title: Lead Engineering Manufacturing Security
description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Security is responsible for executing operational technology (OT) Zero –Trust remote access security program and supporting network segmentation implementations at Danaher manufacturing sites as part of the DIS OT Security Center of Excellence. This role works closely with the OT Security Architects to deploy approved solutions for OT remote access controls, retire legacy VPN and vendor direct-connect solutions, and remediate uncontrolled third-party access across the global manufacturing portfolio. This position offers a unique opportunity to lead the operational execution of a strategic zero-trust remote access transformation across one of the most complex OT environments in the life sciences and diagnostics industry.

This position is part of the Corporate Information Security and will be located as Pune / Bangalore Office.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Support the deployment and site-level configuration of a Zero Trust Remote Access Architecture for OT environments at Danaher manufacturing sites — working under the direction of the Remote Access Lead to operationalize OT remote access, retire legacy VPN solutions, and establish approved, monitored access methods for employees, contractors, and OT OEMs

  • Conduct OT vendor remote access assessments at assigned manufacturing sites — identifying unauthorized or uncontrolled remote connections (legacy modems, consumer-grade remote tools, direct vendor links, unknown cellular connections) and coordinating remediation or replacement with DIS-approved solutions without disrupting production operations

  • Implement site-level OT network segmentation changes with a specific focus on remote access zones, vendor access DMZs, and internet egress controls — working in coordination with the P4 Lead Engineers, OpCo Site Engineers, and the DIS network team during change window execution

  • Manage the vendor remote access on-boarding process at assigned sites — ensuring all third-party connections to OT environments are submitted through the approved DIS process, properly documented, time-limited, monitored, and authorized before use

  • Maintain accurate documentation of remote access architecture configurations, active vendor access records, and site-level deviations from standard design .

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Hands-on experience deploying and managing ZTNA or SASE remote access solutions (Zscaler Private Access, Palo Alto Prisma Access, or equivalent) — including configuration of connectors, access policies, integration with identity providers, and split-tunneling for OT environments

  • Working knowledge of OT/ICS vendor remote access patterns — including jump servers, remote desktop gateways, vendor-managed remote tools (TeamViewer, VNC, Putty, SSH, RDP ), and industrial cellular modems — and the specific cybersecurity risks each access method introduces in a manufacturing environment

  • Demonstrated ability to assess and remediate unauthorized or uncontrolled remote access in operational technology environments — including discovering unknown connections, engaging vendors on remediation, and transitioning to approved access methods without causing production disruption

  • Familiarity with OT network architecture principles (Purdue Model, ISA-95 zone segmentation, DMZ patterns) and the specific remote access controls required at each network boundary, including firewall policy, NAT, logging, and session monitoring requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in OT security, network security, or remote access engineering, with hands-on experience in vendor connectivity management, third-party access governance, or OT network security in industrial or manufacturing environments

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Experience integrating OT remote access solutions— including vendor on-boarding workflows, periodic access review cycles, and deprovisioning procedures that close the loop between IT security, procurement, and plant operations.

Familiarity with privileged access management (PAM) solutions as applied to OT remote sessions, and experience with OT-specific network monitoring tools that provide real-time visibility into active remote connections and anomalous access behavior.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Vi søker cafemedarbeider 80% stilling, Jordbærpikene City Nord🍓
description:
Ønsker du å jobbe et sted hvor maten er smakfull og hjemmelaget? Da er Jordbærpikene det rette valget!

Jobb med oss i Jordbærpikene

Jordbærpikene er en arbeidsplass hvor vi ELSKer jobben vår og har det gøy hver eneste dag.

Vi trenger flere entusiastiske jordbær på laget, og vi søker nå cafemedarbeider i 80% stilling, for å bli med oss i vår spennende hverdag.

Mangfold og inkludering

Hos Jordbærpikene setter vi pris på mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere. Vi ønsker å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

Hvorfor velge Jordbærpikene?

Bli med på en unik reise med Jordbærpikene. Våre kafeer er kjent for sin varme og avslappede atmosfære, samtidig som vi holder et høyt tempo. Her vil du være en del av et miljø der samspill med kolleger er en nøkkel til suksess, og hvor alle gleder seg til å gå på jobb. Vi sørger for god opplæring og muligheter for faglig utvikling.

Rollens ansvar og arbeidsoppgaver

Som cafemedarbeider vil du ha en genuin interesse for å skape gode matopplevelser for våre gjester. Du skal være et positivt innslag, en lagspiller, og ha en lidenskap for å skape minneverdige kundeopplevelser.

Egenskaper vi ser etter

  • Erfaring fra serveringsbransjen er en fordel
  • Trives i et hektisk miljø med høyt tempo
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig samt ta ansvar
  • Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbeidstider, inkludert dag, kveld og helg
  • Må kunne snakke norsk

Våre kjerneverdier

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛, som styrer vår hverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - både økonomisk og sosialt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår og har et varmt hjerte for både mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi støtter hverandre og vet at vi presterer best sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst gjennom å fokusere på gode kundeopplevelser.

title: Lead AI
description:
If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI and creativity, and excited to shape how emerging technologies transform art production across Babil Games Studio and Stillfront’s wider Art Hub, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help shape what’s next for AI-powered creativity in gaming.

Please note: This is a full-time role based in Amman, Jordan.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced and visionary Lead AI to lead Stillfront’s Art Hub existing AI efforts and push them to the next level. You will be responsible for driving strategic initiatives that further embed AI into creative intelligence and analysis, brief generation, and art production. You will own the tech foundation for AI production at the art hub. This hands-on leadership role will require both technical depth and strategic thinking, as you guide the evaluation, adoption, and successful deployment of AI solutions across a diverse range of creative types and games.

Our Art Hub is already deploying AI widely in its processes. Midjourney, Nano Banana, ComfyUI, Krita AI, DALL·E, Leonardo, Scenario, Higgsfield, Flux 2, Seedream, Veo, Hedra, ElevenLabs, Google AI Studio, Krotos, FL studio, ChatGPT, Claude, Kling, AfterEffects AI, Unity, Unreal Engine are tools used on almost every workflow.

YOUR MISSION

  • Define and drive the Art Hub's AI strategy, with generative AI as the core enabler and force multiplier across all crafts and disciplines

  • Develop a deep understanding of the different workflows and disciplines across the Art Hub, and identify what's needed and possible for each

  • Own and improve the tech infrastructure needed for world-class AI production at the Art Hub together with IT

  • Automate processes for creative intelligence, brief generation, art production and creative analysis together with creative strategists, artists and developers

  • Curate, evaluate, and recommend best-in-class generative AI tools, platforms, and vendors tailored to the practical needs of each discipline

  • Establish a lightweight framework for piloting new tools, models, and capabilities, and scale the ones that prove valuable into AI-assisted workflows that measurably reduce manual effort and unlock new creative production possibilities

  • Define success metrics to make impact visible, tracking time saved, adoption rates, and output quality to prove out the "force multiplier" case

  • Continuously scout emerging generative AI tools and models, keeping the Art Hub's approach current in a field that moves fast

  • Stay closely connected with marketing and creative production teams across the group, understand what they're doing and what they need in generative AI, and provide tools and workflows that can be adopted across teams at scale

YOUR BACKSTORY

  • Significant experience working with AI, with strong hands-on familiarity with modern generative AI tools, APIs, and workflows

  • Deep understanding of creative production pipelines and the day-to-day realities of art, design, and performance marketing

  • Strong communicator, able to translate between technical AI capabilities and the practical needs of creative teams

  • Strong project manager who can handle structure and implementation of an AI project

  • Team player who builds trust and buy-in across crafts and functions rather than pushing change top-down

  • Curious, continuously learning mindset, comfortable operating in a field that shifts week to week

Who we are

Babil Games

"Where MENA Plays Bold"

Was founded in 2012 to elevate the gaming landscape for the Arabic-speaking world, filling a gap with culturally relevant content. Headquartered in Dubai and Amman, and part of Stillfront since 2016, we combine MENA market insights with global expertise to deliver exceptional gaming experiences. Join Babil Games and help shape the future of mobile gaming. Apply now to be part of our dynamic team!

Stillfront

Stillfront is a global gaming company. We develop a wide range of digital games that attract over 50 million players each month. From well-established franchises like Supremacy, Big Farm, and BitLife to niche games, we span many different genres, including strategy, simulation, RPG and action, and casual and mash-up games.

We believe gaming can be a force for good. And we want to create a gaming universe that is digital, affordable, equal, and sustainable. So, we focus on developing games that are all about having a rewarding hobby, a great social experience, or a strategic challenge.

Our HQ is in Stockholm, Sweden, but our game development is done by teams and studios all over the world. Our main markets are the US, Japan, MENA, Germany, and the UK. We’re proud that our company shares are listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Varsity Boys Baseball Head Coach- Spring 2027
description:
Are you interested in Coaching for Delta High School.

Please read the information below in its entirety.

COACHES STIPEND

Head Coach Stipend $3,200.00

REQUIREMENTS TO COACH

To be hired and cleared to coach applicants must be able complete training certificates for the following courses (Some coursework requires fees, these are the responsibility of the coach to pay). Courses will be assigned in our District training system:

  • Sexual Harassment training
  • General Coaching Course
  • Sports Specific Course
  • Concussions in sports training
  • Sudden Cardiac Arrest training
  • Heat Acclimatization training
  • Bloodborne Pathogens training
  • Youth Suicide Prevention training
  • Title IX Protecting Students training
  • Asthma Awareness training
  • Social media for Sports training
  • Homeless Education training
  • Sportsmanship training
  • Bullying, Hazing training

Required but not completed in district training system:

  • Negative TB Test
  • First Aid/CPR Certificate
  • Valid Drivers License
  • State of California Mandated Reporting

The Board of Trustees desires to employ highly qualified coaches for the district's sports and interscholastic athletic programs in order to enhance the knowledge, skills, motivation, and safety of student athletes.

The coach of an athletic team is primarily responsible for the compliance of his/her squad members to the rules, regulations, and policies governing athletics at his/her assigned school. Compliance is enhanced when athletes are informed of and understand the policies. All coaches are directly responsible to the Athletic Director and Administrator at his/her school for the application of these rules and regulations.

HEAD VARSITY COACH JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Serve as liaison between the coaching staff and the Athletic Director.
2. Has a thorough knowledge of the Rules and By-Laws of the California Interscholastic Federation, the League, and the River Delta Unified School District as they pertain to his/her sport, including the clearance of all staff members and student-athletes.
3. Understands the proper administrative chain of command and refers all requests or grievances through proper channels. Is aware of all public/staff/departmental meetings that require attendance.
4. Establishes the fundamental philosophy, skills and techniques to be taught by the staff. Designs conferences, clinics and staff meetings to ensure staff awareness of the overall program.
5. Trains and informs staff and encourages professional growth by promoting clinic attendance.
6. Delegates specific duties, supervises implementation, and at season’s end analyzes staff effectiveness and evaluates all assistants.
7. Maintains discipline, mediates grievances, and works to increase morale.
8. Assists the Athletic Director in scheduling, providing transportation needs and requirements for all games, tournaments, and special sports events.
9. Assists in the necessary preparation for scheduled home sports contests or practices and adheres to scheduled facility usage times.
10. Coordinates facility needs/repairs with maintenance and school employees.
11. Provides proper safeguards for eminence and protection of assigned equipment.
12. Recommends policy, method or procedural changes to the Athletic Director.
13. Monitors the grades and conduct of his/her athletes.
14. Provides assistance, guidance, and safeguards for each participant by his/her presence at all practices, games, while traveling, and when returning from off-campus events.
15. Completes paperwork on all disabling athletic injuries on proper forms and submits to the Athletic Director by the next school day.
16. Directs student managers, assistants and statisticians.
17. Determines discipline, delineates procedures concerning due process when the enforcement of discipline is necessary, and contacts parents when a student is suspended, dropped or becomes ineligible.
18. Participates in the budgeting process with the Athletic Director by submitting needs for the next season.
19. Recommends/selects equipment and uniforms within budget appropriations.
20. Is accountable for all equipment in his/her program and submits notification to the Athletic Director for any equipment lost, damaged not returned or returned after the due date.
21. Arranges for issuing, storing, reconditioning of equipment, and submits annual inventory.
22. Properly marks and identifies all equipment before issuing or storing.
23. Secures all doors, lights, window and locks and stores all equipment before leaving building or area. Supervises locker room area before and after practice.
24. Instills in each player a respect for equipment and school property its care and proper use.
25. Responsible for maintaining good public relations with news media, parents, officials, volunteers and fans.
26. Responsible for reporting scores and information after every home contest to the Sacramento Bee. Statistics required by local media, league representatives and Max Preps will also be the responsibility of the head coach. These duties may be delegated.
27. Head Coaches in football are responsible for having written contracts for non-league games with opposing schools.
28. Understands that all drivers must meet district requirements to transport student-athletes and must be at lease 21 years of age prior to driving. Verification will need to be obtained with site secretary. Athletes are not allowed to drive themselves, ride with other athletes, or with drivers not cleared by district.
29. Guarantees that all district equipment including district vehicles is used for official school business only and is operated safely.
30. Performs other duties which may be assigned by the Athletic Director or Principal.
31. Make sure that any volunteer coaches (unpaid coaches or adult help) have been cleared by district. If a coach allows a non-paid coach/volunteer to work with athletes, that coach is violating district and school policies.
32. Make sure that you carry you binder containing insurance and power of attorneys for each athlete.
33. Responsible to make sure that each player signs the Athletic Code of Conduct.
34. All athletic purchase must be cleared with the Athletic Director prior to purchasing.

ABOUT THE DISTRICT

River Delta is a K-12 district with an enrollment of 1,880. The District has 8 small schools: (4) K-6 elementary schools; (2) middle schools; and (2) high schools serving the communities of Clarksburg, Hood, Courtland, Walnut Grove, Ryde, Locke, Isleton, Rio Vista, Birds Landing, and Collinsville.

The River Delta Unified School District sits in three counties – Sacramento, Solano, and Yolo. Although it is a tri-county district, it is served by the Sacramento County Office of Education.
River Delta Unified School District is committed to providing a quality education for all students and has high standards and expectations for students' success in school. We are committed to ensuring that our students meet these standards and that our clients' expectations for educational excellence are not compromised. The District continually improves and expands its curriculum by implementing new programs and broadening the instructional strategies used in the classroom.

Staff development opportunities are provided, encouraged, and promoted. Strategic Schooling is ongoing in all our school sites and Common Core training and coaching is the top priority for the district currently. In addition, the District provides opportunities for staff to participate in on-going in-services in all curriculum areas. The district encourages advancement on the salary schedule for advanced classes taken to improve instruction in areas agreed upon by the teacher, principal, and Superintendent.

title: Ombordundersökning på bussar  - dela ut och samla in enkäter!
description:
Tycker du om att interagera med människor, åka buss och vill jobba med något som leder till samhällsutveckling? Då kan tjänsten som enkätutdelare vara något för dig!

OBS! Vi anställer löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag!

Kort om tjänsten

Du arbetar med att dela ut och samla in enkäter ombord på bussar, på olika linjer. Enkäten består av frågor om passagerarnas resa och hur de upplever den. Du kommer att bli schemalagd för att veta vilka linjer du ska åka och vilka byten du ska göra under ditt pass.

Uppdraget pågår i tio veckor, med start v. 37 i september.

Arbetstider

Du har själv stora möjligheter att påverka ditt schema och när du vill arbeta. Tjänsten är flexibel och varierande, och passar utmärkt som ett deltidsjobb vid sidan av studier eller annat deltidsarbete. Arbetspass kommer att erbjudas på vardagar, morgnar, dagtid och kvällstid.

Kort om dig

Vi söker dig som bor i Nyköping med omnejd och som kan arbeta v.37-46. Du är noggrann och uppmärksam, och trivs med att följa instruktioner.

Du är lättlärd och självgående, t.ex. finner du det enkelt att planera hur du använder tiden ombord på en buss för att hinna dela ut enkäter och sedan samla in dem igen innan du ska gå av på den hållplats du är schemalagd att gå av vid.

Det är även meriterande om du har liknande arbetslivserfarenhet sedan tidigare.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Bor i Nyköping med omnejd.
  • Kan jobba minst ca 1pass i veckan på varierade tider.
  • Är noggrann och ansvarsfull.
  • Är lättlärd och självgående.
  • Är kommunikativ och har lätt för att uttrycka dig på svenska.

Vi erbjuder:

  • En fast timlön på god nivå.
  • Ett trevligt arbetsklimat där tempot är högt, men noggrannhet är viktigast.
  • En liten arbetsplats där varje anställds insats är viktig för helheten.
  • Flexibilitet i arbetstider - frihet under ansvar.

Kort om oss

Vi på Lysio arbetar med olika typer av undersökningar på uppdrag av offentliga organisationer, akademisk sektor, företag och föreningar. Vi sätter kvaliteten på våra undersökningar och vårt analysarbete i första rummet. Nu söker vi fler personer till vårt team. Job Description:

The Wireless Installation Engineer provides technical leadership, oversight, and quality governance for all wireless (WiFi) engineering, design, survey, and installation activities across global Air Force and Space Force modernization sites. This role is responsible for coordinating wireless engineering tasks, ensuring design accuracy, validating survey data, and guiding implementation teams through installation, configuration, and optimization of the wireless infrastructure. The Wireless Installation Engineer oversees wireless engineers, survey technicians, and subcontractor wireless resources to ensure the resulting wireless network meets performance, coverage, security, and DoW compliance requirements.


MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

  • Provide on-site supervision for wireless survey techs, installers, and subcontractor personnel
  • Oversee end-to-end wireless lifecycle activities: predictive design, active/passive surveys, validation surveys, installation, configuration, tuning, and troubleshooting
  • Ensure all wireless designs and implementation activities comply with DoW, Air Force, Space Force, and industry standards including TIA/EIA, UFC, I3A, DoW WiFi security requirements, and OEM best practices
  • Review, validate, and approve predictive wireless designs, heatmaps, channel plans, AP placement, and performance modeling
  • Validate survey data (active, passive, and sensor-based) for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to program-specific survey guidelines
  • Coordinate with the Site Implementation Lead on scheduling, resource management, risk identification, and daily task execution
  • Collaborate with network engineers to ensure proper integration of Cisco 9800 wireless LAN controller (WLC) configurations with switching, routing, authentication, and security infrastructures
  • Oversee quality assurance by inspecting installed APs, cabling, labeling, mounting, and wireless system configurations
  • Ensure accurate documentation including RF designs, survey reports, as builts, configuration files, and post-install validation
  • Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis for wireless performance, coverage, security, and spectrum issues
  • Coordinate with base communications teams, cybersecurity personnel, and Government stakeholders on wireless design and deployment requirements
  • Develop status reports, contribute to briefings, and support weekly project meetings and stakeholder engagements


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 5+ years experience in wireless network engineering, WLAN design, wireless survey, or enterprise wireless deployment
  • BS degree or additional years of experience in Wireless Engineering in lieu of degree
  • Experience leading installation teams in complex environments (DoW, federal, campus, or largescale enterprise preferred)
  • Strong hands-on experience with predictive and validation wireless survey tools (Ekahau, Hamina, iBwave, or similar)
  • Strong familiarity with TIA/EIA wireless-relevant standards and cabling/pathway requirements
  • Understanding of RF fundamentals, antenna types, power levels, interference sources, and spectrum analysis
  • Experience integrating wireless systems into enterprise authentication and network security frameworks
  • Experience managing subcontractor and field technicians in installation and survey operations
  • Experience supporting modernization, upgrade, or large-scale deployment projects
  • Active Secret clearance

Preferred Experience

  • DoW or AF/SF network modernization experience
  • Direct experience with Cisco or Aruba/HPE wireless infrastructure
  • Experience conducting wireless validation surveys on secure or classified networks
  • Previous experience in leading installation teams and working with low voltage cable vendors

Certifications (Preferred or Required)

  • Security+ CE (required or 8140 equivalent)
  • CWNA (Certified Wireless Network Administrator) – strongly preferred
  • CWDP, CWSP, or CWNE – highly desirable
  • Ekahau ECSE (Design, Troubleshooting, or Advanced) – strongly preferred
  • Cisco Wireless (e.g., CCNA Wireless, CCNP Enterprise with Wireless specialization) – preferred
  • BICSI Technician, Installer 2, or other cabling-related certifications considered highly desirable

title: Lead Engineer Manufacturing Security
description:
Bring more to life.

At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Security is responsible for executing OT network security implementations at Danaher manufacturing sites under the direction of the Principal Architect and Lead Engineers. This role focuses on translating detailed OT architecture specifications into deployed network configurations — working hands-on at the site level to implement firewall policy, VLAN segmentation, and DMZ architecture in coordination with OpCo Site Engineers and the DIS network team. This position offers the opportunity to build deep operational expertise in industrial cybersecurity delivery across a truly global, multi-OpCo manufacturing environment.

This position is part of the Corporate Information Security and will be located as Pune Office.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Execute OT network segmentation implementations at assigned Danaher manufacturing sites in accordance with architecture specifications from the DIS OT CoE — configuring firewalls, deploying VLANs, implementing DMZ architectures, and enforcing zone-based access controls in coordination with the DIS and OpCo network teams

  • Partner with OpCo OT Site Engineers during site visits and change windows — serving as the DIS technical presence to ensure implementation accuracy, flag production risk in real time, and adapt to site-specific constraints within the bounds of approved architecture

  • Validate OT segmentation implementations against architecture specifications post-deployment — conducting connectivity validation, firewall rule audits, zone boundary verification, and compensating control checks to confirm designs have been correctly and completely executed

  • Document site-specific implementation findings, as-built network configurations, approved deviations, and compensating controls — maintaining accurate records that feed into the enterprise OT asset inventory, site risk register, and DIS engineering knowledge base

  • Support knowledge transfer to the MSP Operations Team during transition from project delivery to steady-state operations — developing runbooks, escalation procedures, and operational playbooks for each deployed site so the run team can maintain segmentation effectively

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Hands-on experience configuring industrial firewalls, implementing VLAN-based network segmentation, and building DMZ architectures in OT or industrial environments — with demonstrated ability to execute network changes safely in active production settings

  • Working knowledge of OT/ICS components and their network connectivity requirements — including PLCs, SCADA, HMI, historian, and BMS systems — sufficient to assess connectivity dependencies and implement segmentation without disrupting operational processes

  • Familiarity with OT cybersecurity frameworks (IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82) and their application to network segmentation and access control — with the ability to implement to specification and flag deviations for escalation to the Principal Architect or Lead Engineer

  • Experience executing network changes in regulated manufacturing environments (life sciences, pharmaceutical, medical device, chemical, or similar) with an understanding of the operational and GxP constraints on change management in production-active facilities

  • 7+ years of experience in OT security engineering, industrial network engineering, or IT/OT integration, with direct hands-on experience implementing network changes and segmentation configurations in active manufacturing environments

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Exposure to OT asset discovery platforms (Claroty, Nozomi Networks, Dragos, or Armis) and experience maintaining OT asset inventories or contributing to site-level OT risk registers.

Familiarity with GxP-governed change management processes in life sciences manufacturing and experience working with production operations teams to schedule and execute network changes within validated system change control frameworks.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

description:
About the company

Mediplast is part of AddLife group and shares their vision of improving people’s lives by being a leading, value-creating player in Life Science. As a member of this larger MedTech family, we can provide you with additional consulting and services, as well as product training.

As a company producing and distributing medical solutions, sustainability is ingrained in our DNA. We recognize the importance of sustainability and our role in ensuring the long-term viability of our planet and its resources. We are mindful in our use of resources and respectfully implementing sound governance practices and complaint behaviour across our organization. We embrace and drive ESG principles in all aspects of our operations. At Mediplast we recognize the importance of fostering positive social impact and maintaining strong relationships with our employees, customers, and communities.

We strongly believe in fostering a culture that is characterized by humility, helpfulness, personal ownership, and respect amongst each other. By committing to a profound human approach internally, we are convinced that this also mirrors our interactions and relationships with our external stakeholders. We believe this is the reason why we are seen as a trusted and engaged partner with a genuine care for people.

Purchaser to Mediplast

In the exciting role as Purchaser at Mediplast, you will work in a global, high pace and dynamic environment. Here you will have an independent role where you will have responsibility for planning, purchasing and delivery monitoring, both from suppliers and our own manufacturing. You will act as a proactive adviser and follow- up on your daily targets.

You will have personal responsibility for a number of suppliers and actively work to ensure long-term relationships. In the role of Purchaser, great structure, accuracy, and the ability to see the whole picture are required as you will work daily with orders, delivery plans, lead times, forecasts, stock levels and turnover.

Through analysis of supply chain data, you will predict, manage, and avoid risk situations. Inventory management, tracking backorders, understanding pricing and evaluating risk factors will also be your area of responsibility.

You work in a collaborative way internally with various stakeholders to ensure deliveries take place according to agreements and targets. You will be part of a team consisting of six colleagues in purchasing.

About you

For you, high quality, precision, and structure is important. As a person, you are analytical, proactive, business-minded and have an interest in driving improvement, supporting decision-making processes and streamlining our internal processes. In a non-prestige way, you are happy to take on new challenges with an ability to see the solutions rather than obstacles. You are a true team player, prestige less and communicate and convey messages well to your various contact areas, both internally and externally. For us, it is important that you contribute to a healthy culture that is characterized by humility, helpfulness, respect, great personal ownership and always with a clear focus on the patient and healthcare professionals.

For the role of purchaser, we are looking for you who have:

  • Relevant purchasing and/or business education and at least 3 – 5 years of experience in purchasing
  • It’s an advantage if you have experience from the MedTech industry
  • Good systems/computer skills (mainly Excel) and preferably experience with a business system. It’s an advantage if you have experience with Business Central

title: Senior RF Spectrum Engineer
location: El Segundo, CA; Chantilly, VA; Colorado Springs, CO
description:
Senior RF Spectrum Engineer

Location: El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA, Colorado Springs, CO

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

At the Mission Payloads Division (MPD), we are pioneers in remote sensing systems that guide our country’s space enterprise. Our talented and dynamic people create and flourish in electronics, sensors, radar, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced data network domains. We boldly advance technology through our research and development and then forward to demonstration and integration. With innovative laboratories and prototyping, MPD delivers groundbreaking results. We guide our Department of Defense, intelligence community, and civil clients to enhance national productivity and security and tackle the most critical missions. Bring your intelligence and creative spirit and join us at MPD!

The Communication Architectures Department (CAD) performs trade studies, analyses, and simulations to optimize the overall communications performance of terrestrial, satellite, launch vehicle, and ground-based systems. CAD also provides radio frequency (RF) spectrum engineering to future military, civil, and commercial systems and guides the development of spectrum regulations and policies to assure critical wireless systems have access to necessary spectrum resources.

We are seeking a Senior RF Spectrum Engineer (Engineering Specialist or Senior Engineering Specialist – Communications Systems Engineering) to support multiple facets of spectrum management and engineering such as performing interference analysis to support individual programs’ spectrum certification requirements and facilitating coordination between multiple stakeholders. We work with customers throughout the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community, and civil agencies.

The selected candidate will be required to work full time on-site at our facility at El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA, or Colorado Springs, CO.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Perform radio frequency interference analysis and modeling of communications systems to evaluate spectrum sharing strategies and avoid harmful interference

  • Use knowledge of RF communications and spectrum regulations to guide program design decisions and ensure regulatory compliance

  • Support programs through spectrum registration and coordination processes

  • Coordinate with program offices, federal spectrum agencies, and other stakeholders

  • Mentor junior employees in spectrum management and engineering

What You Need to be Successful – Engineering Specialist

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Electrical Engineering or related STEM discipline

  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant technical experience

  • Knowledge of International Telecommunications Union (ITU), National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) or Federal Communications Commission (FCC) spectrum management processes

  • Knowledge of RF communications systems and architectures

  • Project development experience and ability to lead small teams of engineers

  • Ability to present results effectively in briefings and technical reports

  • Some travel, approximately less than 10%, is anticipated

  • This position requires ability to obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

In addition to the above, the minimum requirements for Senior Engineering Specialist:

  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant technical experience

  • Proven project development and technical leadership experience

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • Master’s or PhD in engineering or related discipline

  • Knowledge of various government programs and commercial satellite systems

  • Proficiency in Python or Matlab

  • Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools such as STK and Visualyse

  • Prior experience with spectrum coordination and policy

  • Active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$129,000.00 - $249,600.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

  • Operate Strategically
  • Lead Change
  • Engage with Impact
  • Foster Innovation
  • Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

  • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans

  • Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation

  • Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options

  • 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Variable pay program for exceptional contributions

  • Relocation assistance

  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career

  • Education assistance programs

  • An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . title: Prosessingeniør
description:
Energiforsyningen i Longyearbyen står midt i en historisk og samfunnskritisk omstilling. Etter mer enn 100 år med kullbasert energiproduksjon ble diesel tatt i bruk som energikilde i 2023. De kommende årene skal fremtidens energikraftverk etableres. Samtidig skal stabil energidistribusjon sikres og kritisk infrastruktur videreutvikles i et krevende arktisk miljø.

Omstillingen skjer i et av verdens mest krevende klima. Den innebærer høy bygg- og anleggsaktivitet, store tekniske installasjoner og strenge krav til sikker drift, kvalitet og forsyningssikkerhet.

Vi søker en prosessingeniør som skal ta ansvar for prosessanlegget med tilhørende støttesystemer og bidra til at vi kan produsere elektrisk og termisk energi til Longyearbyens innbyggere. Rollen innehar ansvaret for vedlikehold og skal også støtte resten av avdelingen.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Vedlikeholdsplanlegging i digitalt vedlikeholdssystem

  • Prosjektledelse

  • Bidra med fagkunnskap innen fagområder som energiledelse, prosessteknikk og fjernvarme

  • Følge opp og utvikle leverandører.

  • Bidra til miljørapportering

  • Ansvarlig for analyse av prosessdata og gjennomføre driftsoptimaliseringstiltak og forbedringsplaner for virksomhetens prosesser i samarbeid med andre avdelinger.

  • Fagansvarlig for prosess-sikkerhet herunder funksjonssikkerhet, risikovurderinger, sikkerhetsbarrierer, SIL, HAZOP og bidrag til virksomheten oppfyllelse av forskriftskrav.

Vi ser etter deg med følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Bachelor/master i prosessteknologi, maskin eller lignende

  • Driftserfaring fra kraftvarmeverk, prosessindustri, fjernvarme eller kjemisk industri

  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Erfaring med bruk av digitale verktøy for vedlikeholdsplanlegging og oppfølging

  • Prosjektledererfaring

Det er også en fordel om du i tillegg har erfaring som kjeleoperatør/passer

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter:

  • Gode samarbeidsegenskaper

  • Systematisk og ryddig

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Løsningsorientert og håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en trygg måte

  • God evne til å håndtere stress

  • Evne til å kunne ta selvstendige beslutninger

Svalbard Energi kan tilby:

  • En bred og spennende stilling

  • Gode kolleger i et svært godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Bolig med subsidiert leie

  • Svalbardskatt, for tiden 15,6%

  • En dekket feriereise årlig, dekkede flyttekostnader

  • Lønn etter avtale, svært gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • En mulighet til å være en del av natur og kultur i verdens nordligste, og kanskje hyggeligste by, med unike naturopplevelser på 78 grader nord

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt. Svalbard er et unikt sted. Å jobbe her gir deg verdifull kompetanse du ikke får andre steder

Om Svalbard Energi AS:

Svalbard energi AS er Longyearbyens eneste kraftselskap og leverer nesten all strøm og fjernvarme som holder byen lys og varm. I januar 2026 ble selskapet en del av Store Norske-konsernet. Selskapet er en liten og kompetent organisasjon med rundt 25 ansatte og et bredt spekter av ansvarsområder. Dette gir en variert arbeidshverdag med stor faglig bredde og komplekse problemstillinger.

Tidligere ble energi produsert med lokalt utvunnet kull, men høsten 2023 ble kullkraftverket lagt ned og i dag forsynes byen med strøm og fjernvarme produsert med diesel. På sikt er det en ambisjon om at CO2 utslippene skal reduseres og at energiproduksjonen i Longyearbyen skal omstilles til å bli mest mulig fornybar.

title: Director, Enterprise Solutions Engineering - Mid West
description:
LOCATION

This is a remote position; however, candidates must reside in Michigan, Ohio, Illinois, or Minneapolis to effectively support the region, frequent travel is required, and relocation will not be considered.

INTRODUCTION

The market has shifted. AI is accelerating. The key to AI success is intelligent data and the infrastructure to manage it. Customers are urgently rethinking how they modernize, secure, and unlock value from their data. NetApp is built for this exact moment, with a differentiated platform, deep enterprise credibility, and a clear strategy to win. Joining NetApp now means operating in a high-achievement environment where you are empowered to own every moment. Our culture is grounded in three principles: innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel as a team. These are more than words, they define how we show up, how we sell, and how we grow.

JOB SUMMARY

NetApp is seeking a Director of Enterprise Solutions Engineering to lead our Mid West Sales Region. This is a second line leadership role where you will manage several SE Managers whos teams are responsible for driving technical strategy, customer engagement, field execution, and business growth across one of NetApp’s highest-performing Enterprise regions. Partnering closely with Enterprise Sales leadership, you will shape regional go-to-market strategy, develop high-performing technical leaders, and support complex customer engagements across some of NetApp’s most strategic accounts. Success in this role requires balancing technical leadership with business acumen, developing leaders who coach their teams to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes while helping customers modernize, protect, expand, and unlock greater value from their data.

This leader will cultivate a culture where technical excellence is expected, but customer value, business outcomes, and strong sales partnership are what differentiate winning teams. This is a fun team, we will be looking for a fun leader :)!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Solutions Engineering Managers supporting NetApp’s Enterprise Sales organization across the Midwest region.
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Sales leadership to define regional strategy, drive execution, and accelerate business growth across strategic enterprise accounts through protect, expand, and land motions.
  • Develop leaders who build consultative, value-driven Solutions Engineering teams that translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes and executive-level conversations.
  • Travel alongside Sales and Solutions Engineering leaders to support executive customer meetings, strategic account planning, competitive pursuits, and complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Foster trusted relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders while strengthening NetApp’s position as a strategic technology advisor.
  • Partner with Channel and Alliance organizations to deepen partner engagement and accelerate customer success across the region.
  • Develop high-performing leaders through coaching, talent development, succession planning, organizational planning, and performance management.
  • Serve as the executive escalation point for complex customer opportunities, technical strategy discussions, competitive positioning, and critical business initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, HR, Finance, and Talent Acquisition to execute regional and corporate priorities.
  • Drive operational excellence through forecasting discipline, account planning, business reviews, and execution rigor while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous development, and winning together.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, Enterprise Infrastructure, or related leadership roles within the technology industry.
  • 5+ years of experience leading managers within a Solutions Engineering, pre-sales, or technical sales organization.
  • Proven experience partnering directly with Enterprise Sales leadership to develop regional strategy, drive revenue growth, and execute against business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success developing high-performing leaders through coaching, talent development, succession planning, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, hybrid cloud, AI, cyber resiliency, data management, storage, or adjacent technologies - required.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop teams that effectively connect technical capabilities to customer business outcomes through consultative selling and executive engagement.
  • Experience supporting strategic enterprise customers through complex, multi-product sales motions focused on customer retention, platform expansion, and new business acquisition.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional leadership skills within a matrixed organization.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, and regional field teams.

Compensation:
The target salary range for this position is 325,550 - 421,300 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. The range is based on 'On Target Earnings’ (OTE) representing the total potential earnings, which is the sum of the base salary and potential commission earned when performance targets are achieved. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s). These offerings are subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. We will provide detailed information about the specific benefits for your region during the recruitment process.

title: Careers Coach - EOI
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£30,000 to £31,500

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!

This role is office based, but will involve travel across Cambridge & Peterborough.

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Internal applications for this role close on 21/08/2026.

Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. A Careers Coach is also responsible for conducting outreach in the community, building relationships with referral partners (DWP/JCP), and attending local events (e.g. job fairs) to generate referrals. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.

  • Providing support with CV preparation, job-searching, and interview skills.

  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.

  • Facilitating group training courses and workshops according to their needs.

  • Employer engagement and stakeholder management with the JCP.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

  • Reed Pension Scheme

  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training

  • Professional & Personal Development Funds

  • Bi-annual pay reviews

  • Plus much more that can be found on our website

  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Attainments

  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)

  • Experience of working in a performance target driven environment

  • Willingness to travel locally, and access to own vehicle (e.g. to meet customers/employers).

  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.

  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification).

Desirable Attainments:

  • Experience of working in a fast-paced environment. Examples of such experience may include working as a Holiday Representative or Recruitment Consultant, etc.

  • Experience of and exposure to client groups. These client groups may include incapacity benefit claimants, single parents, those with criminal records, mental health groups, ex-services, specific ethnic minority or faith groups and those with specific disabilities.

  • Direct previous experience of a similar role. Roles considered to be similar include the role of Employment Adviser on a welfare to work contract or a publicly funded service.

  • Degree or relevant qualification. Degree topics may include psychology, sociology, and social care/science. Relevant qualifications would include Information Advice and Guidance NVQs, Brokerage Standard, Social Work qualifications or qualifications relating to work with the specific client groups this role will involve

  • Level 3 or 4 NVQ in Advice & Guidance or Education & Training

  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (Dependent on programme).

  • Technical skills include the ability to use technology to deliver results and knowledge of welfare/benefits system

  • Personal interests include interest in career and self-development.

  • Experience of coaching and/or training

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. title: Mjukvaruutvecklare inom telecom i Karlstad!

title: Software Developer
description:
ABOUT SKJOLDET

We are a Danish fintech startup turning the approach to digital fraud on its head. Imagine being able to convert a phishing site into a signal that could stop everyone from losing money to that exact scam. That's what we're working on. And why? We witnessed first-hand how digital fraud hits ordinary people, especially those close to us, costing them both time and money. We decided to do something about it. Instead of reacting to fraud after the fact, we stop it proactively, outside the bank's systems, before the payment goes through. We are a small, ambitious team of two founders, developers and analysts, entering a new chapter of investment and scaling.

YOUR ROLE

As our Software Developer, you'll be an important part of a small, hands-on technical team – contributing to real features, learning from experienced developers, and helping build systems that detect fraud before money is lost. You'll work closely with our CTO and the rest of the team, and from day one your work will have a real impact.

  • Build and maintain features across our backend and frontend systems

  • Work on real-time data pipelines that process fraud signals at scale

  • Collaborate with fraud analysts and developers to turn data into actionable prevention

  • Write clean, reliable code and learn to take ownership of your contributions

  • Grow your skills in a production environment with meaningful, complex problems

TECH STACK

TypeScript / JavaScript · Node.js · MongoDB / NoSQL · React · AI / ML

WHAT YOU BRING

We're not just hiring your CV. We're hiring your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your drive to build things that actually matter.

  • A degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field or equivalent practical experience

  • Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript and a desire to go deeper

  • Some experience with backend development, whether from jobs, studies, projects or internships

  • Comfortable learning new technologies and asking questions when you're stuck

  • Interest in AI/ML and how data can be used to solve real-world problems

  • Eager to grow in a startup environment where you take real ownership

  • Experience from fintech, finance or regulated environments is a plus – but far from required

WE OFFER

  • A real engineering role – not just support tasks – in a fintech startup with European ambitions

  • Collaboration with experienced developers and the founding team

  • Meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, finance and security from day one

  • Flexible, trust-based work culture in Lyngby

  • The chance to grow fast and help build something that doesn't exist yet

title: Product Manager (Remote)
description:
Advanced Product Manager

Location: Remote Utah, Remote California

Remote Type: Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Avalanche is a Warner Bros. Games studio located in downtown Salt Lake City nestled against the backdrop of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. We’ve been in the video game business since 1995, creating interactive experiences for fans of the world’s largest franchises. Join the team behind the blockbuster open world, action RPG Hogwarts Legacy as we create what’s next!

Avalanche, a division of WB Games Inc., is seeking an Advanced Product Manager to join our team of talented industry veterans working on a new online multiplayer RPG.

Your New Role

We're looking for an Advanced Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of player empathy and analytical rigor. You've shipped games and navigated the intensity of launch and/or found your rhythm in the ongoing discipline of live operations. You know your way around a telemetry pipeline as well as a product roadmap, and you’re able to rally the cross-functional team around a product vision.

Your Role Accountabilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Partner with other disciplines to craft features across your area from concept through release and into post-launch iteration, owning outcomes at every stage

  • Turn high-level business strategy and player insights into clear, prioritized roadmaps for team collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to define short- and long-term product vision, articulating tradeoffs with confidence and clarity

  • Write sharp, thorough PRDs, feature specs, and briefs that empower the team for clear alignment

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective tissue between design, engineering, QA, and data, aligning teams around shared goals without sacrificing speed and vision
  • Lead indirect reports and collaborators toward shared outcomes, exemplifying ownership mindset and setting a high bar for execution
  • Facilitate decisions across stakeholders with competing priorities, building consensus grounded in data and player understanding
  • Communicate progress, risks, and pivots clearly and proactively up to leadership and across the team
  • Own the business outcomes of features in your area

Analytics, Telemetry & Data

  • Design and define telemetry schemas such as instrumentation plans, event taxonomies, and data contracts in close collaboration with engineering and central data teams
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that surface actionable insights across retention, engagement, monetization, and feature health
  • Define success metrics and KPIs for every feature before it ships and conduct post-mortems to understand feature performance and its impact on game health
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify player behavior patterns, funnel breakdowns, and growth levers
  • Conduct market research to understand current trends, anticipate emerging ones, and ensure the product and team remain competitive
  • Translate product questions into analytics tasks, set clear hypotheses, and interpret results with the rigor and nuance
  • Champion a culture of data-informed decision-making across the team

Live Operations

  • Partner with other disciplines to craft the live ops calendar for your feature area that include seasonal content, in-game events, balance updates, and economy tuning
  • Monitor live service health post-launch, triaging issues rapidly and coordinating a swift, organized cross-functional response
  • Continuously analyze live data to identify retention risks and engagement opportunities, moving quickly to act on them
  • Balance the needs of today's players with the long-term health of the game’s economy and community

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience with at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM capacity
  • Shipped or operated a live game
  • You are an active gamer invested in the online RPG and/or cozy genres
  • Deep, hands-on experience designing telemetry systems, defining what to instrument, why it matters, and how it gets implemented
  • Proven ability to build and own dashboards, not just consume them
  • Strong track record of building and maintaining product roadmaps in fast-moving environments ambiguous environments
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and driving alignment across design, engineering, creatives, and business stakeholders
  • Strong analytical foundation. You're comfortable in SQL, fluent with raw data, and skilled at forming hypotheses from ambiguous signals
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills, being able to explain the “why” clearly and align diverse teams around a shared product vision

Nice to Haves

  • Experience taking a product from concept all the way through live ops
  • Console game development experience
  • Various monetization and platform-specific constraints
  • Familiarity with player-facing economy design, battle passes, seasonal content systems, in-game currencies
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks and experiment design at scale
  • Background working with sophisticated monetization ecosystems, navigating diverse player lifecycles and spending behaviors

The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

  • You talk to players, not just about players
  • You treat your dashboard like a living document, not a reporting obligation
  • You push back when strategy doesn't serve the player, and you do it with data
  • You get genuinely excited debating whether a new mechanic will land with your core community
  • You don't wait to be told what the problem but, instead, find it, frame it, and walk in with solutions
  • You set a high bar for yourself and the people around you, and exercise growth mindset, not letting your past successes hinder your future growth

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $122,500.00 - $227,500.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

If you’re a qualified candidate with an arrest or conviction record, please know that your application will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Job Description

Are you passionate about helping people to lead healthier lives?

Are you an enthusiastic, experienced health professional, looking for a flexible & highly rewarding role?

Then consider joining Reed Wellbeing as a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach!

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. As a Self-Employed Health & Wellbeing Coach, you will be responsible for the engagement and delivery of sessions in both group and/or one-to-one settings with participants.

Sessions are delivered face-to-face across Bristol, North Somerset & South Gloucestershire, therefore flexibility and a willingness to travel are essential. Applicants must also have access to their own vehicle and hold a full UK driving licence.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Experience facilitating groups and supporting individuals to achieve positive health, lifestyle, or behaviour changes.

Desirable Criteria:

Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.
