title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Job Summary

NetApp is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the go-to-market strategy and execution for a new first-party cloud storage offering delivered through a leading public cloud platform.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of product, engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, and cloud-partner teams. The successful candidate will help translate a differentiated cloud storage service into clear customer value, repeatable workload solutions, strong field readiness, and measurable business growth.

The role requires a product leader who can operate across strategy and execution: defining target markets and workload priorities, shaping positioning and packaging, enabling sellers and solution architects, engaging directly with strategic customers, and using field and market signals to influence the product roadmap.

Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for the new cloud storage offering, from launch through scaled adoption.
  • Identify priority customer segments, workloads, use cases, and buying motions based on market opportunity, customer needs, and competitive differentiation.
  • Develop a clear customer-value narrative that connects the offering’s technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  • Translate product capabilities into repeatable workload solutions for databases, VMware, enterprise applications, engineering workloads, AI, analytics, and enterprise file services.
  • Establish launch priorities, adoption milestones, success metrics, and mechanisms for tracking business performance.

Product and Business Leadership

  • Act as the product lead for adoption, revenue growth, customer engagement, and market success.
  • Partner with product management and engineering teams to ensure roadmap priorities reflect customer requirements, field feedback, and go-to-market needs.
  • Develop business cases for new capabilities, regions, performance tiers, integrations, and workload investments.
  • Use customer, competitive, and usage insights to identify opportunities to strengthen product-market fit.
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, consumption models, and commercial programs in partnership with finance, sales, and cloud-platform stakeholders.
  • Balance near-term launch requirements with the long-term strategy for the offering.

Cloud-Partner Engagement

  • Build strong working relationships with product, engineering, sales, marketing, and solution architecture teams at the cloud provider.
  • Develop joint plans for customer acquisition, workload migration, seller engagement, and pipeline development.
  • Align cross-company stakeholders around shared priorities, launch milestones, field motions, and customer outcomes.
  • Represent NetApp in joint planning sessions, executive reviews, customer meetings, and industry events.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the offering’s relevance within the broader cloud-services portfolio.

Sales and Field Enablement

  • Equip sellers, solution architects, partners, and customer-success teams with the messaging, tools, training, and competitive guidance required to position the offering effectively.
  • Create repeatable sales plays for priority workloads and customer scenarios.
  • Work directly with account teams to qualify opportunities, overcome adoption barriers, and advance strategic deals.
  • Develop customer-facing materials, solution briefs, reference architectures, presentations, demonstrations, and executive narratives.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms that connect field learning to product, roadmap, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Support lighthouse customers, early adopters, and reference accounts through evaluation, deployment, and expansion.

Customer and Market Engagement

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand workload requirements, migration considerations, operational needs, and purchasing criteria.
  • Serve as a trusted product expert in executive briefings, roadmap discussions, design-partner sessions, and industry forums.
  • Develop a deep understanding of market trends across enterprise storage, cloud infrastructure, data services, AI, databases, and hybrid-cloud operations.
  • Monitor competitive offerings and clearly articulate the service’s differentiation, strengths, and areas for continued investment.
  • Build customer evidence through adoption stories, references, case studies, and measurable business outcomes.

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, go-to-market, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience launching and scaling enterprise technology products or cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of public-cloud platforms, cloud consumption models, enterprise infrastructure, and partner-led go-to-market motions.
  • Experience working with sales, engineering, product marketing, solution architecture, finance, and customer-success organizations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer value and repeatable sales motions.
  • Experience engaging with enterprise customers, senior executives, sellers, and technical decision-makers.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define business metrics, evaluate market opportunities, and make evidence-based prioritization decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an ambiguous, fast-moving, pre-launch environment.

Success Messures

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Launch readiness and execution
  • Customer adoption and consumed capacity
  • Qualified pipeline and revenue growth
  • Seller and solution-architect readiness
  • Number and quality of repeatable workload solutions
  • Strategic customer wins and reference accounts
  • Joint field engagement with the cloud provider
  • Customer satisfaction and expansion
  • Influence on roadmap priorities based on market evidenc

Leadership Attributes

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a business owner and acts with urgency.
  • Moves comfortably between product strategy, customer detail, and field execution.
  • Creates clarity in complex cross-functional environments.
  • Builds trust across company and partner boundaries.
  • Uses data and customer evidence to drive decisions.
  • Understands that launching a product is only the beginning; success comes from creating repeatable adoption at scale.

Education

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

Compensation:
The target salary range for this position is 227,800 - 338,800 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

title: Product Manager Ads Data Insights & Targeting
description:
About the Team

The Ads Data Insights & Targeting team delivers leading targeting and reporting capabilities, a necessity for Schibsted to succeed in the advertising market. Our competition is Meta and Google, so the bar is high.

Among our products are data cleanrooms, matched audiences infrastructure, reach estimation models, as well as general ad impression level data reporting and data products. Real AI requires real AI ready data and working towards this is our current top priority.

Our products are powered by data from the billions of advertising impressions Schibsted generates each month as well as data about the millions of people using our services each day. Based on available data we define and calculate relevant metrics for our advertisers, we integrate with vendors and customers and provide targeting datasets for our advertising delivery systems. You and the team deliver the models and pipelines to convert the data we import into data outputs used by our customer facing applications.

The data and insights team consists of 11 people, mostly based in Krakow, with a mix of data engineering, general software engineering and data analytics and science background.

About the Role

The product manager for data solutions is responsible for managing product development of all advertising data flows related to campaign targeting and insight reporting. You will report to the director of ad data capabilities and work closely with our data portfolio team in Norway and Sweden as well as other product managers for Schibsted ad technologies.

In this role, you will

  • Manage near-term product delivery (we use a Kanban approach) while steering our offering with a long-term product strategy in mind.

  • Collaborate with product marketing and sales teams to understand client and market requirements to feed into the product development process

  • Collaborate with teams in ad operations and ad technology and other engineering teams and product functions to bring our data products to market

To thrive in this role we believe you

  • Are in possession of strong analytical skills and mindset

  • Are good at building trust with all types of internal and external stakeholders

  • Enjoy constantly changing perspectives from the critical details to the bigger picture

Competency requirements

  • Degree level qualification in business, mathematics, statistics or technology, or equivalent experience.

  • Several years of experience within product management or data analyst roles or equivalent.

Valued skills and experience

  • Experience from product management with data products and large datasets

  • High level understanding of relevant cloud and big data technologies

  • Experience from media or advertising industry

About Schibsted Marketing Services

Schibsted Marketing Services is Schibsted´s advertising organization, representing some of the strongest news brands in Norway and Sweden - like VG, Aftonbladet, Aftenposten and SvD. In addition we work with our partners at TVM representing TV4 and MTV on select data targeting and insights projects.

Advertising plays a central role in funding independent news media, and every day the people at Schibsted Marketing Services work hard to strengthen Schibsted's position in the advertising markets we operate. You can be part of that team and that journey.

title: Quality Engineer Principal - MLOps
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Quality Engineer Principal within PNC's Data and Automation Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Strongsville, OH or Dallas, TX.

We are looking for a MLOPs Quality Engineer Principal to join the Data & Automation organization, supporting the MLOps ecosystem. In this hands on individual contributor role, you will be responsible for driving scalable, automation-first validation strategies across teams, systems, and complex integrations. This role operates at both hands-on and strategic levels, influencing best practices, improving testability, and establishing reusable quality patterns that enable both design & operating effectiveness. You will be responsible for designing, building, coordinating, executing & validating risk & control testing strategies across the MLOPs portfolio.

You will work closely with QE resources, Development teams, and Platform Engineers to strengthen & standardize test coverage, automation, and end to end quality w/ evidence.

Key Responsibilities:
· Design MLOps testing strategies which verify that the rules, policies, and procedures put in place as internal controls are properly designed and operating effectively
· Champion automation, continuous testing and shift-left testing methodologies
· Build and maintain test automation and ensure stds are adopted and followed.
· Identify controls gaps and develop test harnesses to detect and validate.
· Support test data and test environment readiness across environments.
· Analyze defect trends and production incidents — contributing to root cause analysis and recommending preventive measures.
· Provide quality sign off as needed
· Contribute to QE standards and best practices for MLOps testing techniques, tools, and approaches within the ecosystem.

Key Skills & Qualifications:
• Strong understanding of the MLOps lifecycle, including model validation, deployment, and monitoring
• Experience designing scalable test strategies across complex data and ML systems
• Expertise in test automation and continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines
• Proficiency in Python, API testing, and data validation (SQL)
• Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and distributed data systems
• Experience with risk-based testing, controls validation, and audit readiness
• Ability to analyze defects and production issues and drive root cause solutions
• Strong collaboration and stakeholder influence across engineering and QE teams
• Self-driven with a strategic mindset and hands-on execution capabilitiesPNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Drives the development of test strategies and plans, ensuring alignment with enterprise-level objectives and delivery timelines.
  • Escalates systemic issues to Quality Engineer leadership and influences resolution strategies.
  • Oversees risk and defect processes, ensuring adherence to ECO standards. Provides detailed insights through accurate and timely reporting.
  • Leads preparation and delivery of test summary reports and documentation for Technology leaders, Governance/Risk teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborates across teams and participates in Quality Engineer CoP meetings to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
  • Provides strategic mentorship and oversight to more junior Quality Engineer team members, ensuring consistent execution of testing standards.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

title: 2 AI Developers | Azure AI Foundry & Copilot
description:

This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, including Azure AI Foundry, Copilot and AI Agents, helping to drive digital innovation, improve productivity and support enterprise-wide adoption of generative AI.

The Opportunity

AI Developer x 2 | Azure AI Foundry & Copilot | 12 Month Contract

As an AI Developer, you will design, build, deploy and maintain AI-powered applications, agents and automation solutions using Microsoft Azure AI services and Azure AI Foundry. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver secure, scalable and user-focused AI capabilities that create measurable business value.

AI Agent Development & Digital Enablement

  • Configure and deploy Azure AI Foundry agents tailored to business requirements
  • Develop AI solutions supporting document drafting, summarisation, workflow automation and decision support
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise platforms such as SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Outlook and other business systems

  • Build and maintain code supporting AI-enabled applications and services
  • Ensure AI solutions comply with privacy, security and responsible AI standards
  • Support architectural reviews and transition-to-service activities
  • Contribute to benefits realisation, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Monitor and evaluate agent performance, adoption and user outcomes
  • Support user onboarding, training and change management activities
  • Develop learning materials, user guides and documentation
  • Provide recommendations to enhance cross-platform functionality and data-driven insights

About You

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AI Agents and Copilot technologies
  • Strong understanding of Azure cloud services and enterprise AI solution delivery
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
  • Experience configuring and deploying secure and scalable AI applications
  • Practical knowledge of generative AI models and prompt engineering
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication capabilities
  • Experience delivering user training, workshops or adoption initiatives

Essential Experience

  • Demonstrated proficiency in configuring AI tools using Microsoft Foundry

Desired Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline

Contract Details

  • Position: AI Developer (2 positions available)

  • Location: ACT
  • Working Arrangement: Hybrid (typically 2 to 3 days in the office per week)

Why Apply?

title: Kilpisjärvi | Santa's Hotel Rakka: Keittiömestari
description:
Ammattitaitoiseen ja rentoon työyhteisöömme Kilpisjärvelle haetaan vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen (112,5h/3vk) tehtävään KEITTIÖMESTARIA johtamaan Santa's Hotel Rakan keittiötä. Ravintolassamme valmistetaan aamiaista, puolihoitoa sekä à la carte-annoksia. Keittiömestarina vastaat ravintolan ruokaelämyksistä, keittiötiimin johtamisesta ja keittiön sujuvasta, tuloksekkaasta toiminnasta ketjun kehittyvien konseptien mukaan. Johdat esimerkilläsi, kehität ruokalistaa sesonkien mukaan ja varmistat korkean laadun kaikessa tekemisessä raaka-aineista asiakaskokemukseen.

Oletko haaveillut pienessä kyläyhteisössä asumisesta ja työskentelystä Käsivarren upeissa maisemmissa luonnon keskellä? Olet etsimämme tyyppi, jos intohimonasi on luoda elämyksiä asiakkaille laadukkaiden ruokatuotteiden parissa ja kehittää kokonaisvaltaisesti keittiön tuloksellista toimintaa. Käytät sujuvasti tilannetajua ja olet omatoiminen tiimipelaaja, jolta ei mene sormi suuhun kiireenkään keskellä. Erityisen hyvät valmiudet tehtävään antaa alan koulutus ja aiempi kokemus keittiön esihenkilönä toimimisesta. Tehtävässäsi toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä omana esihenkilönäsi toimivan ravintolapäällikön sekä hotellinjohtajan kanssa.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Vahvaa kokemusta keittiön johtamisesta ja tuloksellisesta toiminnasta

  • Näyttöä onnistuneesta esihenkilötyöstä ja henkilöstön motivoinnista

  • Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

  • Hygieniapassia

  • Suomen ja englannin kielen sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista osaamista

  • Eduksi katsotaan järjestelmäosaaminen (esimerkiksi Opera Cloud, Simphony, Maraplan, Kespro)

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän ympärivuotisessa ravintolassa

  • Santa's Hotels -ketjun henkilöstöedut

  • Positiivisen työskentelyilmapiirin ja kannustavan tiimin työsi tueksi

  • Tarvittaessa mahdollisuuden henkilökunta-asuntoon

  • Palkkaus: MaraTES tai kokemus-/osaamisperusteinen sopimuspalkka

Hakuaika päättyy 23.8.2026, mutta haethan pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyn aikana.

Lisätiedot

Petri Neuvonen, Santa's Hotel Rakka ravintolapäällikkö
petri.neuvonen@santashotels.fi, puh. 0406671470 (soittoajat maanantaisin ja torstaisin klo 12-14)

Vuonna 2023 valmistunut Santa’s Hotel Rakka tarjoaa Saanatunturin ja Käsivarren erämaan kävijöille 41 hotellihuonetta, 21 täysvarusteltua huoneistoa sekä 100-paikkaisen ravintolan. Huoneiden laadukas, pohjoismainen design ja huoneiden ikkunoista avautuvat Saanatunturin jylhät maisemat luovat keskenään näyttävän kontrastin. Hotelli tarjoaa korkeatasoisen palvelukokonaisuuden, jossa asiakkaan kokonaisvaltainen elämys on tärkeintä.

Santa's Hotels on lappilainen perheomisteinen hotelliketju, joka on osa Sava-Group-konsernia. Hotelliliiketoimintaa konsernissa on harjoitettu jo yli 30 vuotta, ja Santa’s Hotels -ketju on kasvanut vuosien aikana yhdeksi merkittävimmistä lappilaisista matkailualan toimijoista. Kansainvälinen ja tyylikäs ketjumme tarjoaa elämyksellisiä majoitus- ja ravitsemis- sekä kokous- ja juhlapalveluita Rovaniemellä, Luostolla, Levillä, Saariselällä, Kilpisjärvellä ja Kalajoella. Lisäksi Kalajoen hotellistamme löytyy myös kylpylä. Ketjumme työllistää ympärivuotisesti noin 150 henkilöä ja sesonkiaikoina noin 300 henkilöä.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer II

Location: GA Atlanta 1050 Techwood Drive NW

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X!

About the Team

With deep domain expertise, advanced technical capabilities, and a proven track record of successful collaborations, the AI Enablement & Machine Learning team at CNN is accelerating our digital transformation through strategic applications of machine learning and AI technologies.

The AI Systems group builds AI-powered applications and systems that solve real problems for CNN's audiences and internal teams. Our work spans consumer-facing features (article summaries, weather summaries), internal AI tooling for editorial, product, design, engineering, and business teams, content and product classification systems, and the AI platform that powers it all — prompt management, evaluation, caching, versioning, deployment, and tenant management. We are held to the high standards our audiences expect from a news organization: reliable, accurate, and trustworthy.

Your New Role...

As a Software Engineer II on AI Systems, you will design, build, and operate AI-powered applications and the platform capabilities that support them. You will partner with ML engineers, editorial and product stakeholders, and platform engineers to ship features that improve CNN's user experience and internal productivity.

Key challenges you will tackle:

LLM-Based Content Understanding: Build the in-house, LLM-based content understanding capability that replaces a vended classification product — improving quality, expanding adoption to new business domains across CNN, and powering downstream use cases including ad targeting, content routing, and brand safety.

Consumer-Facing AI Features: Ship and iterate on AI-powered features that reach millions of users — article summaries, weather summaries, and the next set of audience-facing experiences — with the accuracy and trustworthiness CNN's audiences expect.

AI Platform Maturation: Grow CNN's AI platform capabilities — prompt management, evaluation, caching, versioning, deployment, and tenant management — so that AI features across CNN can be built, tested, and operated reliably and efficiently.

Internal AI Tooling: Build AI-assisted workflows for editorial, product, design, engineering, and business teams that drive measurable productivity gains.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Author, test, review, and optimize production-quality code, following best practices for IaC, version control, and continuous delivery with minimal oversight

  • Be a subject matter expert in one or more AI Systems production systems, independently shipping high- quality features and helping others understand complex technical domains

  • Provide technical input during design of components and systems architecture, driving technical decisions that create functional-level impact

  • Integrate ML models and foundation models into production applications with appropriate guardrails, monitoring, and evaluation

  • Solve business problems with simple and straightforward solutions, proactively defining problems and driving clarity for the team

  • Drive operational excellence — building highly available, low-latency, and efficient software while thinking long-term about code health, monitoring, alerting, and documentation

  • Partner with editorial, product, and ML stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable AI features

  • Communicate effectively across audiences — technical documentation, code reviews, design reviews, and interactions with stakeholders and adjacent teams

  • Embrace failure as a learning opportunity — use research and experimentation to choose solutions that meet company goals, moving autonomously from proof-of-concept to production

Qualifications & Experience…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or 2+ years with a Master's degree)

  • Strong backend engineering experience with data-intensive applications at web scale

  • Proficiency in Python and at least one of Go, Java, or C++

  • Solid foundation in relational databases (Postgres or equivalent), NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or equivalent), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, and ship highly available, low-latency systems

    Nice to Haves

  • Experience integrating LLMs or foundation models into production applications

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, or LLM observability

  • Experience with classification, content understanding, or information retrieval systems

  • Understanding of experimentation frameworks and A/B testing methodologies

  • Prior experience working on a machine learning or AI team

  • Background in media, publishing, or news organizations

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: Business Controller
description:
Ben jij een Business Controller die energie krijgt van structuur aanbrengen, processen verbeteren en collega's in beweging krijgen? Bij Qbuzz krijg je de kans om een sleutelrol te spelen in het verder professionaliseren van de financiële organisatie. Als rechterhand van de Manager Business Control zorg jij ervoor dat financiële processen soepel verlopen en leg je de basis voor verdere groei en standaardisatie.

Dit ga je doen

Als Business Controller ben je de rechterhand van de Manager Business Control en zorg je ervoor dat financiële processen, rapportages en verbeterinitiatieven soepel verlopen. Je bewaakt deadlines, houdt overzicht en zorgt dat acties binnen het team van concessie controllers daadwerkelijk worden opgepakt en afgerond. Je schakelt dagelijks met je collega’s in de concessies, budgethouders en andere stakeholders binnen de organisatie. Extern sluit je aan bij overleggen met andere vervoerders, bijvoorbeeld VSS overleggen, waarin het gaat over opbrengsten uit producten als studenten-OV.

Je ondersteunt bij de budget-, forecast- en maandafsluitingscyclus en helpt bij het opstellen van managementrapportages. Ook werk je aan het verder standaardiseren van processen en templates, zodat financiële informatie op een uniforme manier wordt verzameld en gerapporteerd. Je begrijpt de inhoud achter de cijfers en weet die context te vertalen naar heldere analyses en rapportages voor management en directie.

Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Op dit moment ligt de focus op het creëren van rust, structuur en efficiëntie. Je helpt bij het verbeteren van bestaande werkwijzen, ondersteunt bij uiteenlopende financiële vraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat collega's beschikken over de juiste informatie en tools om hun werk goed te kunnen doen. Zodra de basis verder staat, krijg je de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe projecten, procesverbeteringen en toekomstige ontwikkelingen binnen Qbuzz.

Dit krijg je van ons

Allereerst een fijne werkomgeving met veel gedreven en collegiale collega’s die er samen met jou écht wat van willen maken. Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • Salaris tussen € 5.714 - € 6.974 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • Met daar bovenop 8% vakantietoeslag

  • Een contract van 32 of 40 uur per week

  • 23 - 29 vakantiedagen, afhankelijk van je leeftijd

  • 17 ATV dagen naast je vakantiedagen

  • Goede pensioenregeling via Rail en OV

  • Verschillende kortingen; collectieve ziektekostenverzekering en fitness abonnement

Dit breng jij mee

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in financiële richting.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als Business Controller of in een vergelijkbare financiële rol.

  • Kennis van de OV-sector is een vereiste voor deze rol. Een pré is ervaring met HFM. (Hyperion Financial Management)

  • Een zelfstandige, proactieve werkhouding en het vermogen om overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om collega's op een positieve manier mee te nemen en afspraken op te volgen.

Interesse?

Solliciteer dan direct met je cv. Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met corporate recruiter Jonne Hofstee via

jonne.hofstee@qbuzz.nl.

Over Qbuzz

Openbaar vervoer zo vanzelfsprekend en betrouwbaar als water uit de kraan: altijd beschikbaar en van hoge kwaliteit. Daar staan en gaan we voor. We verbeteren, vernieuwen en groeien. En dit doen we met ons oranje Qbuzz hart.

Onze kernwaarden Verbindend, Vindingrijk, Verantwoordelijk en Vakkundig vormen Qbuzz en zijn de leidraad voor onze dagelijkse beslissingen. Onze missie iedere dag een vanzelfsprekende verbinding is een belofte, een verhaal waar we samen in geloven en delen met de wereld. Bij Qbuzz kijken we elke dag hoe het openbaar vervoer in onze streek of stad beter kan. Slimmer. Sneller. Duurzamer. Vriendelijk. Veilig. Dat doen we graag samen met anderen. En altijd met een open, nieuwsgierige blik.

Daardoor zien we onze reizigers. We zien wat mensen beweegt en we zijn er voor ál die mensen. Waar ze ook heengaan en hoe hun pet ook staat. We brengen ze zo snel mogelijk naar hun werk en met liefde naar oma. We zijn er (op tijd) voor als ze zenuwachtig zijn voor die date, dat sollicitatiegesprek of hun eindexamen. We loodsen ze soepel en veilig door de stad en laten ze rustig genieten van de regio. En we laten zien dat we ze zien. Met een groet en een grapje, als het past.

Zo zorgen we voor een soepele verbinding en fijne aansluiting. Tussen mensen onderling, in de bus, in de tram en in de trein. Maar ook tussen dorp en stad, tussen idee en bestemming. Samen komen we verder, elke dag.

Samen vooruit, samen thuis.

title: Vi søker cafemedarbeidere til Jordbærpikene City Nord🍓
description:
Ønsker du å jobbe et sted hvor maten er smakfull og hjemmelaget? Da er Jordbærpikene det rette valget!

Jobb med oss i Jordbærpikene

Jordbærpikene er en arbeidsplass hvor vi ELSKer jobben vår og har det gøy hver eneste dag.

Vi trenger flere entusiastiske jordbær på laget, og vi søker nå cafemedarbeidere i varierende stillingsprosent, til å bli med oss i vår spennende hverdag.

Mangfold og inkludering

Hos Jordbærpikene setter vi pris på mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere. Vi ønsker å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn eller kjønn.

Hvorfor velge Jordbærpikene?

Bli med på en unik reise med Jordbærpikene. Våre kafeer er kjent for sin varme og avslappede atmosfære, samtidig som vi holder et høyt tempo. Her vil du være en del av et miljø der samspill med kolleger er en nøkkel til suksess, og hvor alle gleder seg til å gå på jobb. Vi sørger for god opplæring og muligheter for faglig utvikling.

Rollens ansvar og arbeidsoppgaver

Som cafemedarbeider vil du ha en genuin interesse for å skape gode matopplevelser for våre gjester. Du skal være et positivt innslag, en lagspiller, og ha en lidenskap for å skape minneverdige kundeopplevelser.

Egenskaper vi ser etter

  • Erfaring fra serveringsbransjen er en fordel
  • Trives i et hektisk miljø med høyt tempo
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig samt ta ansvar
  • Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbeidstider, inkludert dag, kveld og helg
  • Norsk er en fordel
  • Alder over 18 år

Våre kjerneverdier

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛, som styrer vår hverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - både økonomisk og sosialt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår og har et varmt hjerte for både mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi støtter hverandre og vet at vi presterer best sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst gjennom å fokusere på gode kundeopplevelser.


Har du spørsmål? Ikke nøl med å ta kontakt med daglig leder Cathrine Nilsen på tlf. 41215560, eller via e-post på cathrine.nilsen@jbp.no 🍓

title: Restaurantsjef / Nestleder
description:
Folk elsker Sabrura Sticks & Sushi – og kjeden er i sterk vekst. Vi er et helnorsk konsept som serverer fersk sushi og asiatiske småretter både i restaurant og som take away. Som en del av Bitastad har Sabrura et sterkt apparat i ryggen. Vi har eiere som har tro på forretningsmodellen vår, og som er villig til å investere i videre vekst. Dette gjør Sabrura til et ekstra spennende og pulserende arbeidssted - her er det tempo og framdrift som gjelder. Dette krever en dedikert og allsidig kokk med sterk gjennomføringskraft.

Vi søker etter Restaurantsjef /Nestleder til vår restaurant i Oppdal, på heltid.

I Sabrura brenner vi for å gi våre gjester fantastiske mat- og serviceopplevelser. Det er derfor essensielt at vi bygger våre retter på veldig gode råvarer som håndteres av kyndige og matglade kokker. I tillegg skal vi være proaktiv og gi våre gjester den service vi selv ville satt pris på. Du vil få en flott arena i en av våre restauranter med topp moderne kjøkken. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av samspill, fellesskap og et felles ønske om å levere gode kundeopplevelser og resultater.

Som restaurantsjef og nestleder i vår restaurant skal du lede det daglige operative arbeidet. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra til våre gjester gjennom fantastiske service- og matopplevelser.

Vi søker deg som:

  • Har erfaring fra kjøkken eller restaurant.
  • Har gode lederegenskaper.
  • Har god kunnskap om IK-mat og HMS.
  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo.
  • Har erfaring fra tilsvarende virksomhet.

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse;

title: Global Contracts Negotiator
description:
Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating deals, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting deal recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

As a Global Contracts Negotiator, you will be responsible for oversight and assistance of the contractual needs for all aspects of building Google's Cable Landing Stations globally. You will take a leadership role in working with peers, managers, internal stakeholders, and executives of Google and general contractor partners.

Your key priorities are ensuring that our delivery teams’ contractual needs are fulfilled, negotiation of agreements to protect Google's rights while ensuring consistency in contracting and agreement performance, oversight of agreement administration across all projects, and interfacing with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders. You will have a deep knowledge of construction agreements, including design-build, design-assist, design-bid-build, and others, as well as demonstrated commercial acumen to understand how construction agreements assist and structure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Lead a team of individuals; set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.

Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss😎

Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

Backend Engineering Intern

5–6 months · Real production systems · PPO track

Most internships hand you a toy project on the side. This one doesn’t. You’ll ship code into the same backend that runs AI defect detection for the world’s largest chip factories — alongside the engineers and founders who built it. You’ll write real APIs, solve real latency and scale problems, and see your work reach global semiconductor manufacturers within weeks, not quarters.

And you’ll do it in one of the most AI-native engineering teams you’ll find anywhere. We don’t just build AI products — we build AI agents that write, review, and test our own code. As an intern here, using Claude Code / Codex and agentic workflows won’t be a novelty; it’ll be how you work every day. You’ll leave months ahead of peers who are still writing everything by hand.

What You’ll Do

  • Build scalable, low-latency, high-performance systems and learn what “production-grade” actually means.

  • Work on multi-tenant isolation and access control for a platform where hard data separation between customers is non-negotiable.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with senior engineers and founders on real customer problems.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and get thoughtful reviews that make you sharper every week.

  • Use AI agents (Claude Code / Codex) to automate the boring parts and move faster — and learn to build with them, not just use them.

  • Learn modern software engineering the way high-growth startups actually do it: fast, pragmatic, high-ownership.

Required

  • Strong programming skills in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with the Django framework.

  • Excellent Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) fundamentals.

  • Knowledge of relational databases and database design fundamentals.

  • Genuine curiosity — you like hard problems and you learn fast.

Good to Have

  • Experience building with AI coding tools (Claude Code / Codex) or AI agents.

title: Teamleder regnskap - Enora AS
description:
Enora er et nyetablert nordisk regnskaps- og rådgivningsmiljø, lansert i 2026 etter sammenslåing av flere sterke fagmiljøer. Med rundt 700 ansatte – hvorav ca. 250 autoriserte regnskapsførere – bygger vi nå en felles kultur med tydelig fokus på kvalitet, fag og mennesker.

Enora ble etablert etter salget av BDO Business Services til RAN Group. Vi er et nyopprettet selskap med over 1000 eksperter, 13 000 kunder og en omsetning på over 1,5 milliard kroner etter salget fra BDO. Med etableringen sammen med Ran Group har vi friheten til å utvikle fremtidens ledende løsninger innen regnskap, rådgivning og teknologi.

Med dyp bransjeforståelse optimaliserer vi våre leveranser skreddersydd hver enkelt bedrift. Enora har stort fokus på bransjekompetanse og vi har derfor spesialisert oss i bransjeteam, slik at vi kan levere en unik bransjeinnsikt.

For å styrke den operative kapasiteten i Vestfold søker vi nå Teamleder regnskap – en rolle for deg som er faglig sterk, trives i kundedialog og ønsker å ta et tydelig ansvar for både leveranser og mennesker.

Dette er en operativ teamlederrolle, der du kombinerer eget kundefokus med ledelse av et kundeteam.

Rollen innebærer blant annet:

  • Ansvar for egen kundeportefølje (ca. 70 % av tiden)
  • Ledelse og faglig oppfølging av kundeteam, primært juniorressurser
  • Kvalitetssikring av leveranser og kontroll av andres arbeid
  • Personalansvar og bidra til faglig utvikling i teamet
  • Avlastning og tett samarbeid med kontorleder
  • Utvidet kundekontakt og rådgivning
  • Bidrag i videre utvikling av kontoret og arbeidsprosesser
  • Mulighet for å være Enoras ansikt utad mot næringsliv og nettverk

Stillingen er tilknyttet vårt kontor i Sandefjord, på Tassebekk Office Center.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en trygg og erfaren fagperson som ønsker å ta et større ansvar – med eller uten formell ledererfaring.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Har minimum ca. 6 års relevant erfaring innen regnskap/revisjon
  • Er statsautorisert regnskapsfører eller revisor (eller har svært solid erfaring)
  • Har god erfaring med årsoppgjør og rådgivning
  • Trives i kundedialog og bygger tillit over tid
  • Er strukturert, kvalitetsbevisst og faglig trygg
  • Har lyst til å bidra til kulturbygging i et selskap i sterk utvikling

Erfaring med systemer som Tripletex, Business NXT eller Xledger, samt årsoppgjørsverktøy som Maestro, er en fordel – men ikke et krav.

Hos Enora får du

  • En sentral rolle i et selskap med tydelige vekstambisjoner og sterk eierstruktur
  • Mulighet til å forme både egen rolle og videre utvikling
  • Et inkluderende og kollegialt arbeidsmiljø med høy fagkompetanse
  • Fleksitid og hybrid arbeidshverdag (1–2 dager hjemmekontor)
  • Gode ordninger for kurs/etterutdanning
  • Kortere arbeidsdager sommerstid og redusert arbeidstid i romjul
  • Sosiale og faglige møteplasser på tvers av kontorer
  • Konkurransedyktig fastlønn , bonusordning, samt gode pensjons- og velferdsordninger

Interessert?

Enora samarbeider med Skagerak Consulting i denne rekrutteringsprosessen. For mer informasjon kan du kontakte våre rådgivere Monica Nordby, tlf. 458 53 755 eller Geir Nordvold, tlf. 938 28 100.

Skagerak Consulting AS er et unikt, tverrfaglig rådgivningsmiljø. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

Les mer om Skagerak Consulting AS her: www.skc.no

For å unngå bedrageriforsøk vil vi presisere at vi aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

title: Kjøkkenmedarbeider
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss🧑‍🍳

Som kjøkkenmedarbeider er du stjerna på vårt topp moderne kjøkken i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater🤩


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på.


Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Trives i et arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo
  • Har erfaring fra kjøkken-eller servicebransjen
  • Har kunnskap om IK-mat og HMS

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.


Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢


Har du spørsmål er du hjertelig velkommen til å kontakt med restauranteier Christine Halvik Hagen på 41067788/christine.halvik.hagen@sabrurasushi.no

title: Digital Signals and RF Engineer
description:
Digital Signals & RF Engineer

Location: El Segundo, CA

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

At the Mission Payloads Division (MPD), we are pioneers in remote sensing systems that guide our country’s space enterprise. Our talented and dynamic people create and flourish in electronics, sensors, radar, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced data network domains. We boldly advance technology through our research and development and then forward to demonstration and integration. With innovative laboratories and prototyping, MPD delivers groundbreaking results. We guide our Department of Defense, intelligence community, and civil clients to enhance national productivity and security and tackle the most critical missions. Bring your intelligence and creative spirit and join us at MPD!

Interested in prototyping cutting-edge communication and Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) systems that will drive future acquisition programs? Then a role as a Digital Communications & Signal Processing Engineer in the Digital Communication Implementation Department (DCID), under The Aerospace Corporation’s MPD, is the ideal landing spot for your next career move!

DCID uses software-defined radios and FPGA technology to develop advanced communication and navigation system prototypes (GNSS, PNT, GPS, etc.) that solve the toughest problems related to digital communication systems. DCID’s support includes guiding the acquisition of next-generation communication and navigation systems needed by our customers, helping industry implement cutting edge technologies and creating innovative solutions to our customers’ most challenging problems. Our group supports exciting programs such as the Aerospace CubeSat SlingShot Platform, the development of the Payload Characterization and Environments (PACE) Lab, and competes in challenges such as the Blind Signal Classification Challenge. Please join us on the leading edge of digital communications.

The selected candidate will be required to work full time on-site at our facility at El Segundo, CA

What You’ll Be Doing

Job Summary:

  • Developing and implementing signal processing algorithms with applications to GPS/GNSS/Software Defined Radio receivers and/or communication transceivers and/or digital signal processing on FPGA hardware or in software

  • Analysis of signal processing performance using MATLAB, Python, or similar simulation environments

  • Prototyping of cutting-edge real-time systems for emulation and proof of concept

  • Research pertaining to advanced signal processing, GNSS technology/future development and Alternative PNT concepts

  • Documenting work products in briefings and/or technical reports to customers and colleagues

What You Need to be Successful – Senior Member of Technical Staff

Minimum Requirements:

  • ​​Master’s degree from an accredited university in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in an area of digital signal processing and Digital Communications

  • Proficiency with any of the following: MATLAB, C/C++, Python, VHDL

  • Experience with digital communication and/or DSP algorithms in hardware using FPGAs

  • Previous experience testing, fielding, or developing GNSS systems

  • Detailed understanding of GNSS architecture

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance Top-Secret level with SCI access. This process will begin after the start date.

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • PhD degree from an accredited university in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or another related field in an area of digital signal processing, GNSS positioning and navigation, alternative navigation techniques

  • Experience using GNURadio, USRPs, and the GNSS SDR

  • Proficiency working with and modeling for GNSS Simulators

  • Skill with RF lab equipment (spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, oscilloscopes)

  • Familiarity with Linux, Real-Time Operating Systems, and DevOps tools (Jira, Git, Jenkins)

  • Experience with Anomaly testing for GNSS hardware

  • Pervious experience interacting directly with government customers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$110,400.00 - $165,500.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

  • Operate Strategically
  • Lead Change
  • Engage with Impact
  • Foster Innovation
  • Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

  • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans

  • Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation

  • Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options

  • 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Variable pay program for exceptional contributions

  • Relocation assistance

  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career

  • Education assistance programs

  • An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . You can also review Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.

title: Circle K Rydsrondellen söker butikssäljare med servicekänsla!
description:
Vart är du på väg?

Nu söker vi butikssäljare – ja, alltså riktiga servicehjältar!

Vi vill bli världsbäst på service. Och därför söker vi nu fler servicehjältar. Vad gör en sådan? Jo, du möter våra kunders behov med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett härligt leende – ofta samtidigt som du kanske fyller på kaffemaskinen eller lägger upp en korv. För vi är en butikskedja som erbjuder allt från god mat och bakverk, till bra drivmedel och fräscha toaletter. Är du vår nästa talang? Då hittar du vänner för livet här på Circle K.

Vi söker dig som vill bli en i Teamet hos oss på Circle K Rydsrondellen i Skövde. Detta passar dig som vill jobba extra nu i höst, för att då komma in i jobbet, och för att sedan eventuellt gå på ett längre vikariat på 90% efter nyår.

Arbetstiderna kommer planeras efter behov, och rulla på 4 veckor, därefter kommer du att få ett rullande schema med större omfattning, och varierande tider. Då vi har öppet dygnet runt finns möjlighet att anpassa även detta schema till viss del. Ensamarbete förekommer. Efter nyår finns det stora möjligheter att stanna kvar, då nuvarande medarbetare planerar att studera.

Vi tillämpar kollektivavtal med Transportarbetarförbundet, och timlönen sätts utifrån tidigare erfarenhet. OB-tillägg tillkommer för arbete på helger, kvällar och nätter.

Vi vill att du bifogar CV och ett personligt brev med din ansökan, där du kortfattat redogör för ditt nuvarande arbetssituation, samt vad du söker. Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen, så sök omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 24.08.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas.
  • Du har kanske redan jobbat inom service eller så känner du att det är dags att testa!
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.

För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.

Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Senior Fullstackutvecklare på Nordens mest älskade digitala båtplattform
description:
Skippo driver Nordens mest älskade navigationsapp samt digital båtplattform, skippo.se, som används av närmare en miljon båtägare. Vårt mål är att radikalt förbättra och förenkla båtlivet för alla Nordens båtmänniskor och nu söker vi en senior utvecklare som vill vara med och bygga framtidens båttjänster.

I Norden är båtlivet ett unikt kulturarv med fler båtar per capita än någon annanstans i världen. Men trots en generellt hög digitaliseringsgrad har båtvärlden förblivit traditionell och analog - det håller vi med att ändra på!

Vårt mål är högt ställt - vi bygger nästa generations upplevelse för båtägare. Vi har ambitiösa planer vad gäller user experience, nya funktioner och tjänster som kan bidra till ett bättre, enklare, säkrare och mer inspirerande båtliv!

Inför säsongen 2026 expanderar vi nu och behöver stärka upp vårt produkt- och tech-team med ytterligare en grym senior utvecklare som har kapacitet att jobba brett med utveckling av nya fantastiska funktioner och produkter.

På Skippo blir du en del av ett tight team av utvecklare, produktägare, UX/UI designers och data engineers där det är högt till tak och varje insats räknas.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig:

  • Att du brinner för, och har förmågan att utifrån en design bygga fantastiska produkter som människor älskar. Tillsammans med våra andra utvecklare skall du ta till nästa nivå!

  • Förmågan att bidra till alla stadier av produktens livscykel: design, implementering, experimentering, testning, release och underhåll.

  • Förståelse för både teknik- och användarkrav och förmåga att samarbeta med olika stakeholders för att hitta bra lösningar.

  • Kunskap om modern arkitektur, systemdesign, datastrukturer och principer för mjukvaruteknik, och förståelse för hur dessa kan tillämpas att skapa skalbara och robusta lösningar.

  • Att du är självständig med att utveckla i React, Node Js, Wordpress och Java/Kotlin, samt har erfarenhet av GoogleCloud.

  • Självklart är det en stor bonus om du delar vår passion för båtlivet och/eller har erfarenhet av att bygga kart-/navigationstjänster.

Vad du kan förvänta dig av Skippo:

  • En chans att bidra till att radikalt förändra en industri som släpar efter digitalt.

  • Möjligheten att förbättra båtlivet för miljoner passionerade båtmänniskor.

  • En unik möjlighet att arbeta i en välfinansierad start-up som redan har en älskad produkt och fungerande verksamhet.

  • En samarbetsinriktad och effektiv arbetskultur med högt i tak, där varje åsikt räknas.

  • Bra och flexibla arbetsvillkor.

  • Men kanske framförallt ett roligt och innovativt företag med visionära ledare och drivna medarbetare.

Allra viktigast är att du och vi på Skippo kan bli en bra match. Vi är en bit på vägen med sjösättning av våra planer - ta chansen och kliv ombord!

Tveka inte att höra av dig till nesa@skippo.io, om du har några frågor eller funderingar. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Data Solutions Analyst
location: Buffalo, NY; Philadelphia, PA; Baltimore, MD; Wilmington, DE; Washington, DC; Bridgeport, CT
description:
Data Solutions Analyst (Regional Reporting Team)

Location: Buffalo, NY, Philadelphia, PA, Baltimore, MD, Wilmington, DE, Washington, DC, Bridgeport, CT

Remote Type: Hybrid Position

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

OVERVIEW:

Supports the development and delivery of data, reporting, and business intelligence solutions that enable informed decision-making across regional reporting and enterprise initiatives. Partners with Data Engineering and Data Visualization leads to acquire, transform, validate, and present data through scalable reporting assets, automated processes, and interactive dashboards.

Contributes to the modernization of reporting capabilities by supporting ETL development, report automation, data governance, and business intelligence initiatives that improve access to trusted, actionable insights.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compile, explore, transform, and validate data from multiple internal and external data sources for reporting and analytics purposes.
  • Develop, maintain, and document automated data workflows and reporting assets used across reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Perform data profiling, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to ensure accuracy and consistency of outputs.
  • Support data governance initiatives through documentation of data definitions, business rules, and transformation logic.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and visualizations. Partner with Data Visualization leads to ensure adherence to reporting standards, visualization best practices, and user experience expectations.
  • Support dashboard testing, deployment, enhancement, and ongoing maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate with business partners to understand reporting needs and support data-driven decision making. Translate business requirements into reporting solutions that provide actionable insights to business partners and leadership.
  • Assist with recurring and ad hoc reporting requests while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through automation.
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering lead and Data Visualization lead to deliver scalable and governed reporting solutions.
  • Share knowledge, document processes, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the team.
  • Provide support and training to stakeholders as needed.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
  • Promote an environment that supports diversity and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

title: Kjøkkenleder
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss🧑‍🍳

Som kjøkkenleder er du stjerna på vårt topp moderne kjøkkenet i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra til våre gjester. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater🤩


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på.


Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo
  • Har erfaring med kjøkkenledelse
  • Har en lidenskap for mat og gjesteopplevelser
  • Har kunnskap om IK-mat og HMS
  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢

title: Verksamhetsansvarig – vatten/avlopp, gata/väg
description:
Malå kommun är en vacker och framåt kommun i södra Lappland. Máláge kommuvdna, är en samisk förvaltningskommun.

Merparten av de boende är sysselsatta inom trä- och verkstadsindustri, georelaterad verksamhet, transportnäring och offentlig verksamhet. I kommunen finns en god offentlig service samt ett mångsidigt fritidsutbud.

Malå är ett bra alternativ för såväl barnfamiljer som företagare och industrier. Flera framgångsrika små och medelstora företag med väl utvecklade produkter, som säljs på världsmarknaden, skapar ett klimat med framtidstro.

Vår vision: Malå med allt så nära - en välkomnande och trygg kommun där utveckling sker.

Mer info finns på Malå kommuns hemsida: www.mala.se och www.nykommun.se/mala

Beskrivning

Tekniska enheten består av ett flertal verksamhetsområden med sammanlagt ca 40 medarbetare. Respektive verksamhetsområde har en verksamhetsansvarig med ansvar under teknisk chef. Vi söker nu en verksamhetsansvarig med inriktning mot Vatten-avlopp, och gator- vägar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som verksamhetsansvarig har du budgetansvar för din verksamhet. Du kommer även ansvara för inköp, projektering, arbetsledning, kundkontakter, planering och uppföljning, arbetsmiljöarbete, samt administration av externa entreprenörers uppdrag med hjälp av teknisk chef. Du är även behjälplig ute i fält tillsammans med dina medarbetare.

Även om arbetet i hög grad är självständigt och under eget ansvar jobbar vi som ett team. Vi söker dig som har förmåga att prioritera och driva processer framåt samt själv fatta beslut. Du är en naturlig ledare som trivs med att motivera andra.

Kvalifikationer

Du har en teknisk grundutbildning på lägst gymnasienivå, gärna högskolenivå, alternativt har du skaffat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom några år i likvärdigt arbete. Krav på lägst B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har ingenjörsutbildning med inriktning mot gator och vägar eller VA. Du har god datorvana och känner dig trygg med ekonomiska frågor och ekonomisystem. Erfarenhet av arbete inom en politiskt styrd organisation är också meriterande.

Eftersom vi använder geografiska informationssystem (GIS) i våra verksamheter är kunskaper inom CAD och GIS ytterligare meriterande.

Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga för rollen, då arbetet innebär många kontakter med både entreprenörer och kommunens medborgare. Eftersom vi är ett mindre arbetslag behöver du vara en person som trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö, samtidigt som du är självgående och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.

Vi ser gärna att du är lösningsorienterad, engagerad och har en vilja att utvecklas och lära dig mer i ditt arbete.

Övrigt

Provanställning kan bli aktuell.

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Ange gärna löneanspråk i din ansökan.

Vi håller löpande intervjuer under ansökningstiden så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!

Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer du att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen innan anställning.

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: AI Automation Engineer - 12-month contract
description:
About the Role Our client is an emerging trading firm with an exciting new opportunity for an AI Automation Engineer. At its core, this role will play a vital part in shaping the future development of comprehensive ML models and AI-integrated software to enhance efficiency across their entire trading operations. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with industry experts, software engineers, and researchers to guide the firm’s integration of advanced AI technologies-redefining the workday for traders and engineers alike.

Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and optimise low-latency batch and streaming inference pipelines that deliver continuously updated predictions derived from upstream training pipelines.
  • Integrate and fine-tune LLM-based conversational systems (e.g., GPT) to support front-office functions such as research query handling, data interrogation, and operational assistance.
  • Develop AI-driven tools to automate issue detection, classification, and triage, improving system reliability and reducing engineering overhead.
  • Collaborate closely with quant researchers, software engineers, traders, and platform teams to deliver robust and scalable AI solutions aligned with trading and business requirements.
  • Leverage accelerated computing (GPU/TPU) and optimised inference frameworks (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, CuDNN) to process high-frequency trading data streams and support predictive modelling at scale.
  • Continuously monitor, test, and retrain machine learning models to maintain performance, mitigate drift, and ensure optimal behaviour in live trading environments.
  • Develop and maintain high-performance model deployment infrastructure, including feature stores, monitoring systems, and model versioning tools.
  • Implement distributed training strategies to accelerate research workflows and support experimentation with larger or more complex model architectures.
  • Document architectures, best practices, and operational playbooks, ensuring clarity and maintainability for long-term production systems.

Core Technical Experience

  • 5-10+ years of experience in software engineering or machine learning, with practical exposure to both training and deploying AI/ML systems.
  • Strong programming capability in Python, with additional proficiency in C++, CUDA, C#, or Java highly valued.
  • Hands-on experience building and optimising real-time, low-latency ML or inference pipelines.
  • Expertise with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, NLP, and conversational AI, including use of OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar APIs.
  • Strong competency in GPU programming and optimisation, including tools such as CuDNN, TensorRT, or similar acceleration libraries.
  • Experience with distributed training and scaling ML workloads using frameworks like Horovod, NCCL, or DeepSpeed.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, RAG pipelines, and modern retrieval frameworks.
  • Solid experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerisation/ orchestration, e.g., Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead or contribute to complex, cross-functional technical projects.
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects in ML, data science, or distributed systems is a plus.
  • Passion for AI innovation, continuous learning, and practical experimentation with emerging technologies.
  • Strong communication skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

title: Staff Software Engineer/Tech Lead, ML Network Infrastructure

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. You will architect and build software for distributed services, abstractions, and the components of the system that operates and powers Google’s ML network infrastructure. You will be passionate about networking, control-plane software, and distributed systems, and enjoy working with both software and hardware across the full stack.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

  • Lead the technical strategy and architecture of next-generation control planes and software infrastructure for highly-available ML network fabrics.
