title: Partner, PR (Travel & Hospitality)
description:
We’re looking for a Partner to lead and grow our travel, hospitality, luxury and consumer practice in Singapore. You’ve spent 15 years or more in this business, a good chunk of it agency-side, so we won’t bore you with the usual JD. What matters is this: you know how to win work, you know how to keep clients close, and you know how to build a team that people actually want to stay on.

You’ll be building something, not inheriting it. FINN already has established travel and luxury teams across Greater China and the wider region — your job is to make Singapore the next chapter of that story. You’ll lead strategic communications and brand storytelling for a portfolio of hospitality, F&B, design and lifestyle clients, and you’ll go out and win more of them. You’ll report to our Founding Managing Partner & APAC Lead, working closely with our Managing Partners in Singapore and Greater China.

You are the commercial engine and the senior voice in the room — the person clients call first, and the one they call when something has gone sideways. You’ll help shape the strategy for the business and play a key part in hitting our profitability and growth targets: winning new clients, growing the ones we already have, and managing the budgets across your portfolio of accounts. You’ll shape pitches, negotiate scopes and contracts, and give the kind of counsel that protects a client’s reputation when the pressure is on.

You don’t need to have worked with every brand in the region (yet), but you do need the relationships, the instinct, and the drive to build a book of business from a strong base.

The team side of this job matters as much as the client side. You’ll coach your people, plan who works on what, and help them build their careers. We want you to build a team that does good work and treats both clients and each other with respect — that’s what our seven company values ask of us, and we hold each other to them.

Most importantly, we want someone who takes pride in their work and in their people. Someone who cares about craft, collaboration, and doing things properly — because “good enough” isn’t how we roll.

You will be someone who is
  • A confident business builder — prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing come naturally to you
  • Deeply fluent in travel, hospitality, luxury, lifestyle, F&B, and consumer brand storytelling
  • A strategic thinker who turns research and data into insight-driven, earned-first campaigns
  • Trusted at the C-suite table, and steady when the conversation turns to issues or crisis
  • Commercially sharp — forecasts, budgets, scopes, and profitability are yours to own
  • A generous leader and mentor who builds high-performing teams on a foundation of respect
  • Well-connected across regional media, influencer, and industry circles, and happy to be FINN’s face at events
  • Organised under pressure — you juggle several accounts and deadlines without dropping any of them
  • Curious about what’s next in communications, and quick to fold new tools and channels into the work
You likely have …
  • 15+ years in communications, with a significant portion of it in a PR agency
  • A book of business, or the relationships to build one, across travel, hospitality, luxury, or lifestyle
  • A track record of hitting growth and profitability targets across a portfolio of accounts
  • Experience leading integrated campaigns spanning earned, social, influencer, and brand
  • Strong resource planning, coaching, and team development instincts
  • Regional perspective — Singapore, Greater China, or wider APAC experience is a real plus
We’re committed to building a healthy, happy team, starting with:
  • 20 days of annual leave
  • FINN-ishing early once a month to rest, relax, and recharge
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Flexible working arrangements (in terms of hours, locations, and outfits)
  • A competitive salary and benefits package
  • A well-stocked pantry
  • Lots of fun, laughter, and love
About FINN Partners, Inc.
Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has grown from about $24 million in fees to almost $200 million in fees during the past 13 years, becoming one of the fastest-growing independent public relations agencies in the world. Recognized as one of Fast Company’s 2024 Most Innovative Companies, PRovoke Media’s 2024 Best Agency to Work For and 2022 Agency of the Year, the full-service marketing and communications company's record-setting pace results from organic growth and integrating new companies and new people into the FINN world through a common philosophy. With more than 1,300 professionals across 36 offices, FINN provides clients with global access and capabilities in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In addition, FINN provides its clients with access to top-tier agencies worldwide through its membership in the global network PROI.

Headquartered in New York, FINN has offices in: Abu Dhabi, Atlanta, Bangalore, Bangkok, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Delhi, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Fort Lauderdale, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Honolulu, Jerusalem, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Madison, Wisc., Manila, Mumbai, Munich, Nashville, Orange County, Paris, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Shanghai, Singapore, Vancouver, Washington D.C. and Yangon.

title: 2027 Investment Banking Analyst (Atlanta, GA)
description:
2027 Citizens Capital Markets & Advisory Program Analyst

Company Overview Citizens Financial Group, Inc. is one of the nation’s oldest and largest financial institutions, with $226.4 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. Headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island, Citizens provides a broad range of retail, private banking, wealth management, and commercial banking products and services to individuals, small businesses, middle-market companies, large corporations, and institutional clients. Capital Markets & Advisory (“CM&A) is Citizens’ full-service investment banking platform, offering a comprehensive product suite supported by deep sector expertise and a cohesive coverage model.

Program Overview Citizens Bank is seeking Investment Banking Analysts to join the Capital Markets & Advisory (“CM&A”) team. Analysts work closely with the team’s junior and senior professionals preparing, analyzing, and executing investment banking related transactions, primarily within the U.S. middle market.

Analysts are assigned to active and prospective engagement teams across multiple industries within our core areas of focus and have the opportunity to grow professionally in a fast-paced environment.

Opportunities Within CM&A, bankers are organized into four core groups: Industry Coverage, Leveraged Capital Markets, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Equity Capital Markets.

  • Industry Coverage: Industry Coverage (Corporate Finance) bankers originate and execute debt, M&A, and equity transactions across specific industry sectors through capital raising and strategic advisory solutions and work closely with the M&A and Leveraged Capital Markets teams to execute business.

  • Leveraged Capital Markets (“LCM”): Internally referred to as Debt Capital Markets, the Leveraged Capital Markets team focuses on the origination, structuring, and execution of finance transactions for corporate and financial sponsor clients, with a concentration on middle-market credits.

  • Mergers & Acquisitions (“M&A”): M&A bankers provide sell-side and buy-side advisory services for middle market corporate and sponsor clients.

  • Equity Capital Markets (“ECM”): ECM bankers support the execution of equity financing transactions, helping companies raise capital through offerings such as initial public offerings (IPOs), follow-on equity offerings, convertible securities, and share repurchase programs.

Analysts are aligned with specific groups and potentially organized further by sector coverage. Availability of each group and sector varies by office location (see below).

Atlanta, GA Industry Coverage (Financial Institutions)

Mergers & Acquisitions (Human Capital Management; Commercial & Industrial Svcs; Transportation & Logistics; Software; Healthcare)

Boston, MA Industry Coverage (Transportation & Logistics; Industrial & Infrastructure Svcs; Healthcare Svcs)

Leveraged Capital Markets (Healthcare; Financial Institutions; Aerospace, Defense & Government Svcs; Transportation & Logistics; Consumer & Retail; Real Estate, Gaming, Lodging & Leisure; Technology, Media & Telecom; Energy, Power & Chemicals)

Charlotte, NC Industry Coverage (Aerospace, Defense & Government Svcs; Industrial Equipment & Distribution; Commercial & Residential Svcs; Financial Institutions; Communications)

Mergers & Acquisitions (Consumer, Franchise & Restaurant)

New York, NY Industry Coverage (Healthcare; Gaming & Leisure)

Equity Capital Markets (ECM)

San Francisco, CA Industry Coverage (Technology; Real Estate)

Responsibilities Shared responsibilities across all CM&A functions include:

  • Financial Analysis: Financial modeling, comparable company and transaction analyses, leveraged buyout, and other valuation analyses.
  • Preparing Information Memoranda and Transaction Documents: Draft key marketing and transaction-related documents.
  • Supporting Team Members: Develop new business ideas, pitch strategies, or transaction structuring scenarios to help clients achieve their strategic objectives.
  • Preparing Pitch/Business Origination Materials and Presentations: Develop and assemble pitches and presentations and be an integral part of delivering these presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current students enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, graduating between Winter 2026– Spring 2027

  • Minimum GPA of 3.2; Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.5

    • Please include your cumulative GPA on your resume.

  • Relevant work experience, leadership experience and coursework in Finance, Accounting or Economics is preferred but all majors will be considered.

  • Strong analytical skills and software skills: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) proficiency is required.

  • Candidates must currently be a U.S. Resident to be eligible for this program.

    • Please note that U.S. Immigration sponsorship or work visa is not available for intern / full-time Analyst positions and candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the U.S.

Preferred Skills and Attributes

  • Intelligent, resourceful, professional, clear communicator, excellent attention to detail, self-starter, intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, team player, high degree of humility, maturity, and integrity, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, efficient, adaptable, and strategic in time-sensitive situations, leadership.

Application & Interview Process

  • Successfully complete a video interview assessment within 4 days of receiving the link. If not completed within the timeframe, your application will be automatically withdrawn from consideration.

Additional Resources

Click here for more information about our programs and application process:

Pay Transparency

The position offers $110,000 annually, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Careers Coach - EOI
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£29,000 to £30,000

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!

This role is office based, but will involve travel across County Durham also.

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Internal applications for this role close on 21/08/2026.

Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. A Careers Coach is also responsible for conducting outreach in the community, building relationships with referral partners (DWP/JCP), and attending local events (e.g. job fairs) to generate referrals. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.

  • Providing support with CV preparation, job-searching, and interview skills.

  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.

  • Facilitating group training courses and workshops according to their needs.

  • Employer engagement and stakeholder management with the JCP.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

  • Reed Pension Scheme

  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training

  • Professional & Personal Development Funds

  • Bi-annual pay reviews

  • Plus much more that can be found on our website

  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Attainments

  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)

  • Experience of working in a performance target driven environment

  • Willingness to travel locally, and access to own vehicle (e.g. to meet customers/employers).

  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.

  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification).

Desirable Attainments:

  • Experience of working in a fast-paced environment. Examples of such experience may include working as a Holiday Representative or Recruitment Consultant, etc.

  • Experience of and exposure to client groups. These client groups may include incapacity benefit claimants, single parents, those with criminal records, mental health groups, ex-services, specific ethnic minority or faith groups and those with specific disabilities.

  • Direct previous experience of a similar role. Roles considered to be similar include the role of Employment Adviser on a welfare to work contract or a publicly funded service.

  • Degree or relevant qualification. Degree topics may include psychology, sociology, and social care/science. Relevant qualifications would include Information Advice and Guidance NVQs, Brokerage Standard, Social Work qualifications or qualifications relating to work with the specific client groups this role will involve

  • Level 3 or 4 NVQ in Advice & Guidance or Education & Training

  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (Dependent on programme).

  • Technical skills include the ability to use technology to deliver results and knowledge of welfare/benefits system

  • Personal interests include interest in career and self-development.

  • Experience of coaching and/or training

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

title: Produksjonsansvarlig Nordic Seal AS
description:
Om Nordic Seal AS

Nordic Seal AS utvikler, produserer og leverer spesialtilpassede tetningsløsninger til krevende industrielle anvendelser over hele verden. Fra hovedkontoret og produksjonen i Larvik betjener selskapet kunder innen blant annet papirindustri, prosessindustri og annen teknisk krevende industri, og er alene i verden på enkelte av teknologiene de tilbyr. Nordic Seal AS er en del av det finske industrikonsernet Etola Group gjennom morselskapet Tiivistetekniikka Oy, noe som gir virksomheten et solid internasjonalt fundament kombinert med lokal handlekraft og korte beslutningsveier

Selskapet er ISO 9001-sertifisert og kvalifisert gjennom Achilles.

Som en liten og spesialisert virksomhet preges hverdagen av høy fagkompetanse, tett samarbeid og stor grad av selvstendighet. Nå søker vi en produksjonsansvarlig som ønsker en nøkkelrolle i et selskap med unike produkter, internasjonale kunder og gode muligheter til å påvirke videre utvikling og vekst.

Om stillingen

Vi ser etter en erfaren og selvstendig person som trives med praktisk produksjonsarbeid, tekniske problemstillinger og ansvar for egen arbeidshverdag. Rollen passer for deg som liker å ha kontroll på detaljer, arbeider strukturert og motiveres av å levere høy kvalitet.

I et lite selskap er den enkelte medarbeider ekstra viktig. Derfor legger vi stor vekt på at du er lojal, pålitelig og tar eierskap til oppgavene dine. Du må være komfortabel med å jobbe selvstendig, samtidig som du samarbeider godt med kollegaer, kunder og leverandører.

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver

  • Produksjon av tetninger og spesialtilpassede produkter

  • Lese og følge tekniske tegninger og produksjonsdokumentasjon

  • Sikre kvalitet, presisjon og effektiv produksjon

  • Bidra til forbedringsarbeid og utvikling av produksjonsprosesser

  • Delta i tekniske vurderinger, produktutvikling og innkjøp ved behov

Typisk bakgrunn og kompetanse

  • Vi tror du har erfaring fra mekanisk industri, produksjonsvirksomhet eller annen teknisk rolle hvor nøyaktighet og kvalitet er avgjørende.

    Aktuelle bakgrunner kan være:

    • Mekaniker

    • Fagarbeider innen industri eller produksjon

    • Produksjonsmedarbeider med teknisk ansvar

    • Teknisk tegner eller person med erfaring fra teknisk dokumentasjon

    • Ingeniør med praktisk interesse og produksjonsforståelse

    Det viktigste er ikke formell utdanning, men teknisk forståelse, nøyaktighet og evnen til å lære nye produkter og prosesser

Egenskaper vi verdsetter

  • Du tar ansvar og eierskap til eget arbeid

  • Du er nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst

  • Du har teknisk interesse og forståelse

  • Du er strukturert og selvstendig

  • Du trives med stor frihet under ansvar

  • Du er løsningsorientert og praktisk anlagt

  • Du samarbeider godt med andre

  • Du er lojal og til å stole på

  • Du er komfortabel med å jobbe alene i perioder

  • Du bidrar med initiativ og forbedringsforslag

Hvorfor velge Nordic Seal AS

Hos Nordic Seal AS får du en sentral rolle i et lite og spesialisert selskap hvor din innsats har stor betydning. Du får stor grad av frihet til å planlegge egen arbeidshverdag og muligheten til å påvirke hvordan produksjonen utvikles videre.

Du blir en del av et selskap med internasjonal kundebase, anerkjente produkter og spennende vekstmuligheter. Samtidig får du en variert arbeidshverdag med kombinasjonen av praktisk håndverk, tekniske utfordringer og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid.

Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Nysgjerrig og vil vite mer?

Ta kontakt med vår samarbeidspartner Skagerak Consulting AS, ved Linda Brusletto 41676428 eller Cathrine Svendsen 92606610.

Alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest

Søknad med CV registreres i vårt digitale søknadssystem så snart som mulig.

Skagerak Consulting er et tverrfaglig miljø innen rekruttering og rådgivning. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

title: IT-chef till SSG
description:
Vill du leda en IT-verksamhet där du får kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med djup inom IT och teknik? Nu söker vi en IT-chef som vill ta ett samlat ansvar för infrastruktur, arkitektur och utveckling och som drivs av att skapa moderna, stabila och verksamhetsnära IT-lösningar. Här får du en nyckelroll med stort inflytande över både riktning, kultur och teknisk utveckling.

På SSG utvecklar vi digitala lösningar och tjänster som hjälper industrin att arbeta säkrare, smartare och mer hållbart. Nu står vi inför en strategisk förflyttning där vi går från att arbeta i separata delar till att bygga en gemensam och skalbar plattform med nya tjänster, affärsmöjligheter och möjligheter att växa internationellt.

Om rollen

Som IT-chef har du ett övergripande ansvar för hela IT-leveransen, från infrastruktur och drift till arkitektur och systemutveckling och leder en organisation med cirka 55 medarbetare. Du ansvarar för flera kompetensområden och säkerställer att de tillsammans möjliggör att både interna IT-miljöer och SSGs kundprodukter kan utvecklas och förvaltas på ett ändamålsenligt, kostnadseffektivt och långsiktigt hållbart sätt som stödjer verksamhetens mål.

Rollen innebär att du sätter den strategiska riktningen för IT, samtidigt som du tillsammans med gruppcheferna inom IT driver, coachar- och följer upp verksamhetens arbete på individ, team och avdelningsnivå. I ditt ansvar ingår att skapa förutsättningar för olika roller att fortsätta utveckla den tekniska plattformen och arkitekturen såväl som det teambaserade arbetssättet.

Du har ett nära samarbete med verksamheten och produktledningen där du omsätter behov till tekniska möjligheter, förankrar behov av tekniska förflyttningar och säkerställer att IT bidrar till affärsnytta. Rollen innebär även ansvar för leverantörer och partners samt att ständigt driva förbättringsarbete, prioriteringar och investeringar inom IT-området.

Som ledare har du ansvar för utvecklings- och infrateam och leder genom specialister och andra ledare. Du arbetar aktivt med att bygga en sammanhållen organisation där samverkan mellan avdelningarna på SSG såväl som inom IT är central. Du skapar struktur, riktning och engagemang, och säkerställer tillsammans med gruppcheferna att organisationen har förmågor som möter både dagens och morgondagens behov. Du ingår i ledningsgruppen och rapporterar till VD, vilket ger dig en central roll i att forma verksamhetens riktning tillsammans med övriga i ledningen.

Placeringsort är Sundsvall.

Vem är du

Vi ser att du har en relevant akademisk utbildning, alternativt annan utbildning och erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du är en erfaren ledare med god förståelse för hela IT-landskapet, där du har en teknisk grund att stå på, oavsett om den kommer från infrastruktur, utveckling eller arkitektur. Vidare har du förmågan att se helheten och skapa balans mellan stabil drift, långsiktig teknisk riktning och snabb teambaserad utveckling.

Som person är du trygg i ditt ledarskap och van att leda genom andra, samtidigt som du har tillräckligt tekniskt djup för att kunna utmana, prioritera och fatta välgrundade beslut. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi och operativa frågor, där du bygger broar mellan teknik och verksamhet samt kan agera förändringsledare. Du är kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande, med förmåga att skapa engagemang och tydlighet i komplexa miljöer. Du drivs av utveckling, både av människor, organisation och teknik och ser värdet i att arbeta strukturerat, långsiktigt och med ständiga förbättringar.

Vad SSG kan erbjuda dig

SSG är i en stark tillväxtfas och du blir en viktig del av det strategiska arbetet. Vi erbjuder dig ett variationsrikt arbete med tekniker i framkant där du får vara en del av både utveckling och utmaningar. Vi arbetar i agila tvärfunktionella produktteam och har korta beslutsvägar med stor möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen inom respektive ansvarsområde.

Förmåner för dig som medarbetare hos SSG:

  • Modernt kontor med egna arbetsplatser
  • Inspirerande mötesytor med studio, arkadspel och en 3D-printer
  • Inkluderande arbetsmiljö med god gemenskap och en hållbar prestationskultur
  • Kompetensutveckling på arbetstid
  • Friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsbidrag samt möjlighet till innebandy, gruppträning och padel med kollegorna
  • Arbetstidsförkortning med lediga dagar och sommar-/vintertid
  • Privat sjukvårdsförsäkring
  • Tjänstepension ITP1 och kollektivavtal
  • Vinstdelning när det går bra för SSG

Om SSG

I över 60 års tid har SSG samlat svensk industris främsta experter i kommittéer och nätverk för att hitta lösningar på branschens gemensamma utmaningar. Bland våra kunder finns över 400 av de största internationella industriföretagen, mer än 50 000 entreprenörsbolag och vi levererar cirka 500 000 digitala säkerhetsutbildningar - varje år.

Vi välkomnar framtidens utmaningar och möjligheter. Med innovativ teknik lägger vi grunden för nya tjänster som gör internationell industri konkurrenskraftig.

Kontakt

Vi samarbetar med Jefferson Wells i denna rekrytering. Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Karin Frisendahl eller Mats Andersson.

Mats Andersson: 070-8543042, mats.andersson@jeffersonwells.se Karin Frisendahl: 070-3774546, karin.frisendahl@jeffersonwells.se.

Din ansökan vill vi ha via länken nedan senast den 16 augusti.

title: Lead AI Business Consultant
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

What's the Role All About?

The LeadAI Business Consultant, is a pivotal role within our Customer Services Automation AI Center of Excellence.As NICE scales AI adoption across its global enterprise customer base, this role serves as a core execution and insight engine within the AI Center of Excellence. You will work across regions to ensure AI solutions move beyond deployment into trusted, sustained, and value-generating usage.

How Will You Make an Impact?

  • Drive AI Adoption and Stabilization
  • Support AI adoption and post-deployment stabilization for a global portfolio of enterprise customers.
  • Execute adoption playbooks in partnership with regional consultants across Australia and NZ.
  • Lead reinforcement activities that drive sustained usage, trust, and behavioural change.
  • Optimize AI Performance
  • Provide hands on optimization of AI outputs, including prompt engineering, knowledge alignment, and workflow tuning.
  • Support Behavioural UAT by validating user acceptance, workflow fit, and AI trust indicators.
  • Identify early adoption risks and corrective actions using usage, operational, and behavioural data.
  • Analyze and Operationalize Insights
  • Analyze AI usage patterns, contact center KPIs, and operational signals to surface optimization opportunities.
  • Build adoption scorecards and insight summaries used by customer-facing teams and internal leadership.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations that improve efficiency, quality, and AI ROI.
  • Partner and Lead Without Authority
  • Partner closely with regional consultants, delivery teams, and operations leaders to drive aligned execution.
  • Lead remote working sessions with supervisors and operations teams to reinforce best practices.
  • Surface recurring adoption challenges and structured product feedback to internal teams.

What makes this role compelling

  • Global exposure across enterprise customers in multiple regions
  • Deep hands on experience with AI adoption, not just deployment
  • Real ownership of outcomes, not just deliverables
  • High visibility within a global AI Center of Excellence
  • Clear path toward senior consulting, principal, or specialist AI roles

Have You Got What It Takes?

  • 10 plus years of experience in CCaaS consulting, CX operations, AI-enabled self-service, or related domains
  • Strong understanding of contact center KPIs and operational workflows
  • Hands on experience with conversational AI, agent assist, summarization, or automation solutions
  • Practical experience using prompt engineering to improve generative AI performance
  • Strong analytical skills with comfort interpreting trends across large datasets
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with global stakeholders
  • Experience supporting enterprise or global customers is strongly preferred
  • Excellent verbal, written communication, and presentation skills are a must.

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face to face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

title: Junior snickare/hantverkare
description:
Nator Personal

Vill du vara med och bygga framtiden? Vi söker nu nya medarbetare som vill ansluta till vårt team av hantverkare. Idag är vi ett 30-tal medarbetare på Nator Personal som arbetar som anläggare och snickare. Att arbeta tillsammans med oss ska vara enkelt, att skapa bra relationer med våra medarbetare och kunder är och har varit nyckeln till vår framgång. Är du en person som brinner för service och är lösningsorienterad i ditt arbete är vi rätt arbetsgivare för dig.

Tjänsten

Som snickare hos oss kommer ingen dag vara den andra lik då vi har många olika kunder med olika typer av projekt. På Nator Personal är vi ett team och vi arbetar tillsammans, därför är det viktigt att du trivs att arbeta i team. Arbetet är främst förlagt i Stockholmsområdet, arbetstider är 7–16, mån-fre, 40h i veckan. Start enligt ö.k.

Kvalifikationer

Vi tror du har minst 1 års erfarenhet av liknande arbete eller erfarenhet från studier inom bygg. Det viktigaste är att du är flexibel, öppen för nya utmaningar och vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Som person är du en lagspelare som gillar att ta för dig på arbetsplatsen. Du känner stort ansvar och stolthet i det arbete du levererar. I övrigt är du punktlig, pålitlig och bidrar med ett gott humör på arbetsplatsen. Det är ett krav att kunna kommunicera bra på svenska eller engelska.

Du erbjuds

  • En trygg arbetsgivare som är mån om ditt mående
  • Lön enligt kollektivavtal
  • Tillsvidareanställning med tillämpad provanställning första 6 månaderna

Ansökan

Denna rekrytering sker löpande vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta alexander.ytterberg@nator.se

title: Servitør heltid
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Arbeidsted vil vare på Sabrura Triaden på Lørenskog og på Sabrura i Lillestrøm.

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss😎

Som servitør er du stjerna på gulvet i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater.


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på🤩


Det er en fordel dersom du:

    • Har erfaring fra restaurant eller service
    • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
    • Har en lidenskap for salg og gjesteopplevelser

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.


Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢


Har du spørsmål er du hjertelig velkommen til å kontakt med daglig leder Charlotta Kval +4794401461 Charlotta.kval@sabrurasushi.no

title: Säljare
description:
Vill du arbeta med försäljning och skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer? Vi söker nu en engagerad säljare till vårt team. Som medarbetare hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom försäljning, arbeta med affärsutveckling samt bidra till företagets framgång.

  • Grundläggande datorkunskaper och erfarenhet av CRM-system är ett plus.
  • Krav körkort: B

Vad vi erbjuder inom försäljning och karriärutveckling

title: Senior Sustainability Expert - Customer Engineering
description:
Sweep is hiring a Senior Platform & Sustainability Expert, playing an important role in how Sweep helps organisations across the world navigate their sustainability journey.

Working as part of our Customer Engineering team and alongside our Delivery team, you will bring strong sustainability knowledge to the moments that matter most; sharpening the advice our teams can give, strengthening the confidence of our customers, and helping our customers move further, faster on their sustainability programmes.

This role sits at the heart of Sweep's customer-facing organisation, collaborating closely with Delivery, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams. You will act as a multiplier: someone whose knowledge, curiosity, and judgment helps elevate the work of those around them. You will work with a diverse range of customers; from those just beginning their sustainability journey to those with established programmes and specialist teams in place. In all cases, your role is to meet them where they are: providing practical sustainability guidance and reassurance that helps them move forward with confidence.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who has built solid sustainability expertise and is ready to apply it in a more varied, scalable, and technology-enabled environment. You will contribute your expertise internally, engage credibly with customers' ESG teams, and play an active part in how Sweep continues to evolve its customer experience, content, and product offering.

To be more specific, this includes:

1. Enabling & Amplifying Your Colleagues 🔬

  • Serve as a key internal sustainability reference within the Customer Engineering team, supporting Platform & Sustainability Experts in our Delivery team to tackle complex customer questions with confidence; including reviewing outputs and providing clear & actionable guidance before and during engagements.

  • Take ownership of continuous internal sustainability enablement; running regular sessions, updates, and training to keep the Delivery team current on regulatory developments, evolving methodologies, and emerging customer questions.

  • Build and maintain practical internal knowledge resources; regulatory summaries, guidance notes, Q&A banks; that allow the wider team to act quickly and accurately.

  • Contribute sustainability expertise to wider Sweep teams; including Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Support; as relevant.

2.Customer & Partner Advisory 🌱

  • Be deployed directly with customers across their lifecycle; from presales through implementation and into long-term partnership; to provide ad-hoc sustainability guidance at the moments it's needed most.

  • Offer a knowledgeable, reassuring presence on methodology and reporting questions: helping customers validate their approach, navigate specific challenges, and move forward with confidence; without taking over their sustainability programme.

  • Support long-term customers as the regulatory landscape evolves, providing timely, practical input that helps them stay on track.

  • Act as a sparring partner for Sweep's certified consultant network when relevant; a resource they can lean on for sustainability methodology questions as they work with customers.

3. Presales & Commercial Support 💼

  • Be brought into presales processes where sustainability depth matters; particularly for sophisticated prospects who want to stress-test Sweep's credentials.

  • Work closely with regional Delivery Managers to support presales activity, helping articulate and bring to life the sustainability expertise and guidance customers can expect throughout their journey with Sweep.

  • Help commercial teams articulate how Sweep supports real sustainability outcomes, translating product capabilities into the language of various stakeholders in our customer organisations.

  • Serve as a key internal stakeholder on proposals and RFPs, contributing sustainability expertise to support the teams driving those processes.

4. Product, Knowledge & Scalable Customer Education 🔧

  • Develop strong working knowledge of the Sweep platform; enough to speak confidently about how its capabilities address real sustainability challenges, and to bridge the gap between customer needs and platform configuration.

  • Design, create, and maintain 1-to-many sustainability content for customers: including e-learning modules, webinars, structured training sessions, and written resources that help customers and their teams build sustainability knowledge at scale.

  • Help ensure this content stays current as regulations, frameworks, and best practices evolve; making Sweep's sustainability education practical, relevant, and easy to use.

  • Channel insights from customer conversations and the external sustainability landscape into Sweep's Product team, helping inform roadmap discussions in line with regulatory developments and market expectations.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully across all dimensions of the role; from research and content creation to knowledge management and customer preparation; to increase the reach and quality of your work.

That sounds just right for me. What do I need to bring?

Glad you asked. This is who we’re looking for:

Qualifications 🏆

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in a sustainability-focused role, ideally spanning consulting, advisory, customer-facing work, or sustainability technology

  • Strong working knowledge of carbon accounting and product carbon footprint and how it is evolving; including but not limited to GHG Protocol, scope 3 methodologies, data quality and assurance; with a clear understanding of the practical data challenges these create for organisations

  • Strong applied understanding of science-based targets (SBTi) and corporate climate transition planning, and what their implementation means in practice for companies managing complex data environments

  • Solid and applied understanding of voluntary reporting frameworks (CDP, GRI, TCFD) and key regulatory frameworks, such as:

    • CSRD (ESRS, VSME, DMA development)

    • ISSB / IFRS S1 & S2

    • US frameworks (SB 261, SB 253)

    • UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UKSRS)

    • Other evolving global standards

    • ...including a strong grasp of the underlying data requirements and challenges these frameworks impose on organisations

    • Experience explaining complex sustainability topics clearly and credibly to varied audiences; from data owners and sustainability managers to senior stakeholders

    • Genuine curiosity about technology and a willingness to develop strong working fluency with Sweep's platform as a tool for enabling customer sustainability programmes

    • Confidence using AI tools across different dimensions of work; from research and content creation to knowledge sharing and customer preparation

    • Excellent written and spoken English. French is a very strong plus

Qualities 🧠

  • Thrive in a varied, fast-paced role; you're energised by the breadth of this position, comfortable switching context across different customers, teams, and topics, and see that variety as one of its greatest strengths

  • Are genuine sustainability experts who stay actively engaged with a fast-evolving field; and who enjoy sharing what they know

  • See enabling others as a core part of their impact, and take satisfaction in the success of a team as much as their own individual contribution

  • Are comfortable and credible in front of a wide range of stakeholders with varying levels of sustainability maturity; from teams just starting out to seasoned ESG professionals

  • Know how to translate deep expertise into practical, grounded guidance; not just citing frameworks, but helping people understand what to actually do

  • Thrive in a cross-functional environment, working fluidly across Delivery, Presales, Product, Customer Success, and Support to get the best outcome for customers

  • Are particularly drawn to the idea of applying their sustainability expertise in a more scalable, technology-enabled way; combining customer guidance, enablement, content creation, and product collaboration in a single role

  • Are committed to Sweep's mission of helping organisations build credible, meaningful sustainability programmes; and are motivated by the idea of doing that at scale

At Sweep, artificial intelligence is part of how we work, learn, and build. Every team member uses AI tools daily to speed up operations, improve decision making, and unlock creativity. We don’t expect you to be an expert on day one, but we do expect curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the desire to use AI as a true partner in your work.

Whether it's analyzing information, drafting content, improving workflows, designing better employee experiences, or supporting distributed teams, you’ll use AI to work faster and smarter. We provide guidance, tools, and best practices so you can get the most out of it.

We’re looking for candidates who already have hands-on experience with AI tools in a professional setting. You should be comfortable using AI to support your daily work, enhance productivity, and create new solutions. If you naturally reach for AI to amplify what you do, you’ll feel right at home here.

Copy that. And what’s in it for me?

You will be joining an exciting young business that has the humble ambition to change the world. With a proven track record in starting companies, we’re planning to hit the ground running and have an impact fast. Joining this journey right at the beginning allows you to really help shape our path.

Our hybrid work model, with hiring focussed around our head offices in Paris, London, Montpellier and Denver, allows us to balance our personal and professional lives while staying connected and engaged with colleagues and clients.

We’re big believers in creating successful businesses that are good for everyone, including society and the planet. That’s why we have a B Corporation status.

We think this will be the ride of our lives. And maybe yours, too.

title: Senior Data Scientist I
description:
About Chubb

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 43,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: .

About Chubb India

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

Position Details:

  • Function/Department: Advanced Analytics
  • Location: Bangalore, India
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Role Overview – Senior Data Scientist

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist for the Advanced Analytics team, who will be at the forefront of developing new innovative data driven solutions with cutting edge machine learning algorithms. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build machine learning models, perform quantitative data analysis to enable organizational decision making and develop solutions to complex business problems and create value for the business. This position offers exposure to a wide variety of analytics tools and technologies as well as unique challenges in problem-solving. Building and deploying predictive models in support of our pricing strategy will be a focus area. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in statistical modelling, machine learning, and data analysis. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to extract insights from complex data sets, develop predictive models, and implement innovative solutions that enhance business performance.

Responsibilities

  • Work with business partners globally, manage deliverables against timelines, presentation of results and implement the model.

  • Synthesize data to uncover inherent trends, assess impact of data on business usage, and to make recommendations for improvement.

  • Build GLM pricing models/machine learning models in support of various property and casualty insurance products.

  • Research, recommend, and implement statistical and other mathematical methodologies appropriate for the given business problem.

  • Build explanatory and forecasting models using descriptive and inferential statistics, and regression analysis.

  • Perform data validation, preprocessing, and exploratory data analyses.

  • Communicates analytical goals, approaches, outcomes, and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Collaborate with business partners and peers within the organization to understand and scope the problem, gather business requirements, and develop robust model solutions that drive improvement in key business metrics.

  • Effectively communicate with key stakeholders (both technical and non-technical) in written, oral and presentation formats.

  • Create/Maintain excellent working relationships with business partners across the Chubb organization including Product, Actuarial, IT, and analytics peer groups.

  • Develop adaptable modelling frameworks and reusable assets that can be applied across various projects.

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, or Computer Science is preferred.

  • Sound understanding of ML concepts/ Probabilistic Models, Supervised / Unsupervised Learning, Ensemble Techniques, Hyperparameter Good knowledge of constraint Optimization, and Deep Learning; Strong experience in developing and maintaining machine learning models/sound knowledge of GLM, Regression/ Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM, Clustering, building data pipelines in Azure/Databricks.

  • Proficient in Python/Pyspark with strong capabilities in data analysis/modelling.

  • Proficient in Python fundamentals, OOP and design patterns, Packaging and environment management: pip, virtualenv/conda, setuptools, Git workflow, branching, PRs

  • Explore data and communicate insights clearly to non-technical as well as technical audience.

  • Expertise in python machine learning tools and libraries (scikit-learn, h2o, R/MLlib or similar etc.)

  • 4-6 years of work experience in building models is required.

  • Desirable to have knowledge/ experience in big data technologies

  • Must have strong problem-solving skills.

  • Should be adept at research and must look to apply new methodologies to varied situations.

  • Experience in Actuarial Science and Insurance will be an advantage.

  • Must possess an advanced degree in engineering/computer sciences/data science/business analytics/statistics/mathematics or passed actuarial exams.

Why Chubb?

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

  • Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence

  • Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results

  • Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter

  • Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

title: Lead Piping Material Engineer
description:
Rejlers International Engineering Solutions is recognized for delivering reliable engineering and project services. With over 15 years in Abu Dhabi, UAE, our regional headquarters are based in Abu Dhabi City, and we also have an office in Navi Mumbai, India, supporting diverse operations throughout the area. We specialize in industries such as Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemical, Chemical, Renewable Energy, and Industrial Infrastructure—including Buildings, Power Distribution, and Telecommunications—serving clients across the UAE and Arabian Gulf.

Our expertise in Industrial Digitization and AI solutions demonstrates our dedication to technological innovation and excellence. Backed by a parent company with over 80 years of engineering experience, we proudly bring Nordic engineering traditions to the region, combining advanced technology with a legacy of quality and reliability.

We are now looking for Lead Piping Material Engineer to execute projects and support bids in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Reports To

The Lead Piping Material Engineer reports to Head of Discipline - Mechanical & Piping.

Job Overview

The Lead Piping Material Engineer is responsible for leading the design, engineering, review, and technical assurance of all static equipment activities for ADNOC and EPC projects. The role ensures that engineering deliverables comply with ADNOC standards, international codes, project specifications, safety requirements, and quality objectives throughout the project lifecycle, including Conceptual, FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, Commissioning, and Start-up phases.

The incumbent serves as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for piping materials and corrosion management, providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams and ensuring safe, reliable, and cost-effective material selection throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Design

  • Develop and maintain Piping Material Specifications (PMS), Piping Classes, and Material Requisitions.

  • Prepare and review material selection reports based on process conditions, corrosion studies, and operating requirements.

  • Define piping material requirements considering:

    • Design pressure and temperature

    • Corrosion and erosion resistance

    • Sour service requirements

    • H2S/CO2 environments

    • Offshore environmental conditions

  • Prepare Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE) for piping materials.

  • Review P&IDs, Line Lists, Process Data Sheets, and Equipment Data Sheets.

  • Ensure compliance with:

    • ASME B31.3, B31.4, B31.8

    • ASME Section II & VIII

    • ASTM Material Standards

    • API Standards

    • NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156

    • Shell DEP

    • Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES)

    • ADNOC Specifications

    • KOC Standards

Material Selection & Corrosion Management

  • Perform material selection studies for:

    • Carbon Steel

    • Low Alloy Steel

    • Stainless Steel

    • Duplex Stainless Steel

    • Super Duplex

    • Nickel Alloys

    • CRA Materials

    • GRE/GRP Systems

  • Conduct corrosion assessments and mitigation strategies.

  • Review corrosion loops and corrosion monitoring requirements.

  • Participate in HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, and Design Reviews.

  • Evaluate corrosion allowances and internal/external coating systems.

Procurement Support

  • Prepare Material Requisitions (MR).

  • Review vendor offers and perform technical bid evaluations.

  • Resolve technical queries from suppliers and contractors.

  • Review Manufacturer Data Records (MDR), MTCs, and compliance documentation.

  • Support procurement in vendor qualification and selection.

Project Execution

  • Coordinate with Process, Mechanical, Pipeline, Stress, Layout, and Procurement disciplines.

  • Support EPC, FEED, Detailed Engineering, and Brownfield Projects.

  • Review engineering deliverables from contractors and vendors.

  • Participate in project review meetings and technical workshops.

  • Ensure material standardization and optimization across projects.

Construction & Commissioning Support

  • Provide technical support during construction and site installation.

  • Review material substitutions and concession requests.

  • Resolve site technical queries and non-conformance reports (NCRs).

  • Support hydrotesting, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities.

  • Participate in Mechanical Completion and System Handover.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with project specifications and client requirements.

  • Review Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).

  • Support QA/QC activities related to piping materials.

  • Participate in audits, technical assessments, and lessons learned sessions.

  • Ensure compliance with HSE and company quality management systems.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor junior and intermediate piping material engineers.

  • Lead discipline engineering activities and design reviews.

  • Develop engineering procedures, work instructions, and best practices.

  • Provide technical guidance to project teams and stakeholders.

ADNOC / Shell / Aramco / KOC Specific Experience

ADNOC

  • ADNOC Onshore, Offshore, Gas Processing, LNG, and Refining projects.

  • Familiarity with ADNOC Engineering Standards and Specifications.

  • Experience in Brownfield modifications and live plant projects.

Shell

  • Application of Shell DEP standards.

  • Experience in Material Selection Diagrams (MSD).

  • Knowledge of Shell corrosion management philosophy.

Saudi Aramco

  • Expertise in:

    • SAES

    • SAMSS

    • SABP

    • SAIP

  • Experience with sour service material requirements.

  • Knowledge of Aramco approved material systems and vendor requirements.

Kuwait Oil Company (KOC)

  • Familiarity with KOC Engineering Standards.

  • Experience in gathering centers, flowlines, and export systems.

  • Knowledge of high H2S and corrosive environments in Kuwait oil fields.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or Materials Engineering.

  • Master's Degree preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 15+ years of experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Refinery, or EPC projects.

  • Proven experience on ADNOC, Shell, Saudi Aramco, and KOC projects.

  • Experience in FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, and Brownfield projects.

Technical Skills

As a Senior Consultant at Proxima, focused on Property and Facilities Management, you will lead complex workstreams and manage senior stakeholders while delivering innovative solutions and driving strategic initiatives across facilities management, property operations, and real estate portfolios. You will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives, supporting the development of insights, contributing to solution design, and playing an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

This is not a passive learning role. At Proxima, we are practitioner-consultants. You will build experience quickly, take responsibility early, and work alongside clients to deliver real, measurable change.

What you’ll do

Support delivery across client engagements

  • Design and propose facilities management and procurement strategies that deliver maximum value, leveraging market insights, experience, and best practices.

  • Assist with opportunity identification, supplier research, and commercial analysis.

Management and career development

Engage and collaborate with stakeholders

Work in a global, flexible model

What you bring

Experience and skills

  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.

  • Significant consulting experience, ideally within procurement or a related domain.

  • Proven track record leading complex client engagement.

Consulting mindset

  • Strong senior stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Flexibility and growth orientation

Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall - they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.

About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new - and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the‑art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall - they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.

Future Secure AI (FSAI) is a leading enterprise AI company that was created in deep partnership with one of the world's largest financial institutions.

Operating as an enterprise company with deep relationships at C-suite with large global enterprises, FSAI believes humans and AI Workers will collaborate seamlessly to raise organisational performance. FSAI has dozens of partnerships with leading companies in most industries and regions globally.

FSAI has a strategic focus on expanding globally as we continue our extraordinary journey to transform the world with the most cutting‑edge artificial intelligence.

The Opportunity

As a Staff AI Data Scientist, you will be a senior technical leader and force multiplier driving the development of agentic AI Co‑workers, multi‑step reasoning systems, and enterprise‑ready autonomous workflows. You will architect and deploy advanced LLM‑driven agents that plan, decide, and take action-safely, reliably, and at scale.

At Staff level, you won't just build systems - you'll set the technical bar for how we build them. You'll shape the technical direction of our agentic AI platform, influence architecture decisions across multiple teams, mentor and uplift senior and mid‑level talent, and ensure our systems are robust, aligned, and capable of delivering high‑value outcomes in complex environments.

Your work will directly influence the evolution of how humans collaborate with AI - and how our organisation builds AI, at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic LLM‑driven systems with planning, tool‑use, workflow orchestration, and reasoning capabilities
  • Apply machine learning and advanced analytics to power decision‑making within autonomous AI Co‑workers
  • Enhance multi‑step reasoning quality, context management, and agent performance across real enterprise use cases
  • Lead MLOps initiatives across evaluation, benchmarking, safety, and quality for autonomous systems
  • Own and define the long‑term technical strategy for agentic AI frameworks, governance, and scalable deployment patterns across the organisation
  • Act as a technical authority and trusted advisor to engineering, product, and executive teams in building production‑grade AI co‑workers used by global clients
  • Set technical standards and best practices, mentoring and uplifting data scientists across all levels, raising the bar for scientific and engineering excellence org‑wide

About You

You are an experienced, senior Data Scientist with a strong track record of delivering impactful, production‑grade ML systems, and deep curiosity about the fast‑moving agentic AI and LLM ecosystem. You thrive in ambiguity, communicate with clarity and authority, and take a pragmatic approach to building real, production‑ready intelligence at scale.

You bring:

  • Extensive, demonstrated experience delivering high‑impact machine learning solutions in complex environments, ideally with a track record of technical leadership or setting direction for a team
  • Strong NLP foundations: transformers, LSTMs, CNNs, topic modelling, supervised NLP
  • Deep, hands‑on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), RAG, multi‑agent systems, and tool‑calling architectures
  • Python focused on ML/AI and other languages

title: GSOC Program Manager
description:
Security is at the core of Google's design and development process: it is built into the DNA of our products. The same is true of our offices. You're an expert who shares our seriousness about security and our commitment to confidentiality. You'll collaborate with our Facilities Management team to create innovative security strategies, investigate breaches and create risk assessment plans for the future. You believe that providing effective security doesn't come at the expense of customer service - you will be our bodyguard (and our long lost pal).

The Global Security Operations Center is GSRS’s 24/7 ecosystem for intake, triage, management and escalation of physical security incidents and threats.

The GSOC Program Manager serves as the regional operational lead responsible for executing complex, cross-functional programs across people, processes, and technology. Partnering closely with the Senior Program Manager, this role drives regional implementation of global initiatives, optimizes risk mitigation capabilities, and fosters key stakeholder partnerships. By advocating technology innovation, standardizing processes, and tracking operational metrics, the GSOC Program Manager plays a critical role in scaling GSOC capabilities and advancing the broader GSRS mission to protect, sustain, and enable the business.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

  • Support complex and highly cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives to optimize and scale our ability to detect, assess, and mitigate risk.
  • Own the day-to-day relationship with internal cross-functional partners, act as a trusted advisor to manage competing interests. Drive operational excellence across all programs through standardized documentation, processes, and monitoring of key performance indicators.
  • Lead and drive training initiatives at the regional level and identify training gaps or needs to surface for review. Analyze, develop, and strengthen GSOC processes and procedures; guide development and integration.
  • Advocate technology innovation to enhance GSOC capabilities, provide thought leadership that informs future strategy, and actively drive the evolution of the GSOC ecosystem. Align GSOC deliverables where operationally appropriate.
  • Collaborate with the GSOC Senior Program Manager to utilize OKR tracking, operational metrics, and KPIs to standardize and feed performance reporting.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program or project management in an enterprise, cloud, or technology environment.
  • Experience with multidisciplinary program management in an organization.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience implementing security resilience programs impacting teams across multiple regions.
  • Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring.
  • Ability to identify, build, improve, or optimize relevant business processes.
  • Ability to analyze business objectives and strategies by proactively identifying impactful opportunities or gaps in systems and workflows.
  • High ethical standards with proven ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information; excellent judgment, discretion and diplomacy.

title: Nya kollegor till Kundservice!
description:
Vi välkomnar nu dig som vill göra skillnad genom att leverera service i toppklass till våra 2,7 miljoner kunder! Vi söker nya kollegor med start september 2026.

Du är viktig för oss!

Som kundservicemedarbetare på Tre har du en nyckelroll, du är örat mot rälsen och den första kontakten för våra kunder. I din roll hanterar du i första hand inkommande samtal via telefon, men tar även hand om ärenden via mejl och chatt. Du kommer att arbeta i gemenskap med ett härligt team, där ni tillsammans tar ägandeskap för våra kunders ärenden och ser till att lösa alla situationer på bästa möjliga sätt, genom att erbjuda våra kunder den bästa servicen och ett trevligt och professionellt bemötande. Du får också möjligheten att lära dig mer om och arbeta med merförsäljning.

Vi erbjuder dig

  • Att vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work och vi är stolta samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar
  • Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sysselsättningsgrad på antingen 80% eller på 100 %, där du tillsammans med din chef kommer fram till vilken anställningsform som passar dig bäst.
  • En unik utbildning och certifiering i kommunikationsmetoden CXP, Customer Excellence Program
  • Kontinuerlig utbildning och utveckling, tjänsten inleds med introduktionsutbildning och efter erbjuds du individanpassade utbildningar
  • Att vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan

Mer om dig

Vi söker dig som vill göra vardagen enklare för våra kunder och samtidigt bidra till att stärka Tre som varumärke. Du trivs med att hjälpa andra, är engagerad och motiveras av att hitta lösningar på problem.

Du är en lagspelare med en nyfiken inställning och ser lärande som en självklar del av jobbet. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig till olika människor och situationer, visar uthållighet och drivs av att nå resultat. Med ditt engagemang bidrar du till att inspirera både kunder och kollegor.

För rollen behöver du ha fyllt 18 år samt kunna kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Tidigare erfarenhet av service eller försäljning är meriterande.

Lite praktisk information

  • Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 80% eller 100% med start i september.
  • Vi erbjuder fast grundlön, provision samt månadsbonus.
  • Du kommer att arbeta från vårt fina 3hus vid Globenområdet i Stockholm. Våra öppettider är måndag–fredag kl. 09.00–18.15, och du schemaläggs utifrån verksamhetens bemanningsbehov.

Så går vår rekryteringsprocess till ✨

Vi arbetar med löpande urval under en längre period. Det kan innebära att det ibland dröjer lite innan du får återkoppling, men du kan känna dig trygg i att vi går igenom alla ansökningar noggrant.

  • Ansökan: Smidigt och enkelt, genom att besvara några utvalda frågor. Inget CV eller personligt brev behövs.
  • Tester: Om du uppfyller våra grundläggande krav, så som ålder och tillgänglighet, får du inbjudan till att genomföra våra tester. Dessa är en viktig del av vår helhetsbedömning, så gör de gärna så snart som möjligt för att fortsätta vara med i racet!
  • Telefonintervju: Här går vi igenom rollen och stämmer av om vi är en bra match, från ditt håll och vårt håll.
  • Intervju på plats: Du får komma på en kompetensbaserad intervju på plats och se mer av hur det är att jobba hos oss.
  • Referenser & bakgrundskontroll: Vi genomför referenstagning och en bakgrundskontroll.
  • Erbjudande: Om allt känns bra från båda håll, ser vi fram emot att välkomna till vårt team!

    • Välkommen med din ansökan!

    Låter det här som något för dig? Vad roligt, vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

    Att söka jobbet är enkelt och går snabbt, du behöver bara besvara några urvalsfrågor direkt i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot CV eller personligt brev, eftersom vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och vad du kan bidra med, än vad du gjort tidigare. För att ge alla samma chans att visa sin potential använder vi tester som första steg i rekryteringsprocessen.

    För våra slutkandidater genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll. Du får mer information om detta under rekryteringsprocessen.

    Varmt välkommen till oss på Tre!

    Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.

    Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.

    När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.

    WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.

    WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.

    WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: Sr. AVP-Agentic AI Identity Managemnt
description:
Job Description

Senior Assistant Vice President (D2)

Senior Principal Architect – Agentic AI Identity Management

Function: Global Technology

Reporting To: VP / SVP – Technology Cloud & Infrastructure

Role Overview

The Sr. AVP (D2) – Senior Principal Architect, Agentic AI Identity Management is a foundational technology leadership role responsible for shaping EXL’s Identity Management system and expanding it for agentic‑AI ecosystem.

This role operates at the intersection of architecture, security, automation, and business outcomes, providing deep technical stewardship while influencing senior stakeholders across business, delivery, risk, and governance. The incumbent will act as a technology authority, solution catalyst, and strategic advisor, ensuring platforms are secure‑by‑design, scalable‑by‑default, and outcome‑aligned.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Strategy

Architect and govern Identity Management for AI and autonomous agents, covering:

  • Agent discovery, registration, and attestation
  • Identity lifecycle (birth → permissioning → rotation → revocation → decommissioning)
  • Human‑to‑AI and AI‑to‑AI trust relationships
  • Transitioning from existing Microsoft MIM based Identity Management to IGA Platform with Agentic AI Identities
  • Least privilege access
  • Just‑in‑time and ephemeral credentials
  • Context‑aware and risk‑adaptive authorization

Define policy‑as‑code frameworks for:

Ensure full traceability and accountability across agent actions, decisions, data access, and privilege usage.

Partner with Cyber, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure architectures meet PCI DSS, SOC2, ISO 27001/42001, HIPAA, and emerging AI governance requirements.

Act as design authority for Identity for AI initiatives, including integrations with platforms such as Microsoft Entra, Okta, CyberArk, SailPoint, Saviynt, and AI‑native identity controls.

Agentic AI Platforms & Emerging Technologies

  • Architect and govern AI platforms leveraging:
    • Tools: Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, Replit, LangSmith, OpenClaw, Mostly, PyTorch, NeMo, Antigravity, etc.
    • Frameworks: NVIDIA NeMo, CrewAI, LangGraph, agent orchestration and evaluation frameworks
  • Define secure AI adoption patterns—sandbox to production—ensuring:
    • Data isolation
    • Controlled model access
    • Identity‑centric execution
  • Establish standards for prompt governance, agent behavior control, autonomy limits, and rollback strategies.

Security‑Aligned Architecture

  • Embed security thinking deeply into architecture design, with strong alignment to SIEM, CNAPP, Run time Security and cloud security, identity (including Identity for AI), and zero‑trust principles.
