title: Amazon Travel and Events Transactions Lead, Strategic Programs Management
description:
In this role we are seeking a customer obsessed, structured and detail oriented professional to support and drive transactions strategy execution, initiatives that envision implementing smart, intuitive payment models in partnership with Account Payables that balances customer experience with necessity controls. Role focuses on leading day-to-day execution across travel and events payment operations, central billing programs, reconciliation, and supplier billing management. Reports to the Travel and Events Transactions Manager. Emphasis on driving operational excellence across AT&E Payments RACI-defined payment program areas, cross-functional coordination with AP, Finance, Tax, FOAA, and vendor partners. India-based with global scope.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead central billing program operations (BTA/CTA, V-Pay) in partnership with AP
• Manage V-Pay virtual card program day-to-day operations and issue resolution
• Support M&E central card program management and vendor coordination
• Drive central payments reconciliation processes and identify automation opportunities
• Manage Central Bill Solution related invoice management (e-invoicing)
• Maintain and update global country/entity configuration matrix (MoR, invoicing)
• Own end-to-end travel supplier rebate tracking and payment collection
• Execute supplier entity setup and configuration
• Produce monthly travel and events accruals in coordination with Finance
• Coordinate with AP, Accounting, Tax, FOAA, and FORGE on billing matters
• Ensure compliance with payment policy and related GRC controls across geographies
• Work closely with Transactions and Policy-Compliance Managers to establish robust fraud mitigation controls for travel and events payments
• Continuous review of travel and events payments and transactions processes to identify operational gaps and strive for process optimization and automation
• Ability to identify and implement AI-driven solutions to optimize payment operations, enhance team productivity, and scale automation across billing workflows


About the team
AT&E Strategic Programs Management (SPM) drives T&E Policy compliance and controllership excellence, intelligent payment solutions, and sustainability transformation across Amazon's travel and events ecosystem. Operating on Customer Obsession, Insist on Highest Standards, and Deliver Results, we support AT&E's strategic pillars of Risk Reduction and Sustainability by developing smart policies, scalable payments automation, and data-driven insights that protect our customers and company while advancing Amazon's path to net-zero carbon.

title: Consultant - Generalist
description:
The opportunity
As a Consultant at Proxima, you will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives. You will support the development of insights, contribute to solution design, and play an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

This is not a passive learning role. At Proxima, we are practitioner-consultants. You will build experience quickly, take responsibility early, and work alongside clients to deliver real, measurable change.

What you’ll do

Support delivery across client engagements

  • Contribute to category management and sourcing activities, supporting strategy development and execution.

  • Assist with opportunity identification, supplier research, and commercial analysis.

  • Build structured fact bases that turn data into clear insights.

Analyze data to inform decisions

  • Use Excel and data analysis techniques to identify value, risk, and performance improvement opportunities.

  • Support benefits tracking and progress against delivery milestones.

  • Ensure analyses are accurate, structured, and decision-oriented.

Engage and collaborate with stakeholders

  • Work with client stakeholders to gather requirements and align objectives.

  • Communicate findings clearly and professionally with team members and clients.

  • Support workshops, working sessions, and day-to-day client interactions.

Work in a global, flexible model

  • Operate in a hybrid environment, balancing client, home, and office-based work.

  • Travel as required to support client delivery and team collaboration.

What you bring

Experience and skills

  • Experience in consulting, procurement, supply chain, or a related analytical role.

  • Experience supporting project delivery and managing stakeholder engagement across workstreams

  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.

Consulting mindset

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach to your work.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.

Flexibility and growth orientation

  • Willingness to travel as required.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn and develop.

  • Motivation to build a long-term consulting career in a growing global firm

title: Verpleegkundige Somatiek | Persoonlijke zorg in Amsterdam-West
description:
28 tot 36 uur | Amsterdam-West | Salaris tot €4.245,84

Breng rust en vertrouwen in het leven van bewoners bij Amsta De Poort in Amsterdam-West. Hier werk je met mensen die intensieve lichamelijke zorg nodig hebben. Je komt terecht in een team dat elkaar kent, ondersteunt en samen elke dag het verschil maakt

Jouw rol als Amstadammer

Als Verpleegkundige Somatiek bij De Poort zorg je voor bewoners die langdurige lichamelijke zorg nodig hebben. Je kijkt verder dan de zorgvraag alleen. Je kent de bewoners, weet wat belangrijk voor hen is en merkt snel wanneer iets verandert. Daardoor voelen bewoners zich gezien en veilig. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Samen met collega's, behandelaren en familie zorg je voor een fijne dag voor iedere bewoner. Dit doe jij door:

  • Verpleegkundige zorg te bieden met aandacht en vakmanschap.

  • Verpleegtechnische handelingen uit te voeren, zoals wondzorg, medicatie en katheterzorg.

  • Veranderingen in gezondheid of welzijn snel te signaleren en bespreekbaar te maken.

  • Bewoners en hun naasten duidelijk en betrokken te ondersteunen.

  • Collega's te begeleiden en mee te denken over goede zorg op de afdeling.

Hier gebeurt het

Je werkt op De Poort, een moderne woonzorglocatie van Amsta in Amsterdam. De locatie is goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer. Hier wonen ouderen die veel zorg en ondersteuning nodig hebben. Je werkt in een vast team van betrokken collega’s. Samen zorgen jullie voor rust, veiligheid en goede zorg. De sfeer is open en gezellig, met ruimte voor humor. Je werkt in dag-, avond- en nachtdiensten, met duidelijke overdrachtsmomenten, zodat iedereen weet wat er speelt.

Daarom pas jij bij Amsta

Jij houdt overzicht en blijft rustig als situaties veranderen. Je ziet wat bewoners nodig hebben en durft te handelen wanneer dat nodig is.
Verder heb jij:

  • Een diploma Verpleegkunde niveau 4.

  • Een geldige BIG-registratie.

  • Ervaring in de ouderenzorg of somatische zorg, of de motivatie om hierin te groeien.

  • Oog voor bewoners én voor de mensen om hen heen.

  • De wens om samen te werken en kennis te delen met collega's.

Zo zorgen wij voor jou

Bij Amsta zorgen we dat jij je werk goed kunt doen én gezond blijft. Jij zorgt met aandacht voor anderen en wij zorgen met aandacht voor jou. Dat merk je in alles wat we je bieden:

  • Salaris tot €4.245,84 bruto per maand (FWG 45, cao VVT). Je start met een jaarcontract; zijn we allebei enthousiast, dan zetten we samen de stap naar een vast contract.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, plus reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenopbouw via PFZW.

  • Ruimte om door te groeien en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en trainingen die bij jouw ambities passen.

  • Vitaliteit: boost je energie en welzijn via ons Zorg voor jou-platform, met online groepssessies zoals mindfulness, meditatie en ademhaling, en masterclasses over voeding, emoties en financieel welzijn.

  • Voor jou als Amstadammer: een werkplek waar werk en privé goed in balans zijn, met plezier en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Gezond werken, gezond leven! Profiteer van een fietsplan, korting op je zorgverzekering én een Preventief Medisch Onderzoek voor een volledige check-up.

  • Een warme, liefdevolle organisatie waar je jezelf kunt zijn en waarin iedereen telt.

Amsta: zorgen op zijn Amsterdams

Amsta is een Amsterdamse zorginstelling, met locaties door de hele stad. We ondersteunen Amsterdammers die hulp nodig hebben, vooral ouderen en mensen met complexe zorgvragen. Dat doen we liefdevol en met oprechte aandacht voor wat elke bewoner of cliënt nodig heeft. Werken nauw samen met familie, naasten en vrijwilligers.

Als Amstadammer kun je rekenen op uitdagend en afwisselend werk, waarin je blijft leren en groeien.

Want bij Amsta is veel kennis en expertise. Bijvoorbeeld in een van onze vier expertisecentra, gericht op Korsakov, jonge mensen met dementie, Gerontopsychiatrie en ernstig probleemgedrag bij dementie. We bieden ook revalidatiezorg, cognitieve screening, delier- en palliatieve zorg. Zo is er altijd een baan die echt bij jou past.

Bij Amsta kan iedereen zichzelf zijn. Cliënten en bewoners, maar ook jíj als Amstadammer. Je achtergrond, karakter, lef en creativiteit doen ertoe. We geloven in jouw warme, persoonlijke en professionele aanpak

Enthousiast?

Leuk! Solliciteer dan nu en word ook Amstadammer. Wij ontvangen graag je CV en een motivatiebrief. En daarna?
⇾ Je hoort binnen 3 werkdagen iets van ons.

⇾ De eerste kennismaking is telefonisch met onze Recruiter

⇾ Het tweede gesprek is met een van onze Clustermanager

⇾ Er volgt een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek

⇾ Je gaat starten. Welkom bij Amsta!

Twijfel je of heb je nog vragen?

Laat het ons weten! Je kan bijvoorbeeld ook een dagje meelopen om te kijken of dit bij jou past. Whatsapp of mail naar k.touber@amsta.nl

Het aanleveren van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) en het opvragen van een referentie zijn onderdeel van de selectieprocedure.

Met deze vacature willen wij zelf onze nieuwe collega werven. Acquisitie door werving- en selectie-, detachering- of uitzendbureaus wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Customer Solutions Consultant, Platform, Google Cloud (English, Thai)
description:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Solutions Consultant, you will partner with sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to the customers and serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use the expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions. You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participate in planning and support the business goals.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers, and continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, provide support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
  • Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Thai fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience promoting technical solutions in Cloud AI.
  • Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
  • Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).
  • Experience building technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
  • Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.

title: Vill du bli en Sjörikare? Skicka in din spontanansökan idag!
description:
Tillsammans är vi Sjöriket

Sjöriket är en väletablerad hemtjänst- och hemserviceleverantör med moderna, fina lokaler i centrala Ljungby. Vi utför insatser i Ljungby tätort, Lagan med omnejd, Ryssby/Agunnaryd och Angelstad/Annerstad. Här har närmare ett hundratal medarbetare sin arbetsplats och gemensamt för alla är vi tycker om vårt jobb och är stolta ''Sjörikare''.

Hos oss är kunden huvudperson. Vi värnar om den enskilde människan och utgår från varje persons behov, önskemål och förutsättningar. Tillsammans planerar vi insatser som underlättar vardagen, stärker välbefinnandet och bidrar till en god livskvalitet.

Vi vill vara det självklara valet, både för våra kunder och medarbetare.

Är du vår nästa Sjörikare?

Vi tar gärna emot en spontanansökning från dig som delar våra värderingar och vill göra skillnad i människors vardag.

Det är meriterande om du:

  • Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

  • Har B-körkort.

  • Har avlutad eller pågående utbildning inom vård och omsorg eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer relevant till verksamheten.

  • Har erfarenhet inom äldreomsorg eller arbetslivserfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet utöver de krav som olika tjänster kräver. Som person är du ansvarsfull, engagerad och känner stolthet över ditt yrke. Du har lika lätt för att arbeta självständigt som att samarbeta i en flexibel miljö. Utöver det är du positiv och har ett professionellt bemötande samt förhållningssätt.

Detta kan Sjöriket erbjuda dig!

  • En genomtänkt introduktion där lärande står i fokus.

  • Närliggande ledarskap och korta beslutsvägar.

  • Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor.

  • Generöst friskvårdserbjudande med bland annat gym och gruppträning, simning och friskvårdsbridag.

  • Gemensamma aktiviteter som stärker hälsa, trivsel och sammanhållning.

Skicka in din spontanansökan och bli vår nästkommande kollega!

Även om vi inte har en tjänst ute som passar dig just nu vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig. Skicka in ditt CV och berätta lite om dig själv, din erfarenhet och vad vilken typ av tjänst du är intresserad av.

Tillsammans är vi Sjöriket ❤️

title: Careers Coach - EOI
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£30,000 to £31,500

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!

This role is office based, but will involve travel across Clacton, Colchester & Chelmsford also.

Internal applications for this role close on 21/08/2026.

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. A Careers Coach is also responsible for conducting outreach in the community, building relationships with referral partners (DWP/JCP), and attending local events (e.g. job fairs) to generate referrals. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.
  • Providing support with CV preparation, job-searching, and interview skills.
  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.
  • Facilitating group training courses and workshops according to their needs.
  • Employer engagement and stakeholder management with the JCP.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus much more that can be found on our website
  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Attainments

  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)
  • Experience of working in a performance target driven environment
  • Willingness to travel locally, and access to own vehicle (e.g. to meet customers/employers).
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification).

Desirable Attainments:

  • Experience of working in a fast-paced environment. Examples of such experience may include working as a Holiday Representative or Recruitment Consultant, etc.
  • Experience of and exposure to client groups. These client groups may include incapacity benefit claimants, single parents, those with criminal records, mental health groups, ex-services, specific ethnic minority or faith groups and those with specific disabilities.
  • Direct previous experience of a similar role. Roles considered to be similar include the role of Employment Adviser on a welfare to work contract or a publicly funded service.
  • Degree or relevant qualification. Degree topics may include psychology, sociology, and social care/science. Relevant qualifications would include Information Advice and Guidance NVQs, Brokerage Standard, Social Work qualifications or qualifications relating to work with the specific client groups this role will involve
  • Level 3 or 4 NVQ in Advice & Guidance or Education & Training
  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (Dependent on programme).
  • Technical skills include the ability to use technology to deliver results and knowledge of welfare/benefits system
  • Personal interests include interest in career and self-development.
  • Experience of coaching and/or training

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Location: Remote Utah

Remote Type: Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Avalanche is a Warner Bros. Games studio located in downtown Salt Lake City nestled against the backdrop of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. We’ve been in the video game business since 1995, creating interactive experiences for fans of the world’s largest franchises. Join the team behind the blockbuster open world, action RPG Hogwarts Legacy as we create what’s next!

The Job


Avalanche, a division of WB Games Inc., is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our team of talented industry veterans working on a new online multiplayer RPG. This person will work closely with project engineering, art, and design leadership to develop high-quality, extensible gameplay features for an online multiplayer RPG.


The ideal candidate will own and support a variety of core gameplay systems, demonstrating high competency for gameplay and feature development and a true passion for game development.


What part will you play?

  • Develop and implement key gameplay systems and features, with a focus on building extensible architecture to support online, evolving gameplay in a live environment.
  • Work closely with the design team to build core gameplay systems and supporting tools.
  • Work closely with the project engineering team to architect and develop high quality, low-latency, and highly responsive code.
  • Participate in all parts of the development process from concept through to live-ops.
  • Develop and implement key game systems and features, as well as integrating with internal and external shared services and libraries.
  • Perform peer code reviews and champion a high standard of code excellence.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide design guidance on new features.
  • Work with design and product teams for feature viability, costing, design completeness, and risk assessment.

What do we need from you?

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, working on cross-functional teams.
  • Experience on at least one successfully-published large-scale multiplayer online game title or equivalent.
  • Experience on at least one successfully-published game title or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (or a related field) or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in C++ (Templates, Exception Handling, Multi-Threading, etc.).
  • Computer Science fundamentals in object-oriented design, algorithms, and data structures.
  • Strong 3D Math (Linear Algebra, Vector/Matrix Math, Quaternions, etc.).
  • Proficient experience with the Unreal Engine (Core systems, player input, game modes, user interfaces, etc.).
  • Exceptional understanding of all game development disciplines and their inputs into the content pipeline.
  • Strong problem solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.

Good to Have

  • A passion for online multiplayer RPGs and deep experience with online games.
  • Deep knowledge of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in online gaming.
  • Understanding of Performance Analysis and Optimizations.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $115,666.00 - $214,808.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

If you’re a qualified candidate with an arrest or conviction record, please know that your application will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

title: Senior Consultant - Specialty Chemicals
description:
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant at Proxima, you will lead complex workstreams within our Specialty Chemicals practice and manage senior stakeholders while delivering innovative solutions and mentoring junior consultants. You will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives, supporting the development of insights, contributing to solution design, and playing an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

This is not a passive learning role. At Proxima, we are practitioner-consultants. You will build experience quickly, take responsibility early, and work alongside clients to deliver real, measurable change.

What you’ll do

Support delivery across client engagements

  • Experience leading teams and workstreams or projects across complex engagements

  • Assist with opportunity identification, supplier research, and commercial analysis.

  • Identify opportunities supporting client value and revenue growth.

Management and career development

  • Coach and develop junior consultants.

  • Contribute to Proxima category thought leadership and IP.

  • Commercial acumen and comfort with ambiguity.

Engage and collaborate with stakeholders

  • Work directly with senior client stakeholders to gather requirements and align objectives.

  • Communicate findings clearly and professionally with team members and senior client stakeholders.

  • Lead workshops, working sessions, and day-to-day client interactions.

Work in a global, flexible model

  • Operate in a hybrid environment, balancing client, home, and office-based work.

  • Travel as required to support client delivery and team collaboration.

What you bring

Experience and skills

  • Strong experience in consulting, procurement, supply chain, or a related analytical role.

  • Experience in industrial and manufacturing settings, with an understanding of chemical supplier markets, offerings, and operations; including expertise with specialty chemicals (i.e. adhesives, coatings, catalysts, petrochemical additives, process chemicals, industrial gasses)

  • Experience supporting project delivery and managing stakeholder engagement across workstreams.

  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.

Consulting mindset

  • Strong senior stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach to your work.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.

Flexibility and growth orientation

  • Willingness to travel as required.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn and develop.

  • Motivation to build a long-term consulting career in a growing global firm.

title: Engineering Manager, Identity and Access Management, Capsium Serving
description:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) teams. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 3 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

title: Dyrektor Departamentu Rozwoju Produktu
description:
Szukamy lidera, który będzie odpowiadać za rozwój i rentowność portfolio produktów pożyczkowych i ubezpieczeniowych. To strategiczna rola łącząca zarządzanie produktem, doświadczeniem klienta, marketingiem oraz rozwojem biznesu. Będziesz mieć realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju oferty, wyniki Spółki oraz realizację jej celów strategicznych.

Będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za:

  • Zarządzanie, rozwój i budowanie zaangażowania zespołu oraz realizację celów biznesowych.

  • Monitorowanie trendów rynkowych oraz rozwój strategii customer experience.

  • Zarządzanie cyklem życia produktów i klientów oraz działaniami zwiększającymi ich wartość biznesową.

  • Rozwój programów promocyjnych, lojalnościowych i partnerskich oraz zarządzanie budżetem marketingowym.

  • Umiejętności skutecznej współpracy z szerokim gronem interesariuszy, w tym na poziomie Zarządu i Grupy.

Co możesz zyskać, pracując z nami:

title: Product Manager Collaboration Platforms - Atlassian tools (m/f/n)

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us

RATP Dev is a subsidiary of the RATP Group, a global leader in high-capacity urban rail and the world’s third largest public transport operator.

Our 25,000 people design, operate, maintain and modernise urban and interurban transport networks across more than 100 cities in 17 countries, delivering tailored mobility solutions that respond to each community’s environmental, social, and economic needs.

We build, deliver and commit to the best of public transport - every day, everywhere, for everybody - making it the natural choice for cities and passengers.

About the Role

The Senior Data Engineer plays a key role in delivering a strategic Enterprise Data Platform as a core pillar of TransitLinX’s digital transformation. Supporting both the Construction and future Operations phases of the project, you will be instrumental in operating, evolving, and industrialising our newly built Data Lake, supporting business data consumers, and establishing Data Governance foundations.

Reporting to the Enterprise Systems & Innovation Manager, this role offers a strong growth opportunity for a hands‑on technical professional who wants to contribute to building and scaling a Data Lake from the ground up within a structured, international, and high‑impact environment. As our team is growing, you will have the unique opportunity to help shape our future ways of working. In this role, you will:

  • Design, Build & Run: Develop and maintain robust data ingestion and transformation pipelines on AWS and Snowflake, implementing staging, clean, and datamart data layers.
  • Industrialise & Automate: Drive the continuous improvement, automation, and scalability of the platform, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and incident resolution.
  • Support Data Consumers: Act as the primary technical point of contact for Data Lake users (BI, reporting, analytics, and project teams), analysing requirements to publish curated datasets, views, and data models.
  • Bridge Systems & Architecture: Contribute to the broader Data Architecture vision and integrate the Data Lake with enterprise systems (such as asset management, maintenance, ticketing, and external platforms).
  • Champion Emerging Tech: Identify opportunities where modern data practices, automation, GenAI, or LLM-based solutions can improve productivity and data accessibility.
  • Collaborate Internationally: Partner with system integrators and coordinate closely with TransitLinX partners and RATP Dev HQ in France to align with global standards and best practices.
  • Operational Flexibility: As a growing team, support adjacent business needs when required (such as contributing to dashboards, ad-hoc data analysis, or coordinating external partners)—while keeping your primary focus on platform engineering.

title: Åpen søknad 🍓
description:
Jordbærpikene trenger deg som vil begeistre kundene våre!

Når vi skal styrke vårt team, og ønsker flere sprudlende ansatte, som vil være med og skape de beste gjesteopplevelser.

Hos oss i Jordbærpikene er det aller viktigste vi gjør å gi kundene en opplevelse. Vi er hjertet i senteret. De som besøker oss skal merke at de er sett og ivaretatt. Den følelsen er det du som skaper. Samspill med dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø der alle gleder seg til å gå på jobb er essensielt for å lykkes hos oss. Våre kafeer har en varm og avslappet atmosfære, samtidig som tempoet er høyt.

Felles for våre stillinger er at du:

  • Ønsker gjestene velkommen med et herlig ekte smil – hver dag også når det er som mest hektisk
  • Kan lese oppskrifter og manualer fra vårt kjøkken
  • Liker å jobbe med mennesker og trives med høyt tempo
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbeidstid
  • Er en lagspiller som unner dine kolleger suksess, og raust deler erfaringer for å gjøre hverandre enda bedre
  • Genuint er interessert i å servere gode matopplevelser
  • Verdsetter mat av god kvalitet, laget fra våre egne oppskrifter

Våre verdier ELSK står sterkt hos oss, og vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

I tillegg til ovennevnte søker vi deg som:

  • Har interesse for mat
  • Er over 18 år
  • Tar i ett tak der det trengs
  • Erfaring er et pluss

I Jordbærpikene har vi matretter og bakst som lages på våre egne oppskrifter. Vi ønsker oss deg som på en effektiv og engasjert måte er med på å produsere og levere vår meny etter våre standarder.

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Jordbærpikene 🍓

title: Backend Developer
description:

Shalion is a data and insights-driven company that serves world-class manufacturers and brands globally. Through our Digital Shelf Optimization, Retail Media, and Food Service Aggregators solutions, we provide innovative tools for e-commerce monitoring.

At Shalion, we empower brands to make smarter business decisions in eCommerce by delivering actionable data and insights on online product prices, availability, share of search, and more. We operate across 1000+ e-retailers in 60+ countries, serving industry giants such as Heineken, Lego, Danone, Nestlé, and JDE.

As a leader in data intelligence, we specialize in gathering, analyzing, and applying proprietary artificial intelligence to deliver relevant data and monitoring tools, helping our clients maximize their e-commerce performance.

Our headquarters are in Barcelona, Spain, and we are expanding our team in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The role

JQuery, Node.js. Android, who is eager to apply their skills in a challenging environment. Main areas of responsibility:

What we offer you

Shalion Data Services Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Data Center Operations Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services

Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:

Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each

Working in cramped and/or elevated locations

Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Work in an industrial environment

Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution

- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving

- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context

- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support

- Improve effectiveness through process innovation

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

title: Wallpaper Hanger and Painter
description:
About the role

We're hiring an experienced painter who can also hang wallpaper for residential and commercial work across greater Cincinnati. Our work comes largely from repeat customers, referrals, and realtor and designer relationships — which means the finish has to be right the first time and the customer has to be comfortable with you in their home.

The wallcovering skill is what sets this position apart. Most painters can't hang paper, and most paperhangers don't paint. If you do both well, you'll stay busy year-round with us and earn at the top of our range.

What you'll do

Painting

  • Interior repaints: walls, ceilings, trim, doors, cabinets, and stain/finish work
  • Exterior work: siding, soffit and fascia, trim, decks, and railings
  • Full prep — scrape, sand, caulk, patch drywall and nail holes, spot prime, and mask
  • Cut in clean lines by hand; roll, brush, and spray (airless and HVLP) as the job calls for

Wallcovering

  • Measure and estimate material quantities from room dimensions and pattern repeats
  • Strip existing paper, skim and sand, and prime/size walls before hanging
  • Install pretrimmed and untrimmed, pre-pasted and unpasted, non-woven, vinyl, grasscloth and natural fibers, murals, and commercial Type II vinyl
  • Match patterns, book and relax paper properly, and cut clean seams at inside corners, outlets, trim, and ceilings

Both

  • Set up and break down daily: drop cloths, plastic, ladders, and staging, with the space left clean every night
  • Track your hours to the job and report progress against quoted hours to your project manager
  • Flag scope changes, hidden damage, or extra work before doing it — never verbally commit the company to added work
  • Communicate professionally with homeowners, designers, property managers, and GCs on site

What we're looking for

Required

  • 3+ years professional painting experience (residential or commercial)
  • Hands-on wallcovering installation experience — hanging and removal
  • Clean, straight cut lines without tape; clean seams on paper. This is what we screen for
  • Solid prep and drywall patching skills
  • Your own hand tools: brushes, roller frames, 5-in-1, caulk gun, extension pole, drop cloths, plus paperhanging tools (smoother, snap knife, seam roller, straightedge, water box, table)
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and a working smartphone for scheduling and job photos
  • Comfortable on ladders; able to lift 50 lbs and work on your feet all day

title: Senior Product Manager- Fertility Solutions- Livingston, NJ/Trumbull, CT
description:
About CooperSurgical

CooperSurgical is a leading fertility and women’s healthcare company dedicated to putting time on the side of women, babies, and families at the healthcare moments that matter most in life. As a business unit of CooperCompanies (Nasdaq: COO), we're driven by a unified purpose of helping people experience life’s beautiful moments. Guided by our shared values – dedicated, innovative, friendly, partners, and do the right thing – our offerings support patients throughout their lifetimes, from contraception to fertility and birth solutions, to women’s and family care, and beyond. We currently offer over 600 clinically relevant medical devices to healthcare providers, including testing and treatment options, as well as an innovative suite of assisted reproductive technology and genomic testing solutions. Learn more at

Job Summary:

As Senior Global Product Manager, IVF Equipment, you are accountable for both on-market portfolio performance and future portfolio development for defined product categories within the IVF Equipment portfolio.

Your responsibilities include product category strategy, product lifecycle management, product positioning, pricing strategy, competitive intelligence, customer insight, product requirements, launch strategy, commercial readiness, and input into new product innovation projects.

This is a strategically important global role where you will use your marketing toolkit, strong business acumen, customer insight skills, and technical curiosity to ensure CooperSurgical maintains a competitive IVF Equipment offering that maximizes both short-term and long-term profitable growth.

A key focus of the role will be strengthening the link between market insight, customer needs, product requirements, and successful commercialization. You will lead Voice-of-Customer activities, define customer, user and business needs, develop business cases, shape product and portfolio roadmaps, and partner closely with R&D, PMO, Regulatory, Quality, Service, Operations, Business Development, and global commercial teams.

You will report to the Global Product Director, IVF Equipment. You will work in a dynamic global environment with multiple activities running in parallel.

Essential Functions & Accountabilities:

  • Lead category strategy, portfolio roadmap development, and lifecycle planning for assigned IVF Equipment categories, using customer insight, regional feedback, competitive intelligence, installed-base data, and business performance to guide product and portfolio decisions.
  • Define user needs, product requirements, value propositions, and business cases for new product innovation and lifecycle management projects. Partner with R&D, PMO, Regulatory, Quality, Service, Pricing, Finance, Business Development, and commercial teams to ensure product management input is clear, timely, and aligned with portfolio strategy.
  • Lead global launch strategy and execution, including positioning, go-to-market planning, commercial readiness, sales enablement, launch metrics, and post-launch performance tracking.
  • Maintain a detailed understanding of portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, market share, pricing, customer feedback, service considerations, and regional commercial needs.
  • Develop and execute product category growth strategies across the full product lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve customer adoption, retention, competitive positioning, portfolio performance, and long-term profitable growth.
  • Own global pricing strategy for assigned product categories, including annual price optimization, price positioning, and pricing input for new product launches.
  • Drive lifecycle management activities, including portfolio optimization, rationalization, replacement opportunities, and product performance improvements.
  • Support cross-portfolio growth initiatives where relevant, including installed-base growth, replacement strategies, bundling, lab-build solutions, service-related offerings, and commercial excellence projects.

  • Communicate portfolio strategy, opportunities, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

Travel:

Travel up to 20% (50 days) per year, conditional to business need.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong business acumen.
  • Attention to detail and highly organized, while ensuring progress to meet deadlines.
  • Growth mindset with a proactive approach and drive for results.
  • Experience leading upstream marketing activities, including Voice-of-Customer, value proposition development, business cases, product requirements input, and commercial launches.
  • Strong experience developing and executing commercial marketing initiatives, including campaigns, go-to-market planning, segmentation, targeting, positioning, and sales enablement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with excellent networking and collaborative behavior across functions and regions.
  • Team player, while also able to work independently and effectively.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills. Able to create compelling PowerPoint presentations and detailed financial analysis in Excel.
  • Robust mindset and influential personality.
  • Proven ability to run multiple tasks concurrently in a fast-paced working environment and remain comfortable with sometimes short deadlines.
  • Scientific interest, technical understanding, and strong customer / market curiosity are essential.
  • Knowledge of IVF, fertility, embryology, laboratory workflows, high-tech medical devices, laboratory equipment, and/or software-enabled devices is considered a strong advantage.
  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is mandatory.

Work Environment:

  • On Site: US or Denmark

Experience:

  • A minimum of 6 years of product management, global marketing, upstream marketing, or strategic marketing experience, preferably from medical devices, MedTech, diagnostics, life sciences, laboratory equipment, capital equipment, or other technically complex healthcare industries.
  • Experience with capital equipment, hardware/software-enabled products, connected devices, digital solutions, fertility, IVF, or laboratory workflows is considered a key advantage.
  • Experience developing global product, portfolio, or category strategies is a strong advantage.
  • Experience leading new product launches, including launch strategy, commercial readiness, go-to-market planning, sales enablement, and post-launch performance tracking, is a strong advantage.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Science.

title: Associate Director, Structures Department
description:
Associate Director, Structures Department

Location: El Segundo, CA

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Vehicle Systems Division (VSD) sits at the center of the ideas and data behind current and future systems supplying innovative research and development; technical evaluations during the acquisition process; conceptual and detailed design; assembly, integration, and test; and operational support. Comprised primarily of highly trained mechanical and aerospace engineers, VSD provides national expertise in the areas of vehicle engineering; guidance, navigation, and controls; robotics; electro-mechanical devices; embedded systems; fluid mechanics; propulsion; thermal control; orbital mechanics; mechanisms; structures; structural dynamics; and dynamic environments.

The Structures Department within the Structural Mechanics Subdivision, Vehicle Systems Division, is seeking a Structures Department Associate Director (Associate Director – Aeronautical and Aerospace Structural Engineering) with a demonstrated record in leadership and a strong foundation in solid mechanics, practical experience in structural analysis, a passion for the space industry, and a desire to apply their expertise to help solve a variety of technical challenges facing national security space programs.

This is a full-time position based in El Segundo, CA., requiring at least 4 days onsite.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Establish department objectives and goals, communicating them effectively to staff, management, and interfacing matrix organizations

  • Participate with higher management in determining organizational structure, staffing needs, and resource allocation

  • Participate in budget planning and allocation of resources; implement policies, practices, and operating processes

  • Identify and assign functional responsibilities within sub-organizations; coordinate work activities and monitor workload, progress, and schedules to ensure completion within allocations and schedule guidelines

  • Conduct staff performance reviews and recommend performance improvement, career development, salary, and promotion actions

  • Promote a climate of continual learning and mentoring; serve as senior mentor for the development of early career staff by providing technical guidance and insights

  • Communicate and coordinate frequently with customers to understand and identify critical needs, milestone schedules, and work progress

  • Conduct work performance within customer standards and regulations; participate in day-to-day technical task planning and issue resolution as needed

  • Seek and identify opportunities for additional, expanded, and new business; assist higher management in the evaluation and pursuit of new opportunities

  • Develop new business connections and motivate technological innovations

  • Review and approve technical work, documentation, and briefings intended for release to external customers

  • Assess program risks and advise program offices and customers during certification, development, and/or operational phases of programs

  • Maintain authoritative expertise in the development, analysis, and verification of space structures, with thorough knowledge of structural design criteria in combination with structural test methods

  • Direct technical groups performing engineering design, analysis, and research and development activities related to structural mechanics

  • Publish clarification, insight, and guidance on technical topics to assist industry in enhancing mission assurance practices or advancing the state-of-practice in structural verification and validation

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering with a focus in structural and/or solid mechanics or a closely related field

  • 10 years of applicable professional and educational experience

  • Demonstrated 2+ years of people management skills, including hiring, mentoring, staff development, and administering performance reviews

title: Vi søker ekstrahjelp/deltid på Jordbærpikene Orkanger 🍓
description:
I Jordbærpikene møter vi gjestene velkommen med et herlig ekte smil - hver dag også når det er som mest hektisk. Er det deg?

Jordbærpikene Orkanger søker en fast stilling en kveld i uken og annenhver helg.
Stillingen passer perfekt for deg som ønsker å jobbe ved siden av studiene eller ved siden av skolen. For denne stillingen må du være over 18 år.

I Jordbærpikene får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere jordbær med på laget 🍓

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder (over 18 år).

I jordbæråkeren finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Jordbærpikene?
Med Jordbærpikene får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert konsept der våre kafeer har en varm og avslappet atmosfære, samtidig som tempoet er høyt. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill med dine kolleger der alle gleder seg til å gå på jobb som er essensielt for å lykkes hos oss. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss 🧑‍🍳

Du utstråler våre verdier, er en lagspiller som byr på seg selv. Lidenskap for å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.



Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Jordbærpikene 🍓

Har du spørsmål er du hjertlig velkommen til å ta kontakt med Cafèeier Christine Roll Meek på tlf 920 14 920

title: Reservdelsansvarig till Björkmans Bil Örebro
description:
I slutet av 2022 invigde Björkmans Bil sin nya Kia-anläggning på det populära handelsområdet Boglundsängen i Örebro. Nu söker vi efter en Reservdelsansvarig som älskar ordning, struktur och som vill jobba i toppmoderna lokaler hos en av Sveriges modernaste Kia-anläggningar. Missa inte möjligheten till att få representera Kia – Sveriges tredje största bilmärke.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som reservdelsansvarig kommer du att tillhöra en av våra viktigaste avdelningar. Dina främsta ansvarsområden är att sköta vårt lager samt se till att våra servicetekniker har de reservdelar/material de behöver för att kunna utföra sitt arbete.

Arbetet innefattar bland annat beställning av reservdelar, förplock till våra servicetekniker, inventering och försäljning via disk. Du kommer även att hantera kundförfrågningar av reservdelar och tillbehör via mail och telefon.

Du får en spännande roll som knyter samman verkstad, reservdelar och kundmottagning i det dagliga arbetet. Tjänsten är administrativ men innefattar också en del kontakt med leverantörer och partners till företaget.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, strukturerad och har god planeringsförmåga. Vi har inga krav på någon specifik utbildning, men har du fordonsteknisk utbildning eller har ett stort fordonsintresse är det självklart ett plus. Har du tidigare arbetat med reservdelar/tillbehör eller har erfarenhet från Kia eller vårt affärssystem Kobra är det mycket meriterande. Du bör även ha vana av att arbeta med dator och trivas i att arbeta i en miljö där du är ”en spindel i nätet”.

Stor vikt läggs vid dina personliga egenskaper. Du behöver kunna tala och skriva svenska flytande, då rollen innebär kontakt med Kia och andra leverantörer. B-körkort är ett krav.

Som person ser vi att du är en lagspelare men som även klarar av att arbeta självständigt. Du är en glad person som inte tvekar att hjälpa andra.

Vi kan erbjuda dig

Vi erbjuder dig en plats i vår moderna Kia-anläggning på Boglundsängen, som har en stor naturlig ström av kunder. Du kommer att arbeta med personal som brinner för Kia och vi tycker att våra duktiga medarbetare är viktigast för vår framgång. Vi lägger därför stor vikt vid att vår personal ska trivas, och arbetar aktivt för en stark teamkänsla och individuell utveckling.

  • En dynamisk arbetsmiljö där du blir en del av ett professionellt team som värderar individuell utveckling och gemensam framgång.
  • Kontinuerlig utbildning för att hålla dig uppdaterad om den moderna tekniken och det senaste kring Kias modellprogram.
  • Attraktiva anställningsvillkor med bra personalförmåner – vi har kollektivavtal.
  • Heltidstjänst på 100% – tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Tillsammans strävar vi efter att förse våra kunder med upplevelser utöver det vanliga. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att vår personal ska trivas, och arbetar aktivt för en stark teamkänsla och individuell utveckling.

Ser du en framtid tillsammans med oss på Björkmans Bil? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

Låter det intressant?

Du ansöker till tjänsten genom att skicka in CV samt personligt brev via vår hemsida www.bjorkmansbil.se/jobb/

Både urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vänligen bifoga både ditt CV och ett personligt brev, där du berättar lite mer om dig själv och varför du är intresserad av tjänsten.

Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan och lära känna dig bättre.

title: Sr. Technical Program Mgr
description:
Job Summary

Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) in Cloud Storage & Services Business unit is responsible for leading programs for cloud integrated, fully managed, high-performance scalable Cloud storage solution across Azure, Google Cloud and AWS. If you love finding creative solutions to challenging problems, innovate and want to be part of a growing team building the true Cloud concepts for the biggest tech giants then we have this opportunity for you where you can make an impact and help your career advance together with NetApp Cloud Storage.

This Technical Program Manager will own and manage the end-to-end program management of NetApp’s key growth initiatives in the Cloud BU identified by the CEO and executive leadership team. This position will report directly to the Director, TPMO, Cloud Storage & Services. Key responsibilities include working cross-functional with all stakeholders to identify and gain alignment around a set of deliverables and program milestones that lead to strategic solutions for Software as a Service in the Cloud Storage & Services BU and NetApp as a company. Stakeholders could be internal to NetApp or external customers, vendors, and partners.

The incumbent will lead the cross-functional team from concept, design, implementation to launch the product/service in the market while working within the guidelines and cadence defined by the program team. The TPM will serve as the technical delivery owner driving cross-program dependencies to resolution, executive communication, risk management and end-to-end delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end program management and delivery — milestones, critical path, dependency maps, and release integration across engineering and product teams in multiple geographies.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across roles, functions, and geos; navigate ambiguity and keep teams focused on shared goals and measurable outcomes.
  • Understand and communicate program resource needs — current and future — and facilitate prioritization and decision forums with Engineering, release management, and product leadership.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business and shared services partners; challenge assumptions, read stakeholder dynamics, and influence decision-making with a credible point of view.
  • Partner with senior engineers to decompose initiatives into milestones with clear acceptance criteria, dependency linkages, and release-readiness gates.
  • Identify risks and blocking issues early; recommend options, facilitate team decisions, and escalate with cost-of-delay analysis and recommended paths forward.
  • Deliver concise, decision-oriented executive briefings on deployment progress, results, and program health to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Represent the program in CSS portfolio reviews, semester planning, and leadership forums.
  • Improve program traceability and automate recurring TPM workflows in alignment with CSS TPMO standards.

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience of successful releases for multiple products or services in technology focused programs.
  • Demonstrated delivery of complex, multi-team platform or infrastructure programs in cloud, storage, distributed systems, or SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of project and resource interdependencies within a program or portfolio, including shared capacity and prioritization tradeoffs.
  • Ability to read and constructively challenge architecture documents, design specifications, release plans, and dependency graphs.
  • Strong command of Agile-at-scale and release train mechanics: milestone planning, GA readiness gates, change control, and critical path management.
  • Proven ability to influence senior engineering and product leaders without direct authority in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Results-oriented self-starter with strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills; proactively mitigates risk, resolves issues, and escalates when appropriate.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office.
  • Storage industry experience, PMP certification, and Agile experience preferred.

Education

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

Compensation:
The target salary range for this position is 170,000 - 253,000 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

title: Security Engineer, Platform Security
description:
Security Engineer — Platform Security

Location: Berlin

Department: Management Information Systems

Think like an attacker. Build like a defender.

As a security engineer for platform security at Gallup, you'll protect the cloud and infrastructure that power our global business while helping Gallup stay ahead of an ever-changing threat landscape. In this role, you'll strengthen security by design, assist with incident response support and partner across engineering teams to build resilient platforms that enable innovation. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Gallup builds, strengthens and continuously improves platform security.

What You’ll Do

  • Advise infrastructure and engineering teams on secure design for cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure and endpoint environments
  • Design, implement and continuously improve security controls across Gallup's cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Conduct cloud security posture management (CSPM) reviews and infrastructure vulnerability assessments across network, system and cloud environments
  • Administer, optimize and tune Splunk SIEM and endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms to improve visibility, detection and response capabilities
  • Embed security controls, metrics and best practices early in infrastructure initiatives through a shift-left approach
  • Lead and coordinate platform security incident response, providing calm, decisive technical leadership during high-impact events
  • Develop scripts and automation that improve security operations, monitoring and operational efficiency
  • Continuously assess emerging threats and evolving attack techniques, including those enabled by AI, and recommend practical improvements that strengthen Gallup's security posture

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Platform security expertise: You bring deep experience securing enterprise cloud and infrastructure environments across one or more major cloud platforms and understand both modern and traditional infrastructure.
  • Adaptive problem solving: You enjoy moving between different technologies, quickly navigating new challenges and delivering practical, scalable solutions without losing momentum.
  • Calm incident leadership: You remain composed during high-pressure security events, communicate clearly and make sound decisions that restore confidence and reduce risk.
  • Trusted technical partnership: You translate complex security concepts into actionable guidance and build strong relationships with engineers and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Ownership: You proactively identify opportunities to improve security, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver high-quality work.
  • Self-starter mindset: You thrive working independently while knowing when to involve others.

What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information assurance, computer science or a related field required
  • At least two years of full-time professional experience securing enterprise cloud and infrastructure environments required
  • Deep experience securing one or more cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365 or Oracle Cloud required
  • Hands-on experience administering and tuning Splunk SIEM and EDR platforms required
  • Experience performing CSPM reviews and infrastructure vulnerability assessments required
  • Experience leading or playing a significant role in security incident response required
  • Strong scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash or a comparable language required
  • OSCP, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or similar security certifications preferred
  • Experience using AI tools to improve security operations or familiarity with emerging AI-enabled threats preferred
  • A commitment to working on-site at Gallup's Berlin office at least three days per week required

About Gallup

At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes competitive pay, life and critical illness insurance, a pension, an employee stock ownership program, mass transit reimbursement, a JobRad bike leasing program, family-building benefits, an employee assistance program, and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing. We also offer an estimated annual salary range of €55,000–€90,000 for this role. Salaries are based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s education, experience and skills.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and business needs. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy. This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.

Agencies: We are not partnering with agencies for this role, nor will we accept unsolicited résumés or be responsible for any fees or expenses related to such unsolicited résumés and/or applicants.
