title: Senior Gameplay Programmer
description:
Senior Gameplay Programmer

Location: London Rocksteady Studios Limited

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Rocksteady Studios is an award-winning, critically acclaimed video game developer. Founded in 2004, we are home to the widely celebrated Batman: Arkham series of games. Our philosophy for game development is all about treating people well to create quality entertainment that stands the test of time. We’re a one-project studio that built our success by combining genre-defining gameplay and character-driven cinematic narrative with AAA production values. Born in the heart of London, our multicultural team takes inspiration from the culture and history of our home in one of the most diverse cities in the world.

Your New Role…

Rocksteady is looking to add to its family of staff: a Senior Gameplay Programmer to join a team of gameplay coders to deliver world-class AAA videogaming experiences for our players across multiple platforms. The role focuses on creating exciting, emergent gameplay by coordinating combat-related and navigation related NPC behaviours that empower player freedom and choice.

This role is offered on a hybrid basis. You can choose to work from home or in the office on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays. On Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the team collaborates onsite at Rocksteady Studios in Kentish Town, London.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Creating, developing, and maintaining gameplay systems and features in C++.
  • Producing solutions to large, complex, and sometimes not well-defined gameplay problems.
  • Working closely and proactively with Design to come up with fun and engaging gameplay, and informing them of risks and opportunities.
  • Providing suggestions and feedback to other members of your team, including via code reviews.
  • Being a positive, active, and contributing team member taking broad responsibility for your work.
  • Communicating effectively with your Lead, your team, Production and other departments.
  • Supporting production processes, including backlog review, task estimation and breakdown, and Jira ticket management.
  • Following, and championing development best practices.

Qualifications & Experience…

  • Experience developing gameplay systems using C++, including areas such as AI, navigation, and combat systems.
  • Understanding of modern gaming platforms and experience developing software for one or more of them.
  • Experience contributing to the development and successful delivery of a commercial game title, preferably within a AAA environment.
  • Strong game design skills, with the ability to demonstrate your approach through previous work, projects, or portfolio examples.
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine 5.
  • Familiarity with Rocksteady titles and design philosophies would be advantageous.

Hybrid Working - This role is advertised as a Hybrid work model, that combines remote and in-office work, following our current company policy and to be agreed with your Line Manager. Subject to any applicable laws, WBD / your Line Manager reserves the right to change this working agreement where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: Ombordundersökning på bussar  - dela ut och samla in enkäter!
description:
Tycker du om att interagera med människor, åka buss och vill jobba med något som leder till samhällsutveckling? Då kan tjänsten som enkätutdelare vara något för dig!

OBS! Vi anställer löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag!

Kort om tjänsten

Du arbetar med att dela ut och samla in enkäter ombord på bussar, på olika linjer. Enkäten består av frågor om passagerarnas resa och hur de upplever den. Du kommer att bli schemalagd för att veta vilka linjer du ska åka och vilka byten du ska göra under ditt pass.

Uppdraget pågår i tio veckor, med start v. 37 i september.

Arbetstider

Du har själv stora möjligheter att påverka ditt schema och när du vill arbeta. Tjänsten är flexibel och varierande, och passar utmärkt som ett deltidsjobb vid sidan av studier eller annat deltidsarbete. Arbetspass kommer att erbjudas på vardagar, morgnar, dagtid och kvällstid.

Kort om dig

Vi söker dig som bor i Oxelösund med omnejd och som kan arbeta v.37-46. Du är noggrann och uppmärksam, och trivs med att följa instruktioner.

Du är lättlärd och självgående, t.ex. finner du det enkelt att planera hur du använder tiden ombord på en buss för att hinna dela ut enkäter och sedan samla in dem igen innan du ska gå av på den hållplats du är schemalagd att gå av vid.

Det är även meriterande om du har liknande arbetslivserfarenhet sedan tidigare.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Bor i Oxelösund med omnejd.
  • Kan jobba ca 1 pass i veckan på varierade tider.
  • Är noggrann och ansvarsfull.
  • Är lättlärd och självgående.
  • Är kommunikativ och har lätt för att uttrycka dig på svenska.

Vi erbjuder:

  • En fast timlön på god nivå.
  • Ett trevligt arbetsklimat där tempot är högt, men noggrannhet är viktigast.
  • En liten arbetsplats där varje anställds insats är viktig för helheten.
  • Flexibilitet i arbetstider - frihet under ansvar.

Kort om oss

Vi på Lysio arbetar med olika typer av undersökningar på uppdrag av offentliga organisationer, akademisk sektor, företag och föreningar. Vi sätter kvaliteten på våra undersökningar och vårt analysarbete i första rummet. Nu söker vi fler personer till vårt team. Uppdraget innebär att du delar ut och samlar in enkäter till resenärer i kollektivtrafiken.

Läs mer om Lysio på vår hemsida!

http://www.lysio.se/

Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineer
description:
Sr Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer

Location: United States, Madison, WI

Department: Corporate Systems Services

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Build the Cloud Foundation Behind Sony Interactive Entertainment

Every day, engineering teams across Sony Interactive Entertainment rely on the platforms we build to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable services. IT Cloud Foundations engineers the cloud capabilities that power enterprise business systems, developer platforms, and data services across the company.

Our customers are both engineers and the businesses they support. Every improvement we make to automation, reliability, security, and cloud infrastructure directly accelerates engineering teams while improving the reliability of critical business services.

The solutions we build become reusable capabilities that scale across the enterprise—not just for a single application or project.

Our mission isn't simply to manage cloud infrastructure—it's to engineer the secure, scalable cloud platform that enables Sony Interactive Entertainment to operate, innovate, and grow.

Lead Meaningful Engineering

As a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer, you'll lead some of our most important cloud initiatives from design through production.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with sound engineering judgment to design and deliver secure, resilient, and scalable cloud capabilities supporting business-critical services across Sony Interactive Entertainment.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll partner with Networking, Security, Identity, Database, Platform, Data, and Application Engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure challenges, mentor fellow engineers, and continuously improve how cloud services are delivered.

Whether you're designing reusable Terraform modules, expanding Kubernetes platforms, improving observability, or automating operational processes, your work will help shape the shared engineering platform that teams rely on every day.

The Challenges You'll Help Us Solve

  • How can we deliver complex infrastructure requests while continuously improving the platform for the next request?
  • How can we raise the quality of automation, observability, Kubernetes, networking, and governance across the enterprise?
  • How can we strengthen engineering partnerships while delivering business-critical cloud capabilities?
  • How can emerging technologies—including AI—improve automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and developer productivity where they create measurable value?

What You'll Work On

  • Lead complex AWS infrastructure and platform initiatives from architecture through production.
  • Design reusable infrastructure, automation, and platform capabilities that strengthen the shared cloud platform.
  • Advance Kubernetes/EKS, observability, governance, CI/CD, networking, and automation capabilities.
  • Partner across engineering organizations to deliver secure, scalable solutions for business-critical services.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation guidance, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted engineering capabilities where they improve automation, operational efficiency, documentation, or delivery quality.

How We Engineer

  • Build cloud infrastructure that is secure, resilient, automated, and designed to evolve with the business.
  • Automate first whenever a pattern is repeatable.
  • Build security and governance into every solution.
  • Partner across engineering organizations to deliver better outcomes.
  • Continuously improve the platform through practical, measurable engineering.
  • Use AI where it meaningfully improves engineering outcomes.

Technology You'll Work With

AWS • Terraform • Kubernetes/EKS • Helm • Python • GitHub Actions • GitOps • Lambda • IAM • Route 53 • Transit Gateway • CloudWatch • Datadog • Prometheus • Grafana • Cloud Custodian

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and operating AWS-based cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, automation, and CI/CD.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • AWS certifications.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with IaC and Terraform.
  • Experience deploying, administering, and troubleshooting Kubernetes platforms.
  • Strong automation experience using Python and/or Bash.
  • Experience designing CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Strong understanding of AWS networking including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, VPNs, and load balancing.
  • Experience building secure, highly available, resilient cloud environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting across compute, storage, networking, and platform services.
  • Experience with CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, and/or Grafana.
  • Experience with Git-based source control and collaborative engineering practices.
  • Experience administering Linux systems in cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, encryption, secrets management, logging, and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience monitoring, optimizing, and operating cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

You'll Be Successful Here If You...

  • Enjoy leading complex technical initiatives from idea to production.
  • Naturally look for opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve.
  • Build strong partnerships across engineering organizations.
  • Mentor others by sharing knowledge and raising engineering quality.
  • Balance technical excellence with practical business outcomes.
  • Embrace emerging technologies—including AI—when they create meaningful value.

Technology Evolves. So Do We.

We value curiosity, ownership, continuous learning, and engineers who continually challenge themselves—and us—to build better platforms, automate intelligently, and raise the standard for cloud engineering.

Join us in building the cloud foundation that enables Sony Interactive Entertainment to operate, innovate, and scale securely.



At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
$161,100—$241,700 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

title: Office & Workplace Coordinator på deltid till Nordberg Medical
description:
Vill du vara hjärtat i ett av Stockholms mest spännande medtech-bolag? Har du en känsla för service utöver det vanliga och vill jobba i en internationell miljö mitt i centrala Stockholm? Då kan detta vara den perfekta rollen för dig!

Om tjänsten

Nordberg Medical är ett snabbväxande företag inom medicinsk estetik och regenerativ medicin. Företaget grundades för 2,5 år sedan och har redan vuxit till över 180 anställda i 20 länder. Nu kliver de in i en extremt expansiv fas efter grönt ljus för sin produktlansering.

I denna roll kliver du in på Nordberg Medicals kontor i fina Waterfront Building vid Stockholms central. Då bolaget växer kraftigt finns ett tydligt behov av en dedikerad person som tar ägarskap över kontorsmiljön och medarbetarupplevelsen. Du stöttar ledningen samt arbetar tätt tillsammans med bolagets Executive Assistant för att skapa en arbetsplats i världsklass. Du kommer arbeta ca 8 timmar/vecka (20 %). Upplägget är flexibelt, men fördelas med fördel på två halvdagar. Måndagsmorgnar är högt prioriterade för att kickstarta veckan och färdigställa inför veckans gemensamma frukostmöte.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Office & Workplace Coordinator blir du en viktig spelare för kontoret där ca 50 personer har sin bas. Du ser till att allt på kontoret flyter sömlöst och ansvarar för en positiv medarbetar- och besöksupplevelse.

  • Säkerställa god kontorsmiljö (kontorssnacks & renlighet)
  • Ansvara för onboarding av nya arbetare
  • Hantera inkommande och utgående post
  • Vara brygga mellan medarbetare och IT-leverantör (e.g., hjälpa vid tekniska problem och prata med IT-leverantör över telefon)
  • Överse administrativa system såsom resehanterare, HR-system och IT-service-paneler
  • Assistera i administrativa uppgifter från diverse team

Vi söker dig som

  • Studerar en pågående eftergymnasial utbildning eller har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50%
  • Är flytande i engelska i både tal och skrift (engelska är bolagets arbetsspråk).
  • Har erfarenhet från en serviceroll, exempelvis som receptionist, kontorsassistent, inom hotell/restaurang eller event.
  • Har förmåga att arbeta självgående och strukturera din egen tid.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift (underlättar vid hantering av lokal post/leverantörer, men är inget krav).
  • Erfarenhet av IT-koordinering vid onboarding (t.ex. beställa/förbereda datorer och telefoner).
  • Erfarenhet av arbete i en internationell eller snabbväxande start-up/scale-up-miljö.

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • För att trivas i rollen är du en person som älskar service och har ett öga för detaljer. Du ser vad som behöver göras innan någon annan ber om det och tar gärna egna initiativ. Du har en prestigelös inställning där ingen uppgift är för stor eller för liten – du ställer upp där det behövs. Vidare är du varm, kommunikativ och trivs i en dynamisk och internationell miljö med högt tempo.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Du som kandidat bär huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

För våra deltidstjänster behöver du som sökande en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 %. Exempel på detta är studier, annan anställning, eget företagande, föräldraledighet eller liknande.

title: Web Developer

Web Developer (.NET)

WEB DEVELOPER


Why join Aptiv? You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world’s leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road—helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to backend architecture, content build and maintenance, establish development standards, and grow technical depth within a collaborative team environment.

Your role:

  • Strong hands-on experience with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and familiarity with modern frameworks (e.g., Angular, React)
  • Knowledge of C# and .NET / ASP.NET technologies
  • Experience integrating web applications with external systems using REST APIs
  • Understanding of web best practices including information architecture, responsive design, content modeling, and metadata/tagging

  • Excellent command of English

WHY JOIN US?

  • You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.

YOUR BENEFITS AT APTIV:

  • Savings Fund
  • Pension Plan
  • Christmas Bonus
  • Attendance Bonus
  • Vacation Premium
  • Medical Expenses
  • Life Insurance
  • Social security (IMSS, INFONAVIT, Retirement)
  • Recognition for innovation and excellence
  • Opportunities to give back to the community

Yes

Job Description:

The Activity Security Representative (ASR) II's primary function is to provide multi-disciplined security support to a customer’s facility and organization. The position will provide “day-to-day” support for Collateral, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) activities.

Performance shall include:

  • Classification reviews of inbound and outbound correspondence

  • Assist in the maintenance of a document accountability database and associated correspondence

  • Processing inbound and outbound classified mail and receipt records

  • Perform destruction of classified materials

  • Process magnetic media for accountability

  • Reproduction support for classified materials

  • Maintain various daily logs for a variety of administrative functions associated with document control

  • Assist in the processing of inbound data and outbound data transfer files

  • Transfer electronic data files to internal customers

  • Maintain an extensive customer database point of contact listing

  • Assist with researching, processing, filing, and maintaining inbound and outbound visit notices

  • Escort facility visitors and maintains associated logs

  • Assist in the preparation of facility access control badges

  • Conduct entry and exit inspections

  • Assist in the maintenance of facility access control entry systems, to include visitor control

  • Perform data entry to the Personnel Access Security System database and maintain all customer sponsored billets and quota information

  • Assist in maintaining personnel security files for all personnel of the supported element

  • Follow and enforce the customer’s Standard Operating Procedures

  • Provide support for the security awareness and education programs

  • Perform miscellaneous administrative support functions as directed by the contractor site lead and/or the Senior Security Representative


Experience:

  • 3+ years related experience

  • SAP experience required


Education (Desired):

  • Bachelor’s degree (Desired) If individual holds a Bachelor’s degree it can be substitute for four years of experience, Associate’s degree in related area counts as two years of experience.

Education Experience Equivalents:

  • Security Fundamentals Professional Certification (SFPC) counts towards 1 year of experience

  • Special Program Security Certification (SPSC) counts towards 1 year of experience

  • Maximum equivalent experience for SPED Certifications is no more than 3 years

Security Clearance:

  • TS/SCI, must be able to obtain TS/SCI with CI poly

  • Eligibility for access to Special Access Program Information

  • Willingness to submit to a Counterintelligence polygraph

Desired Qualifications:

  • Thorough Operations Security and Physical Security Knowledge

  • Experience in assisting and guiding the interpretation of security classification guides, classification and declassification decisions

  • Experience assisting with SCIF operations and construction

The likely salary range for this position is $73,015 - $98,785. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

title: Sushikokk
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss🧑‍🍳

Som sushikokk er du stjerna på vårt topp moderne kjøkken i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater🤩


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på.


Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Trives i et arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo
  • Har erfaring fra kjøkken-eller servicebransjen
  • Har kunnskap om IK-mat og HMS

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.


Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (remote within EMEA)
description:
About the team:

Platform Infrastructure builds, operates, and continuously evolves FYUL's container platform and cloud foundation. We foster a DevOps culture through self-service tooling, enabling product engineering teams to ship reliable, secure, and cost-efficient services as the business scales. The team owns our AWS cloud accounts, Kubernetes platform, cloud networking, observability stack, core databases, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code, and acts as the go-to partner for engineering teams on cloud and DevOps topics.


About the role:

We're hiring a Senior SRE II to join Platform Infrastructure as one of the team's senior individual contributors. At this level, you're the go-to person for our most complex infrastructure problems: you architect and drive large-scale automation and reliability initiatives, set standards other engineers follow, and mentor Associate and mid-level SREs. You'll split your time between hands-on platform work - Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, CI/CD, observability - and technical leadership: proposing designs, reviewing others' work, and helping the team make good build-vs-buy and cost/reliability trade-offs.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Infrastructure & reliability: Architect and manage highly available, secure, and scalable infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and environments using infrastructure as code.

  • Design and operate our Amazon EKS clusters, including networking policies, persistent storage, and scaling strategies for containerized workloads.

  • Own and evolve core platform services: cloud networking, Kubernetes, and the databases and messaging systems engineering teams depend on.

  • Automation & infrastructure as code: Drive large-scale automation projects and set standards for using Terraform / Terragrunt and GitOps (ArgoCD) across teams.

  • Lead adoption of automation to reduce manual operational work and keep environments consistent and repeatable.

  • Observability & incident response: Be the go-to person for solving complex, cross-service infrastructure problems.

  • Drive initiatives that improve reliability and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) so systems scale with minimal manual intervention.

  • Participate in on-call rotation, lead incident response for production issues, and write clear runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems.

  • Security & cost efficiency: Lead security efforts within the team - IAM, encryption, secure logging - and mentor others on secure infrastructure practices.

  • Audit infrastructure spend regularly and drive cost optimization across the platform (rightsizing, autoscaling, FinOps practices).

  • Collaboration & mentorship: Mentor mid-level SREs, provide detailed feedback, and support onboarding of new team members.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Partner with product engineering squads to understand their needs and represent Platform Infrastructure in cross-team initiatives.

Your qualifications:

These reflect the technical bar we hold Senior SRE II's to internally, based on our SRE competency framework and current stack.

  1. Core technical experience:

  • Solid Linux systems administration background and comfort scripting in Python.

  • Strong AWS knowledge: EKS, IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC networking, RDS, S3, SQS, and familiarity with the Well-Architected Framework; experience in multi-account AWS environments is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting Kubernetes (EKS) at production scale, including Helm chart development, CNI networking (we run Cilium), pod networking/IPAM concepts, and container security (ECR, image scanning).

  • Proficiency with Terraform (modules, state management) and ideally Terragrunt for multi-environment management; GitOps experience with ArgoCD.

  • Experience with Postgres, MySQL and/or MongoDB in production scale, including Aurora.

  • CI/CD experience with Jenkins (Jenkinsfile, shared libraries) and/or GitHub Actions, and familiarity with deployment strategies such as blue-green and canary.

  • Experience with the Grafana observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) - metrics design, dashboarding, alerting, log aggregation, and distributed tracing. Not only using but also maintaining it.

  • Practical incident management experience: on-call rotations, structured incident response, and writing runbooks/postmortems.

  • Working knowledge of 12-Factor App principles and cost optimization / FinOps awareness.

    2. How you work:

  • A methodical, data-driven approach to troubleshooting rather than guessing.

  • Strong written communication - you write runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems that others can actually follow.

  • Comfortable driving initiatives with ambiguous ownership, and taking accountability for outcomes rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Track record of mentoring less senior engineers and giving direct, constructive feedback.

  • Several years of hands-on production infrastructure/SRE experience, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives at a senior individual-contributor level (leading design work, setting standards, being the escalation point for hard problems).

    3. Nice to have:

  • GCP Experience.

  • Experience with Kafka / AWS MSK.

  • Prior experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (security best practices, access reviews).

  • Experience contributing to a platform/DevEx roadmap that other engineering teams consume as a self-service product.

Our tech stack:

  • Languages: PHP (Symfony), Node.js (TypeScript), Angular (TypeScript).

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.

  • Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis

  • Engineering Tools: Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus.

  • Remote work Tools: Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Development Practices: Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer

Who We Are!

Back in 2019, spiderSilk was born with a bold idea: build regional, sovereign cybersecurity IP that could stand tall on the global stage.

Our mission? To shake up the way organizations protect their ever-changing digital worlds with continuous, intelligent, and autonomous security that doesn’t miss a beat.

We’re a global mix of curious minds, problem-solvers, and passionate builders, all united by one goal: making the internet a safer place for everyone. Around here, we thrive on vision, energy, and a strong sense of ownership.

If this feels like your kind of crew, you’ll probably fit right in.

About the Role:

As a DevOps Engineer at spiderSilk, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing our development and deployment pipelines, ensuring high availability, security, and scalability of the infrastructure powering our cutting-edge cybersecurity products. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering and operations, driving automation, resilience, and efficiency across our systems while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure to accelerate software delivery.

  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and proactively respond to incidents to minimize downtime.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers to enable rapid, secure, and reliable releases.

  • Automate deployment, testing, and scaling processes to enhance operational efficiency.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud security best practices to ensure compliance and reduce risk.

  • Optimize system reliability and performance through proactive capacity planning and tuning.

  • Champion DevOps best practices, including observability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.

  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and evaluate new tools to improve our tech stack.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering, preferably in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong expertise with tools like Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

  • Proven experience in scaling applications and databases (SQL & NoSQL) for high-traffic workloads.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML tools that enhance operations and development (e.g., AI-driven monitoring, automated anomaly detection).

  • Deep proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud) and hybrid/multi-cloud architectures.

  • Strong scripting/programming skills in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling.

  • Solid understanding of networking, Linux systems, and security principles (e.g., zero-trust, IAM, secrets management).

  • A startup mindset—self-driven, adaptable, and passionate about building impactful products in a collaborative environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with cybersecurity tools and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC2, ISO 27001).

  • Knowledge of observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong technical blog/portfolio.

title: Careers Coach - EOI
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£30,000 to £31,500

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!

This role is office based, but will involve travel across Suffolk also.

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Internal applications for this role close on 21/08/2026.

Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. A Careers Coach is also responsible for conducting outreach in the community, building relationships with referral partners (DWP/JCP), and attending local events (e.g. job fairs) to generate referrals. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.

  • Providing support with CV preparation, job-searching, and interview skills.

  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.

  • Facilitating group training courses and workshops according to their needs.

  • Employer engagement and stakeholder management with the JCP.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

  • Reed Pension Scheme

  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training

  • Professional & Personal Development Funds

  • Bi-annual pay reviews

  • Plus much more that can be found on our website

  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Attainments

  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)

title: CFD Engineer, Principal
description:
The CFD Principal Engineer will normally plan, conduct, and supervise engineering assignments involving larger, more critical projects or multiple projects. Project work and assignments may be broad in nature, requiring ingenuity and cross-functional coordination. Provides technical assistance within a given area of specialization in Computational Fluid Dynamics and Process Safety to help deliver high-impact technical projects across Brazil and global markets. Our Risk Management team in Brazil supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen.

  • Represents the company at conferences and other meetings to resolve important problems and to plan and coordinate work between technology areas.
  • Develops working practices and procedures for new areas of technology. Works closely with a senior level Manager with regards to day-to-day activities, as appropriate, such as status/scheduling of work, setting priorities, sales initiatives, etc.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering
  • Graduate from University and a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field
  • Experience in international business and technical processes, as well as international requirements and problem resolution, is necessary.
  • International experience or knowledge of international business and related technical processes, requirements, and problem-solving skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies
  • Fluent Portuguese and English
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment
  • FLACS
  • KFX

title: Senior Data Engineer (Marketing)
description:

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Customer Systems, you will own customer and marketing data pipelines, integrations, platform workflows and data quality processes, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable and operationally robust.

Working across business and technology teams, you will translate complex requirements into practical data-driven solutions, guide technical decisions and deliver workflows that enable customer, marketing, digital and analytics use cases. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong problem-solving skills, sound technical judgement and the ability to independently deliver complex solutions while providing guidance to stakeholders, delivery partners and team members.

  • Design, build and optimise scalable data workflows, integrations and automation solutions that support marketing, customer, digital and analytics outcomes.
  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, balancing reliability, privacy, cost, maintainability and operational performance.
  • Lead the configuration and optimisation of marketing and customer platforms, including audience, event, trigger, journey and activation workflows.
  • Design, troubleshoot and support complex data pipelines, integrations and transformation processes, ensuring data quality, accuracy and reliability.
  • Investigate and resolve data, tracking and activation issues, performing validation, reconciliation and root cause analysis where required.
  • Own delivery from solution design through to implementation, monitoring, support and continuous improvement.
  • Implement and maintain appropriate governance, documentation, monitoring, alerting, audit and operational controls.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer, Product, Data, Engineering and Technology to deliver business outcomes, provide technical guidance and identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI and emerging technologies.

What’s In It For You

At Compare the Market and iSelect, we’re all about helping people make smart choices – and joining us might just be yours.We offer an environment where your ideas are heard, your contributions are valued, and your growth genuinely matters. We’re guided by three shared values that shape how we work, how we treat each other, and how we show up for our customers - Drive, Noble Intent and All Together.

What Sets You Apart

Technical Experience

  • Proven experience designing, building and supporting data workflows, integrations, automation solutions and data pipelines across connected business systems.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, events, schemas, data mappings, webhooks, workflow logic, data transformation patterns and system-to-system data movement.
  • Solid SQL and data management skills, including data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and data quality management.
  • Experience managing data extraction, transformation, enrichment, monitoring, failure handling and operational support processes.
  • Exposure to marketing and customer technologies such as CDPs, marketing automation, web analytics, tag management, audience activation, experimentation, personalisation or CRM-related platforms is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, consent, governance, auditability, monitoring and operational risk considerations in customer and marketing data environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity, gather requirements, design practical solutions, test outcomes, document processes and support production workflows.

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take initiatives from discovery and design through to delivery, support and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance speed, quality, risk, privacy and maintainability when making technical decisions.
  • Strong attention to detail across testing, validation, documentation, monitoring and operational handover activities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating business needs into practical data and integration solutions.
  • Collaborative and pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges that span multiple systems, teams and data sources.
  • Passion for emerging technologies, automation and AI, with a focus on driving operational efficiency and improving customer outcomes.

At Compare the Market and iSelect we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we embrace diversity.

title: Projektledare  - Robusta Fastigheter
description:
Välkommen till Sundsvalls kommun!

Sundsvalls kommun är en av Norrlands största arbetsgivare med runt 8 000 medarbetare och över 300 yrken. Tillsammans fyller vi ett av de viktigaste uppdragen i samhället – att skapa nytta och värde för invånare, företag och framtida generationer. Oavsett verksamhet arbetar vi för samma sak, att vi ska vara en bra plats att bo, leva och verka på.

Just nu befinner vi oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas. Vi är en drivande kraft inom digital utveckling och artificiell intelligens och tillsammans skapar vi smarta lösningar för Sundsvallsborna idag och i framtiden.

Vi står inför stora omställningar för att möta medborgares behov på sikt - vill du vara med på den resan?

Din nya arbetsplats

Drakfastigheter är Sundsvalls kommuns fastighetsförvaltare. Vi ser till att kommunens lokaler erbjuder en trivsam miljö för dem som vistas där genom att forma och utveckla våra fastigheter i nära samarbete med de kommunala verksamheter som hyr dem. Allt för att Sundsvalls kommun ska bedriva sin verksamhet i effektiva, ändamålsenliga och klimatsmarta lokaler.

Drakfastigheter är idag en verksamhet inom Kommunstyrelsekontorets förvaltning med ca 230 anställda. Utöver fastighetsförvaltning, städning, tvätt hantering och löpande drift ansvarar vi för ny-, om- och tillbyggnader i kommunala lokaler. Tillsammans med de kommunala förvaltningarna arbetar vi för att erbjuda sundsvallsborna lokaler och miljöer att trivas och utvecklas i. Vi söker en engagerad projektledare som vill bidra till utvecklingen av Sundsvall.

Så här bidrar du i rollen

I rollen som projektledare leder du självständigt projekt med fokus på kvalitet, driftkontinuitet och utveckling av robusta fastigheter som kan upprätthålla sin funktion även vid samhällsstörningar och kriser. Under de första åren kommer ditt arbete i huvudsak att vara kopplat till delprojekten inom det övergripande utvecklingsprogrammet Robusta fastigheter.

Rollen kombinerar traditionell projektledning med ett specialistområde inom civil beredskap, säkerhet och robusthet i fastighetsbeståndet. Arbetet är i viss grad mer strategiskt och analytiskt, där du ansvarar för att utreda behov, ta fram beslutsunderlag, beställa konsultuppdrag och samordna olika aktörer för att omsätta krav och mål till konkreta åtgärder.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Leda och driva projekt från planering till genomförande och överlämning samt att de följer lag och myndighetskrav.
  • Ta fram projektdirektiv, förfrågningsunderlag, kalkyler, tidplaner och övriga beslutsunderlag.
  • Genomföra analyser och utredningar kopplade till robusthet, säkerhet och driftkontinuitet i kommunens fastighetsbestånd.
  • Bidra till utvecklingen av kommunens arbete inom civilt försvar och krisberedskap med fokus på lokaler och samhällsviktiga fastigheter.
  • Ansvara för projektuppföljning, dokumentation och erfarenhetsåterföring.
  • Delta i framtagandet av kravställningar för ramavtal och genomföra omvärldsbevakning inom området.

Din kompetens och erfarenhet

  • Högskole- eller eftergymnasieutbildning med byggteknisk inriktning eller motsvarande erhållen arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
  • Dokumenterad yrkeserfarenhet av projektledning inom byggprojekt kopplade till fastigheter.
  • Mycket god kunskap i svenska i både tal och skrift samt god kunskap i engelska i tal och skrift
  • God kunskap inom Office paketet och av att jobba i fastighetsrelaterad IT-miljö
  • Innehar körkort B

Meriterande

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av utvecklings-, förbättrings och/eller kvalitetsarbete, projektledning, kontinuitetshantering, risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser eller säkerhetsskyddsarbete
  • Erfarenhet av offentlig verksamhet, LOU, kalkylering och upphandling/inköp
  • Utbildning/kunskap inom entreprenad juridik

Som person är du självgående, initiativrik och har en stark drivkraft att föra arbetet framåt. Du har en lösningsorienterad inställning och trivs med att hantera komplexa frågor på ett strukturerat sätt. Du arbetar målmedvetet och tar ansvar för att nå resultat, samtidigt som du har god samarbetsförmåga och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med kollegor och samarbetspartners.

Vidare är du kvalitetsmedveten och har ett gott omdöme i dina bedömningar och prioriteringar. Du har förmåga att se helheten, analysera komplexa sammanhang och omsätta behov och krav till hållbara och långsiktiga lösningar. Rollen kräver att du är flexibel och kan anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar.

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kommer att genomföras före beslut om anställning.

Bra att veta

title: Careers Coach - EOI
description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

Pay Range

£29,000 to £30,000

Working Hours/Pattern:

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?

Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?

Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!

This role is office based, but will involve travel across Newcastle also.

Please Note, these roles are expressions of interest only at this point. We are currently working on a number of exciting opportunities within this area and are looking to build a pipeline of talent to allow us to work quickly upon contract award. We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.

Internal applications for this role close on 21/08/2026.

Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.

A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. A Careers Coach is also responsible for conducting outreach in the community, building relationships with referral partners (DWP/JCP), and attending local events (e.g. job fairs) to generate referrals. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.

  • Providing support with CV preparation, job-searching, and interview skills.

  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.

  • Facilitating group training courses and workshops according to their needs.

  • Employer engagement and stakeholder management with the JCP.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

  • Reed Pension Scheme

  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training

  • Professional & Personal Development Funds

  • Bi-annual pay reviews

  • Plus much more that can be found on our website

  • With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

Essential Attainments

  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)

  • Experience of working in a performance target driven environment

  • Willingness to travel locally, and access to own vehicle (e.g. to meet customers/employers).

  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.

  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification).

Desirable Attainments:

  • Experience of working in a fast-paced environment. Examples of such experience may include working as a Holiday Representative or Recruitment Consultant, etc.

  • Experience of and exposure to client groups. These client groups may include incapacity benefit claimants, single parents, those with criminal records, mental health groups, ex-services, specific ethnic minority or faith groups and those with specific disabilities.

  • Direct previous experience of a similar role. Roles considered to be similar include the role of Employment Adviser on a welfare to work contract or a publicly funded service.

  • Degree or relevant qualification. Degree topics may include psychology, sociology, and social care/science. Relevant qualifications would include Information Advice and Guidance NVQs, Brokerage Standard, Social Work qualifications or qualifications relating to work with the specific client groups this role will involve

  • Level 3 or 4 NVQ in Advice & Guidance or Education & Training

  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (Dependent on programme).

  • Technical skills include the ability to use technology to deliver results and knowledge of welfare/benefits system

  • Personal interests include interest in career and self-development.

  • Experience of coaching and/or training

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

title: Pompmonteur
description:
Looking to turn a new leaf? What are you waiting for? Join our fast-growing, dynamic company anywhere in Europe!

Wat ga je doen als servicemonteur pompen?

Ons moderne pompenpark bestaat uit diesel, elektrisch en lucht aangedreven pompen met op een deel van onze vloot een ATEX certificering. Hierdoor kunnen we onze klanten altijd een goede oplossing bieden.

Wij hebben jou nodig om onze pompen te installeren, te onderhouden, te repareren en onze klanten de juiste technische service te bieden. De ene keer ben je ben ons in de werkplaats aan de gang en de andere keer zit je bij een klant op locatie.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit:

  • Leveren en (de-)installeren van pompen en ander verhuurmaterieel op klantlocatie

  • Servicen van pompen en dieselmotoren op locatie

  • Inspecteren, repareren en onderhouden van pompen en ander materieel op onze vestiging in Zevenbergschen Hoek

  • Helpen bij de voorbereiding en operationele planning van complexere pompprojecten

  • Verzorgen van on-the-job pompen training aan collega’s van het Operations team

  • Het uitvoeren van radarniveaumeetingen

Als je van afwisseling houdt in je baan, dan zit je bij ons wel goed.

Wat bieden we jou?

United Rentals biedt je een verantwoordelijke functie binnen een internationale en servicegerichte werkomgeving waar ruimte is voor initiatieven. Jouw mening en vernieuwende ideeën worden gewaardeerd.

Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een prima salaris plus aanvullende vergoedingen

  • Een goed gevulde servicebus

  • 30 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid er 5 bij te kopen

  • Overuren bij +40 uur/week, alle uren 150% betaald, alle uren op zondag 200%

  • Een mobiele telefoon van de zaak

  • Bonus bij gezamenlijk behalen van de veiligheidsdoelstellingen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Mogelijkheid tot het behalen van verschillende certificaten

We besteden veel tijd aan een gedegen inwerktraject wat ervoor zorgt dat je een goede basis meekrijgt als start van jouw loopbaan bij United Rentals.

Wie ben jij?

Voor onze rol van service monteur pompen/dieselmotoren ben je flexibel en praktisch ingesteld. Je haalt voldoening uit klantcontact en op verschillende locaties je werk verrichten. Er wordt soms een uurtje langer gewerkt, maar normaal gezien kun je op tijd thuis zijn om van je avond te genieten. Je bent een echte techneut en vindt het leuk om te sleutelen en storingen op te zoeken.

Het is belangrijk dat je;

  • een technische opleiding hebt afgerond op tenminste MBO 3 niveau. (mechatronica is een pre ivm elektrotechnische kennis)

  • Affiniteit hebt met sleutelen aan (brommer/auto/vrachtwagen/boot) motoren

  • de Nederlandse taal beheerst en Engels begrijpt

  • in bezit bent van rijbewijs B. De E achter B mag je bij ons halen

Uiteraard werk je in teamverband, maar een grote mate van zelfstandigheid wordt gewaardeerd. Tot slot vragen we je bereid te zijn om in roulatie 24/7 stand-by diensten te draaien.

Wie zijn wij?

United Rentals Europe is marktleider op het gebied van geïntegreerde oplossingen voor vloeistofmanagement en stroom. Wij verhuren materieel en gebruiken onze expertise om voor klanten oplossingen voor opslag, verpompen en filtratie van vloeistoffen en tijdelijke stroomvoorziening te realiseren. Onze producten zijn ontworpen met veiligheid en kwaliteit als topprioriteit en zijn "plug and play".

We hebben 38 vestigingen verspreid over Europa (Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk). Ons Europese hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Groei zit in ons DNA en dit biedt medewerkers de mogelijkheid om op persoonlijk en professioneel vlak te groeien.

We zijn onderdeel van United Rentals, Inc., het grootste verhuurbedrijf van materieel ter wereld. Het bedrijf heeft een meer dan 1500 verhuurlocaties in Noord-Amerika, Europa, Australië en Nieuw-Zeeland en meer dan 26.000 werknemers.

Wij bieden als werkgever gelijke kansen voor iedereen, ongeacht geslachtsidentiteit, leeftijd, nationaliteit, religie, seksuele oriëntatie, handicap of andere niet-prestatiegerelateerde factoren. We hechten waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie en bieden een respectvolle werkomgeving waarin geen plaats is voor discriminatie en intimidatie.

Enthousiast geworden?

Solliciteren? We ontvangen graag jouw reactie op de vacature van Service monteur Pompen/Dieselmotoren. Je krijgt zo spoedig mogelijk onze reactie.

Nog vragen? Bel of stuur een Whatsapp-bericht aan onze corporate recruiter Koen Trommar via 06-2360879 of stuur een e-mail via werkenbijUR@ur.com.

title: Medewerker Zorgadministratie
description:
Welke uitdaging ga je aan?

Ben jij de zorgadministrateur die opzoek is naar een uitdagende functie waarin je meer bent dan alleen een administrateur? Sta jij stevig in je schoenen en durf je binnen een hectische werkomgeving deze uitdaging aan te gaan? Solliciteer dan snel!

De functie van medewerker zorgadministratie is binnen GGZ Rivierduinen meer dan een reguliere administratieve functie. Het is een uitdagende functie waarin je naast je administratieve taken, het klantvriendelijk en tactvol benaderen van onze cliënten ook een actieve bijdrage zal leveren aan de ontwikkeling van de afdeling. Hierbij richten we ons vooral op de volgende punten:

  • het uitvoeren van zorgadministratieve taken conform de geldende (Ao.)procedures waaronder registratie, mutaties, beheer wachtlijsten en agenda’s;

  • het toetsen van cliëntdossiers en de registratie van behandelaren op juistheid, volledigheid en betrouwbaarheid en ondernemen van actie bij onvolkomenheden;

  • het valideren van ZPM-/zorgtrajecten;

  • het bijhouden van signaleringslijsten en –overzichten.

En verder..

Zal je je ook bezig houden met:

  • het adviseren en ondersteunen van behandelaren, bij vragen over de zorgregistratie;

  • het beantwoorden van algemene vragen van cliënten over planningen, facturen, hun dossier, met betrekking tot zorgadministratie en – registratie e.d.;

  • het informeren van collega’s over de zorgadministratieve ontwikkelingen binnen de toegewezen zorgfuncties;

  • inplannen van afspraken / uitnodigen cliënten op verzoek van behandelaars.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een MBO+ opleiding op het gebied van zorgadministratie of een vergelijkbare basisopleiding;

  • Je hebt relevante werkervaring;

  • Je hebt kennis van de GGZ, zorgadministratie, wet- en regelgeving (o.a. Zorgverzekeringswet) en ervaring met de gebruikelijke applicaties;

  • Je hebt ervaring met klantcontact en/of telefonische dienstverlening en je bent klantvriendelijk en tactisch bij het te woord staan van cliënten en het ondersteunen van behandelaren;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, kan goed prioriteiten stellen, bent flexibel en kan je grenzen bewaken.

Waar ga je werken?

Het Cluster Zorgadministratie (ZA) bestaat uit de Centrale ZA plus twee afdelingen (decentrale) ZA. Het Cluster ZA maakt onderdeel uit van het Servicebedrijf. Vanwege de steeds veranderende wet- en regelgeving is ons vakgebied complex en dynamisch. De medewerkers ZA hebben actuele kennis van het gehele registratieproces en zijn breed inzetbaar. Daarnaast voert de ZA controles uit aangaande de registratie en heeft zij een essentiële rol in het cliënt-logistieke proces. De medewerkers ZA werken nauw samen met de zorgafdelingen en met de centrale ZA.

De vacature is voor de Zorgadministratie op locatie Rijnveste in Leiden, waar de ondersteuning ook plaatsvindt. Ook is de ZA aanwezig op de verschillende locaties. Hiermee is de kans aanwezig dat je (ook) op één van de andere locaties incidenteel kan werken. Flexibiliteit is daarom geboden. Werkdagen maandag, dinsdag, woensdag, en vrijdag zijn verplichte dagen.

Wat krijg je van GGZ Rivierduinen?

  • Een jaarcontract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op verlenging voor 32-36 uur;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €2.888,- en €3.917,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (FWG 40 conform CAO GGZ);

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris;

  • 8.33% vakantietoeslag, 166 vakantie-uren en 35 LFB-uren per jaar (bij een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Reis- en onkostenvergoeding;

  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;

  • Meerkeuze systeem arbeidsvoorwaarden (bijvoorbeeld voor de aankoop van een elektrische fiets of het kopen van extra verlofdagen);

  • Keuze uit twee aantrekkelijke collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Jaarlijks een balansbudget van maximaal €1000,- , om te zetten naar extra verlofuren of uit te betalen als bruto loon; Indien ingezet voor opleiding, bedraagt het €1.400 op voltijdsbasis.

  • Opleiding en ontwikkeling via onze Rivierduinen Academie waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt tot het volgen van zorginhoudelijke scholingsprogramma's voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie? Neem gerust contact op met Kimberley van Beugen, recruiter via 06 13318415 of stuur een mail naar k.vanbeugen@rivierduinen.nl

Goed om te weten; onze sollicitatieprocedure omvat een referentiecheck en bij indiensttreding vragen we om een verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG).

GGZ Rivierduinen

GGZ Rivierduinen biedt geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) aan mensen van alle leeftijden met ernstige psychische klachten en hun naasten. Onze 2.100 collega’s helpen zo’n 15.000 cliënten in de regio’s Alphen aan den Rijn, Duin- en Bollenstreek, Gouda, Leiden, Leidschendam en Zoetermeer. We hebben onder andere poliklinieken, wijkteams, acute zorg, klinieken, verblijfsafdelingen, dagbesteding en een specialistische afdeling voor eetstoornissen.

Onze bevlogen medewerkers zijn het kloppende hart van Rivierduinen. Daarom geven we je de ruimte om werk te doen dat bij je past. Wil je doorgroeien? Met opleidingen en onderzoek neem je zelf de regie over je ontwikkeling. Jouw vakkennis is onmisbaar in de samenwerking met cliënten, hun naasten, collega’s en ketenpartners. Zo maak jij het verschil!

Over Rivierduinen Verleggen

GGZ Rivierduinen is volop in beweging. Met Rivierduinen Verleggen bouwen we aan een toekomstgerichte organisatie waarin herstelgerichte netwerkpsychiatrie centraal staat. We brengen zorg dichter bij de leefwereld van cliënten, werken intensiever samen met hun netwerk en versterken de verbinding tussen teams, expertises en domeinen.

Deze verandering raakt alle onderdelen van onze zorg. Wat dit betekent voor jouw functie? Dat lichten we graag toe in een persoonlijk gesprek. Want hoe jij bijdraagt aan deze beweging, hangt af van jouw rol, ervaring en ambities.

Wat vaststaat: we zoeken collega’s die willen meedenken, samenwerken en bouwen aan zorg die écht beweegt. Jouw vakkennis en ervaring doen ertoe.

title: Field Application Specialist
description:
Provides technical support via phone or email to internal OpCo functions (engineers, technicians, and product support personnel) by diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing and debugging complex electro/mechanical equipment, computer systems, complex software, or networked and/or wireless systems. Responds to situations where first-line product support has failed to isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning equipment or software. Repairs and/or updates products at the office site (not field). Reports design, reliability and maintenance problems or bugs to design engineering/software engineering. Highest level of problem escalation. May be responsible for developing and conducting technical training for product lines. Normally degreed engineers or scientists. May be referred to as "bench technicians".

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Musik, artister & möjligheter, är du vår nästa bokare?
description:
Var med och forma Skånes största evenemang och bokningar!

Royal Purple Records står bakom bokningarna till några av Sveriges största scener, från Summer ON i Båstad till Berns i Stockholm. Vi arbetar med allt från etablerade namn som Mohombi till nästa generations stjärnor, som 8-åriga Gabriel Thamhaksa.

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Intern accountmanager
description:
Meteen duidelijk

Vanuit onze vestiging in Amsterdam ben jij de vaste steun en toeverlaat voor de accountmanagers in de buitendienst. Jij duikt in de verkoopcijfers, bewaakt de omzet en marges en zorgt er telefonisch voor dat onze Amsterdamse horecaklanten optimaal worden bediend.

Goed geregeld

  • Salaris: € 2.700,- tot € 3.100,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur

  • 13x salaris: We betalen je salaris elke 4 weken uit, dus je ontvangt 13 keer loon per jaar.

  • Reiskosten: € 0,23 per km (van 10 km t/m 25 km enkele reis).

  • Eten & extra’s: Elke dag een verzorgde lunch op de vestiging én personeelskorting op al je favoriete Bidfood-producten.

  • Werksfeer & cultuur: Een nuchtere, inclusieve werkomgeving met een echt familiegevoel waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, plus gezellige teamuitjes en het jaarlijkse Horecafeest.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Buitendienst ondersteunen: Jij zorgt dat afspraken voorbereid zijn zodat de accountmanager precies weet welke punten die moet bespreken om de klantwaarde te verhogen en de relatie te verbeteren.

  • Cijfers & marges bewaken: Je analyseert bestelpatronen en omzetcijfers in Excel, houdt de marges scherp in de gaten en onderbouwt je commerciële adviezen richting accountmanagers.

  • Eigen klanten beheren: Je onderhoudt het telefonische contact met je eigen groep Amsterdamse horeca klanten, denkt proactief met ze mee en promoot (nieuwe) producten en diensten.

De realiteit van de baan

Dit is een functie op de binnendienst van onze vestiging in Amsterdam. Je voert dagelijks veel telefoongesprekken en moet het leuk vinden om proactief actie te ondernemen richting klanten en prospects. Je moet besluiten goed kunnen onderbouwen met cijfers uit Excel, zeker wanneer marges onder druk staan. Dat vraagt om daadkracht, analytisch inzicht en een gezonde dosis doorzettingsvermogen.

Wie ben jij?

Bij ons telt wie je bent en welke vaardigheden je meebrengt, niet alleen je diploma's.

  • Analytisch & sterk met Excel: Je maakt je systemen snel eigen, leest verkoopdata moeiteloos en kunt cijfers vertalen naar concrete acties.

  • Overtuigende communicator: Je spreekt de taal van de horeca én die van de accountmanagers.

  • Samen scoren: Je haalt graag je doelstellingen en wilt elke dag samen met het team het beste resultaat neerzetten.

Contact

App je CV of klik op de knop solliciteren. Onze recruiter Millan is ook telefonisch bereikbaar op het telefoonnummer 0625288697

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature is niet gewenst en zal ook niet beantwoord worden.

title: Vi søker vektere til utelivet
description:
Vil du være med å bidra til et trygt og trivelig uteliv på Haugalandet?

PSS Securitas er Norges største leverandør av godkjent ordensvakter og vektere til utelivsbransjen og festivaler.

Vi opplever en fantastisk vekst i PSS Securitas avdeling Haugaland og Sunnhordland og søker derfor etter flere kandidater som ønsker å jobbe som vekter og ordensvakt i en spennende og utfordrende bransje. Stillingen er deltid og arbeidstiden vil ha sin hovedvekt på kveld/natt i helger.

Vi tilbyr deg

  • Et spennende yrke i et solid selskap
  • Ordnede arbeidsforhold
  • En jobb du vil trives i
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og trivelige kolleger

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Plettfri vandel
  • Behersker norsk flytende, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • God psykisk og fysisk helse
  • Har nødvendig modenhet og personlig egnethet som kreves av en ordensvakt
  • Er løsningsorientert, fleksibel, selvstendig og ansvarsfull
  • Er sosial og liker å jobbe med andre mennesker
  • Tilgjengelig for arbeid minst annenhver helg på kveld/natt


Ønskelig

  • Det er ønskelig at søker er over 20 år
  • Relevant erfaring
  • Fullført vekterutdannelse
  • Ordensvaktkurs
  • Fullført førstegangstjeneste
  • Ved manglende fullført vekterutdanning, må ny vekterutdanning gjennomføres.
