title: Client Data Contribution Analyst
description:
Client Data Contribution Analyst - RP

Location: Scottsdale

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze℠, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Positions located in Scottsdale, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York follow a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose:

This position is responsible for initiating and leading routine client data contribution, quality and remediation projects that support core business functions and are low to moderate complexity for all datasets used by Early Warning products and services. This position will also perform monitoring, research and analysis client level data to ensure the quality necessary to optimize performance of Early Warning products and services.

Essential Functions:

  • Initiate projects with customers to engage necessary resources, define scope of work, task lists, and project milestone dates and timeline; manage and document multiple client data projects, cases and issues simultaneously using the Early Warning CRM tool.
  • Manages projects from beginning to end playing a key role managing discovery, definition of scope, technical requirements and specifications review, code development (client/internal), testing, production implementation. Works with customers for production validation and certification activities; schedules and coordinates implementations to production. Resolves issues promptly and effectively.
  • Meets with customers regularly to provide and obtain client status updates; reports on health and status of project to both customers and internal EWS stakeholders and escalates both internally and externally as appropriate. Ensures timely execution of projects to ensure progress against tasks and milestones according to plan and that project schedule is on track.
  • Works with client to transition from project to business-as-usual operations to ensure quality standards are maintained and sustainable.
  • Collaborates closely with customers, vendors, business analysts, project managers and development project teams to fully assess data feeds and expectations.
  • Provides consultation and guidance on projects to ensure quality of client dataset contributions.
  • Assesses impacts of data contribution or quality issues that will provide insights to the urgency and steps for remediation in collaboration with customers and stakeholders. Ensures adherence to technical requirements and operating rules as it relates to contribution and ongoing quality of contributed data. Escalates non-responsive, non-performance and/or non-compliance issues as appropriate.
  • Coordinates and test new data transmissions, data mapping, sample and test files and code changes/development related to a client data contribution in collaboration clients and EWS internal resources. Troubleshoots issues (testing and/or production) with client or Early Warning IT partners and make any necessary code or configuration changes required to ensure contribution files meet quality standards.
  • Performs acceptance testing, validation and certification and quality assurance for customer data contribution projects.
  • Initiates audits on client's data, analyzes results and takes action by collaborating with client and facilitates solutions for production or testing issues.
  • Research root causes of problems with contributed data and leads effort to remediate the issue with the contributor.
  • Conduct assessments of data quality and integrity requiring research and analysis and working with clients to understand contribution practices and making recommendations for remediation
  • Provides input to ensure efficiencies with automated methods or tools for customer support, research and analytics.
  • Assists with the development and improvements of internal processes and procedures related to customer data contribution and dimensions of data quality (timeliness, accuracy, completeness, etc).
  • Complies with all security policies and procedures, to ensure that the highest level of system and data confidentiality, integrity and availability is maintained.
  • Ensures department maintains compliance with internal policies and procedures.
  • Supports the company’s commitment to protect the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data.
  • The above job description is a summary of job responsibilities and is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform tasks and other duties as assigned by their manager.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education or experience equivalent to a Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management or Data Analytics related field.

A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a data analytics, data quality or data management role or related experience is required.

Experience in a client-facing or project management role with excellent written, oral and presentation skills to effectively conduct client meetings.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and concurrent deliverables while keeping client and internal partners on task for timely and successful execution and implementation.

Strong analytic and problem-solving skills; motivated self-learner.

Adaptable: able to prioritize and work with sense of urgency.

Ability to translate complex technical jargon into business language that can be easily consumed by all key stakeholders.

Strong PC skills: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

Successful completion of background and drug screen is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

2+ years experience with Early Warning products and services or equivalent financial services industry products, services and regulatory requirements

Prior project management experience

Experience with data analysis and visualization tools such at Tableau Prep, SAS, R or Python and/or other programming language(s)

Experience or certification in data management platforms such as Talend or Informatica (Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC), Axon, and Data quality (IDQ))

Strong knowledge of the multiple dimensions associated with data quality (timeliness, accuracy, completeness, etc).

Physical Requirements

Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

The base pay scale for this position in:
Phoenix, AZ in USD per year is: $84,000 - $105,000.
Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. Early Warning Services takes into consideration a variety of factors when determining a competitive salary offer, including, but not limited to, the job scope, market rates and geographic location of a position, candidate’s education, experience, training, and specialized skills or certification(s) in relation to the job requirements and compared with internal equity (peers). The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

  • Healthcare Coverage – Competitive medical (PPO/HDHP), dental, and vision plans as well as company contributions to your Health Savings Account (HSA) or pre-tax savings through flexible spending accounts (FSA) for commuting, health & dependent care expenses.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Featuring a 100% Company Safe Harbor Match on your first 6% deferral immediately upon eligibility.

  • Paid Time Off – Flexible Time Off for Exempt (salaried) employees, as well as generous PTO for Non-Exempt (hourly) employees, plus 11 paid company holidays and a paid volunteer day.

  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Maven Family Planning – provides support through your Parenting journey including egg freezing, fertility, adoption, surrogacy, pregnancy, postpartum, early pediatrics, and returning to work.

And SO much more! We continue to enhance our program, so be sure to check our Benefits page here for the latest. Our team can share more during the interview process!

The company also prohibits discrimination on other bases such as medical condition, marital status or any other factor that is irrelevant to the performance of our employees.

title: Senior Consultant - Data & AI
description:
Why work for Brennan?
At Brennan, we aim to lead, not follow. One of the ways we do this is through an open diverse culture that values performance, where anyone in the team can bringnew ideasto the table and see them thrive. Our people are empowered, considerate, supportive, trusting and accepting, they are the cornerstone of the business. Because of this approach, we have become the largest Australian owned systems integrator in Australia and continue to grow.
Brennan offers an excellentremunerationpackage and benefits including:

  • A focus on health and well-being - social club, sporting teams, health checks, poker, trivia nights and more!
  • A strong culture underpinned by values that are truly lived every day
  • An environment that embraces learning and development of all employees
  • Flexibility to work in the way that brings out the best in you
  • High levelsof reward and recognition for overachieving

As a Senior Data & AI Consultant, you will be a senior, hands-on consultant who architects and leads Microsoft Data & AI engagements. The role centres on Microsoft Fabric modern data platforms and the production delivery of Microsoft Copilot and AI agent solutions, supported by Azure and Power BI.
You will lead project inception, technical discovery, solution design and delivery, translating business needs into production-ready outcomes. You may also lead analytics, automation and broader AI use cases, drawing on specialists where required. It is preferred that this role will be located in Brisbane but we will consider candidates in Sydney and Melbourne who meet all the criteria required.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

In your role you will be responsible for:

  • Lead project inception, technical discovery and solution design within client delivery engagements.
  • Lead solution architecture and technical delivery for assigned projects and workstreams from design through deployment and handover.
  • Own delivery planning, technical estimates, dependencies, risks, quality controls and acceptance criteria with the Project Manager and delivery team.
  • Translate customer priorities and use cases into clear architecture, delivery roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
  • Design and deliver Microsoft Fabric modern data platforms spanning integration, engineering, lakehouse or warehouse design, semantic models, analytics and production operations.
  • Design and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio agents into production, integrated with enterprise data and processes.
  • Establish production patterns for AI and agents covering security, testing, monitoring, guardrails, release management and lifecycle support.
  • Shape and lead analytics, automation and AI use cases with specialists where required, maintaining a clear focus on adoption and value realisation.
  • Remain hands‑on through prototyping, solution development, design and code reviews, troubleshooting and quality assurance.
  • Lead customer workshops and stakeholder discussions, clearly communicating technical decisions, trade-offs, risks and recommended actions.
  • Mentor consultants through project delivery, contribute reusable delivery assets and methods, support continuous improvement, and consistently meet utilisation and client commitments.

Skills / Experienced required :

  • Advanced, recent, relevant experience delivering complex data, analytics or AI solutions in consulting, professional services or comparable client environments.
  • Proven senior consulting experience leading solution architecture and technical delivery for complex client projects, with responsibility for technical quality, risk and outcomes.
  • Deep hands‑on capability designing and delivering Microsoft Fabric solutions, supported by Azure and Power BI.
  • End-to-end modern data platform experience spanning architecture, data integration and engineering, lakehouse or warehouse design, semantic models, analytics, deployment and production support.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying Microsoft Copilot Studio agents into production and taking AI use cases from discovery or prototype into secure, supported environments, including enterprise data and process integration, security controls, testing, monitoring and lifecycle management.
  • Strong hands‑on engineering and architectural judgement, with the ability to review designs and code, resolve complex issues and enforce production-ready standards.
  • Ability to shape and lead analytics, automation and AI use cases with specialist team members to achieve measurable business outcomes.
  • Exceptional consulting and communication skills, including leading workshops and translating complex technical decisions for business, technical and senior stakeholders, ideally within a consulting or system intergrator organisation
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor consultants, uplift delivery capability and create reusable delivery methods and assets.

Experience with Databricks and Snowflake is advantageous but not essential

AU Citizenship preferred and/or AU Permanent Residents.

Police and background checks will be conducted on the successful candidate

title: INŽINIERĖ (-IUS) (DARBAS PAMAINOMIS, APMOKOME)
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) Elektrėnų komplekso operatyvinio valdymo skyriuje, Elektros ir automatikos įrenginų komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už saugų ir patikimą elektros ir automatikos įrenginių darbą. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart! #inžinierė #inžinierius

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Vykdant elektros ir automatikos įrenginių apžiūras;
  • Identifikuojant įrenginių defektus ir sutrikimus;
  • Šalinant smulkius įrenginių gedimus;
  • Vykdant operatyvinius perjungimus elektros ir automatikos įrenginiuose;
  • Pildant operatyvinę dokumentaciją;
  • Dirbant pamainose pagal slenkantį darbo grafiką: dieninės ir naktinės pamainos po 12 darbo valandų.
  • Aukštasis (universitetinis arba neuniversitetinis) išsilavinimas, įgytas baigus elektros inžinerijos ar elektronikos inžinerijos studijų krypties studijas;
  • Geros „MS Office“ žinios;
  • Iniciatyvumas, orientacija į rezultatą, kruopštumas.
  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Transportas darbuotojams (vežiojimas į/iš darbo, ekipažai, panaudos, automobilio eksploatacijos sąnaudų kompensavimas);
  • Maistas (spec. pietų kaina darbuotojams, nemokama kava, vaisiai);
  • Apmokamas mokymosi atostogas;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Finansinį skatinimą už kandidatų rekomendavimą;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Papildomą skatinimą dalyvaujant Grupės iniciatyvose;
  • Unikalius energetikos transformacijos projektus.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

title: Senior Consultant - Industrial & Manufacturing Directs
description:
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant at Proxima, you will lead complex workstreams within our Directs category, focused on Industrial and Manufacturing categories, and manage senior stakeholders while delivering innovative solutions and mentoring junior consultants. You will be part of client-facing teams delivering high-impact commercial, sourcing, and supplier initiatives, supporting the development of insights, contributing to solution design, and playing an active role in delivering outcomes, not just recommendations.

This is not a passive learning role. At Proxima, we are practitioner-consultants. You will build experience quickly, take responsibility early, and work alongside clients to deliver real, measurable change.

What you’ll do

Support delivery across client engagements

  • Experience leading teams and workstreams or projects across complex engagements

  • Assist with opportunity identification, supplier research, and commercial analysis.

  • Identify opportunities supporting client value and revenue growth.

Management and career development

  • Coach and develop junior consultants.

  • Contribute to Proxima category thought leadership and IP.

  • Commercial acumen and comfort with ambiguity.

Engage and collaborate with stakeholders

  • Work directly with senior client stakeholders to gather requirements and align objectives.

  • Communicate findings clearly and professionally with team members and senior client stakeholders.

  • Lead workshops, working sessions, and day-to-day client interactions.

Work in a global, flexible model

  • Operate in a hybrid environment, balancing client, home, and office-based work.

  • Travel as required to support client delivery and team collaboration.

What you bring

Experience and skills

  • Strong experience in consulting, procurement, supply chain, or a related analytical role.

  • Experience in industrial and manufacturing settings, with an understanding of supplier markets, offerings and operations

  • Experience supporting project delivery and managing stakeholder engagement across workstreams.

  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with data.

Consulting mindset

  • Strong senior stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach to your work.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.

Flexibility and growth orientation

  • Willingness to travel as required.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn and develop.

  • Motivation to build a long-term consulting career in a growing global firm.
